4.28.s:
nārada uvāca ..
triṣu māseṣvatīteṣu tāsāṃ ca hariṇā saha ..
vada kena prakāreṇa babhūva tanusaṃgamaḥ ..1..
4.28.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
त्रिषु मासेष्वतीतेषु तासां च हरिणा सह ॥
वद केन प्रकारेण बभूव तनुसंगमः ॥1॥
4.28.m: Did their bodily union with Hari take place?

4.28.s:
vṛndāvanaṃ kiṃprakāraṃ kiṃvidhaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ..
harirekastāśca bahvyaḥ kena krīḍā babhūva ha .. 2 ..
4.28.d:
वृन्दावनं किंप्रकारं किंविधं रासमण्डलम् ॥
हरिरेकस्ताश्च बह्व्यः केन क्रीडा बभूव ह ॥ 2 ॥

4.28.s:
kutūhalaṃ bhavati me idaṃ śrotuṃ navaṃ navam ..
kathayasva mahābhāga puṇyaśravaṇakīrtana .. 3 ..
4.28.d:
कुतूहलं भवति मे इदं श्रोतुं नवं नवम् ॥
कथयस्व महाभाग पुण्यश्रवणकीर्तन ॥ 3 ॥

4.28.s:
kathā purāṇasārāṇāṃ rāsayātrā hareraho ..
harilīlāḥ pṛthivyāṃ tu sarvāḥ pratimanoharāḥ .. 4 ..
4.28.d:
कथा पुराणसाराणां रासयात्रा हरेरहो ॥
हरिलीलाः पृथिव्यां तु सर्वाः प्रतिमनोहराः ॥ 4 ॥

4.28.s:
sūta uvāca ..
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ..
prahasya suprasannāsyaḥ pravaktumupacakrame .. 5 ..
4.28.d:
सूत उवाच ॥
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ऋषिर्नारायणः स्वयम् ॥
प्रहस्य सुप्रसन्नास्यः प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमे ॥ 5 ॥

4.28.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
ekadā śrīharirnaktaṃ vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau ..
śubhe śuklatrayodaśyāṃ pūrṇe candrodaye mune .. 6 ..
4.28.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
एकदा श्रीहरिर्नक्तं वनं वृन्दावनं ययौ ॥
शुभे शुक्लत्रयोदश्यां पूर्णे चन्द्रोदये मुने ॥ 6 ॥

4.28.s:
yūthikāmālatīkundamādhavīpuṣpavāyunā ..
vāsitaṃ kalanādena madhubhrāṇāṃ manoharam .. 7 ..
4.28.d:
यूथिकामालतीकुन्दमाधवीपुष्पवायुना ॥
वासितं कलनादेन मधुभ्राणां मनोहरम् ॥ 7 ॥

4.28.s:
navapallavasaṃyuktaṃ puṃskokilarutaśrutam ..
navalakṣarāsavāsasaṃyuktaṃ sumanoharam .. 8 ..
4.28.d:
नवपल्लवसंयुक्तं पुंस्कोकिलरुतश्रुतम् ॥
नवलक्षरासवाससंयुक्तं सुमनोहरम् ॥ 8 ॥

4.28.s:
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumena suvāsitam ..
karpūrānvitatāmbūlabhogadravyasamanvitam ..9 ..
4.28.d:
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुंकुमेन सुवासितम् ॥
कर्पूरान्वितताम्बूलभोगद्रव्यसमन्वितम् ॥9 ॥

4.28.s:
prasūnaiścampakānāṃ ca kastūrīcandanānvitaiḥ..
ratiyogyairviracitairnānātalpaiḥ suśobhitam .. 4.28.10 ..
4.28.d:
प्रसूनैश्चम्पकानां च कस्तूरीचन्दनान्वितैः॥
रतियोग्यैर्विरचितैर्नानातल्पैः सुशोभितम् ॥ 4.28.10 ॥

4.28.s:
dīptaṃ ratnapradīpaiśca dhūpena surabhīkṛtam ..
nānāpuṣpaiśca racitaṃ mālājālairvirājitam .. 11 ..
4.28.d:
दीप्तं रत्नप्रदीपैश्च धूपेन सुरभीकृतम् ॥
नानापुष्पैश्च रचितं मालाजालैर्विराजितम् ॥ 11 ॥

4.28.s:
parito vartulākāraṃ tatraiva rāsamaṇḍalam ..
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumena susaṃskṛtam .. 12..
4.28.d:
परितो वर्तुलाकारं तत्रैव रासमण्डलम् ॥
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुंकुमेन सुसंस्कृतम् ॥ 12॥
4.28.m: Splendidly adorned with sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and saffron,

4.28.s:
puṣpodyānaiḥ puṣpitaiśca yuktakrīḍāsarovaraiḥ..
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇairjalakukkuṭakūjitaiḥ .. 13 ..
4.28.d:
पुष्पोद्यानैः पुष्पितैश्च युक्तक्रीडासरोवरैः॥
हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णैर्जलकुक्कुटकूजितैः ॥ 13 ॥
4.28.m:
Joined with flowering pleasure gardens and sporting lakes,
Teeming with swans and kāraṇḍava ducks, ringing with the calls of water hens,

4.28.s:
krīḍanīyaiḥ sundaraiśca surataśramahāribhiḥ ..
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśatoyapūrṇaiḥ sunirmalaiḥ .. 14..
4.28.d:
क्रीडनीयैः सुन्दरैश्च सुरतश्रमहारिभिः ॥
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशतोयपूर्णैः सुनिर्मलैः ॥ 14॥
4.28.m:
Beautiful for sporting, dispelling the fatigue of lovemaking,
Very clear, filled with waters resembling pure crystal.

4.28.s:
dadhipūrṇaśukladhānyajalairnirmañchanīkṛtam ..
rambhāstambhasamūhena sundareṇa suśobhitam .. 15 ..
4.28.d:
दधिपूर्णशुक्लधान्यजलैर्निर्मञ्छनीकृतम् ॥
रम्भास्तम्भसमूहेन सुन्दरेण सुशोभितम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.28.m:
It was consecrated with water, white grain, and curd,
Splendidly adorned with a handsome cluster of banana trunks,

4.28.s:
āmrapallavayuktena sūtrabandhena cāruṇā ..
bhūṣitaṃ maṃgalaghaṭaiḥ sindūracandanānvitaiḥ..16..
4.28.d:
आम्रपल्लवयुक्तेन सूत्रबन्धेन चारुणा ॥
भूषितं मंगलघटैः सिन्दूरचन्दनान्वितैः॥16॥
4.28.m:
With lovely string-bindings holding mango sprouts,
And decorated with auspicious pitchers bearing vermilion and sandalwood.

4.28.s:
mālatīmālyasaṃyuktairnārikelaphalānvitaiḥ..
sa rāsamaṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭvā jahāsa madhusūdanaḥ..17..
4.28.d:
मालतीमाल्यसंयुक्तैर्नारिकेलफलान्वितैः॥
स रासमण्डलं दृष्ट्वा जहास मधुसूदनः॥17॥
4.28.m:
with garlands of jasmine and adorned with coconuts.
Beholding the circular arena of the dance, Madhusūdana laughed,

4.28.s:
cakāra tatra kutukādvinodamuralīravam ..
gopīnāṃ kāmukīnāṃ ca kāmavardhanakāraṇam .. 18 ..
4.28.d:
चकार तत्र कुतुकाद्विनोदमुरलीरवम् ॥
गोपीनां कामुकीनां च कामवर्धनकारणम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.28.m:
and out of playfulness produced there the delightful sound of his flute,
which caused passion to swell in the longing cowherd women.

4.28.s:
tacchrutvā rādhikā sadyo mumoha madanāturā ..
babhūva sthāṇuvaddehā dhyānaikatānamānasā .. 19 ..
4.28.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राधिका सद्यो मुमोह मदनातुरा ॥
बभूव स्थाणुवद्देहा ध्यानैकतानमानसा ॥ 19 ॥
4.28.m:
Hearing that, Rādhikā immediately swooned, overcome by love;
her body stood motionlessly like a post, her mind intent on meditation alone.

4.28.s:
kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya punaḥ śuśrāva sā dhvanim ..
uvāsa sā samuttasthau samudvignā punaḥ punaḥ .. 4.28.20 ..
4.28.d:
क्षणेन चेतनां प्राप्य पुनः शुश्राव सा ध्वनिम् ॥
उवास सा समुत्तस्थौ समुद्विग्ना पुनः पुनः ॥ 4.28.20 ॥
4.28.m:
Regaining consciousness in an instant, she heard the sound once more;
she sat down and stood up, again and again in great agitation.

4.28.s:
tyaktvā cāvaśyakaṃ karma niḥsasāra drutaṃ gṛhāt ..
yayau tadanusāreṇa prasamīkṣya caturdiśam .. 21 ..
4.28.d:
त्यक्त्वा चावश्यकं कर्म निःससार द्रुतं गृहात् ॥
ययौ तदनुसारेण प्रसमीक्ष्य चतुर्दिशम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.28.m:
Abandoning required household duties, she rushed quickly from her house;
she went toward the sound, looking attentively in all four directions,

4.28.s:
dhyāyantī caraṇāmbhojaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ ..
tejasā ca dyotayantī sadratnasārabhūṣataiḥ .. 22 ..
4.28.d:
ध्यायन्ती चरणाम्भोजं श्रीकृष्णस्य महात्मनः ॥
तेजसा च द्योतयन्ती सद्रत्नसारभूषतैः ॥ 22 ॥
4.28.m:
meditating upon the lotus feet of the great-souled Śrī Kṛṣṇa,
and illuminating [the way] with her radiance and ornaments of excellent jewels.

4.28.s:
bahirbabhūvustāstrastā vareṇa hṛtacetanāḥ ..
kuladharmaṃ parityajya niśaṃkāḥ kāmamohitāḥ .. 23 ..
4.28.d:
बहिर्बभूवुस्तास्त्रस्ता वरेण हृतचेतनाः ॥
कुलधर्मं परित्यज्य निशंकाः काममोहिताः ॥ 23 ॥
4.28.m:
Alarmed, their minds captivated by the sound, they came outside,
abandoning family duty, fearless, bewitched by love.

4.28.s:
trayastriṃśadvayasyāśca tāḥ suśīlādayaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
rādhikāyāḥ priyatamā gopīnāṃ pravarā yayuḥ ..24..
4.28.d:
त्रयस्त्रिंशद्वयस्याश्च ताः सुशीलादयः स्मृताः ॥
राधिकायाः प्रियतमा गोपीनां प्रवरा ययुः ॥24॥
4.28.m:
The thirty-three companions known as Suśīlā and the others,
dearest to Rādhikā and foremost among the cowherd women, went forth.

4.28.s:
tāsāṃ paścādyayurgopyastāsāṃ saṃkhyā nibodha me..
samā veṣeṇa vayasā rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca ..25..
4.28.d:
तासां पश्चाद्ययुर्गोप्यस्तासां संख्या निबोध मे॥
समा वेषेण वयसा रूपेण च गुणेन च ॥25॥
4.28.m:
Behind them went cowherd women; hear their number from me,
equal [to them] in dress, age, beauty, and virtue.

4.28.s:
yayuḥ suśīlāsaṃgena sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ..
yayuścandramukhī paścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa .. 26 ..
4.28.d:
ययुः सुशीलासंगेन सहस्राणि च षोडश ॥
ययुश्चन्द्रमुखी पश्चात्सहस्राणि च षोडश ॥ 26 ॥
4.28.m:
Sixteen thousand went in the company of Suśīlā;
behind Candramukhī went sixteen thousand.

4.28.s:
ekādaśasahasrāṇi mādhavyālyaśca niryayuḥ ..
jagmuḥ kadambamālālyaḥ sa sahasrāṇi trayodaśa ..27..
4.28.d:
एकादशसहस्राणि माधव्याल्यश्च निर्ययुः ॥
जग्मुः कदम्बमालाल्यः स सहस्राणि त्रयोदश ॥27॥
4.28.m:
Eleven thousand companions of Mādhavī went out;
the companions of Kadambamālā went, thirteen thousand in number.

4.28.s:
yayuḥ kuntīvayasyāśca sahasrāṇi daśa smṛtāḥ ..
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi yayustā yamunānugāḥ ..28..
4.28.d:
ययुः कुन्तीवयस्याश्च सहस्राणि दश स्मृताः ॥
चतुर्दश सहस्राणि ययुस्ता यमुनानुगाः ॥28॥
4.28.m:
The companions of Kuntī went, recorded as ten thousand;
fourteen thousand went following Yamunā.

4.28.s:
jāhnavīsahacāriṇyaḥ sahasrāṇi yayurnava ..
yayurnavasahasrāṇi padmamukhyālya eva ca ..29..
4.28.d:
जाह्नवीसहचारिण्यः सहस्राणि ययुर्नव ॥
ययुर्नवसहस्राणि पद्ममुख्याल्य एव च ॥29॥
4.28.m:
Nine thousand companions went along with Jāhnavī;
and nine thousand went who were companions of Padmamukhī.

4.28.s:
sāvitryālyaḥ paṃcadaśa sahasrāṇi yayurvrajāt ..
pārijātāvayasyāśca sahasrāṇi yayurdaśa ..4.28.30..
4.28.d:
सावित्र्याल्यः पंचदश सहस्राणि ययुर्व्रजात् ॥
पारिजातावयस्याश्च सहस्राणि ययुर्दश ॥4.28.30॥
4.28.m:
Fifteen thousand companions of Sāvitrī went forth from Vraja;
ten thousand companions went along with Pārijātā.

4.28.s:
svayaṃprabhānugāḥ sapta sahasrāṇi yayurvrajāt ..
yayuḥ sudhāmukhīgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ..31..
4.28.d:
स्वयंप्रभानुगाः सप्त सहस्राणि ययुर्व्रजात् ॥
ययुः सुधामुखीगोप्यः सहस्राणि चतुर्दश ॥31॥
4.28.m:
Seven thousand followers of Svayaṃprabhā went forth from Vraja;
fourteen thousand cowherd women went with Sudhāmukhī.

4.28.s:
śubhānugā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ..
padmānugā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ..32..
4.28.d:
शुभानुगा ययुर्गोप्यः सहस्राणि चतुर्दश ॥
पद्मानुगा ययुर्गोप्यः सहस्राणि चतुर्दश ॥32॥
4.28.m:
Fourteen thousand cowherd women went following Śubhā;
fourteen thousand cowherd women went following Padmā.

4.28.s:
gaurī padmā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ..
yayuḥ sarvamaṅgalālyaḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ..33..
4.28.d:
गौरी पद्मा ययुर्गोप्यः सहस्राणि चतुर्दश ॥
ययुः सर्वमङ्गलाल्यः सहस्राणि च षोडश ॥33॥
4.28.m:
Fourteen thousand cowherd women went with Gaurī Padmā;
sixteen thousand companions of Sarvamaṅgalā went.

4.28.s:
kālikālyo yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ..
niryayuḥ kamalālyaśca sahasrāṇi trayodaśa .. 34 ..
4.28.d:
कालिकाल्यो ययुर्गोप्यः सहस्राणि च षोडश ॥
निर्ययुः कमलाल्यश्च सहस्राणि त्रयोदश ॥ 34 ॥
4.28.m:
Sixteen thousand cowherd women went as companions of Kālikā;
thirteen thousand companions of Kamalā went out.

4.28.s:
durgānugā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ..
yayuḥ sarasvatīpaścātsahasrāṇi trayodaśa .. 35 ..
4.28.d:
दुर्गानुगा ययुर्गोप्यः सहस्राणि च षोडश ॥
ययुः सरस्वतीपश्चात्सहस्राणि त्रयोदश ॥ 35 ॥
4.28.m:
Sixteen thousand cowherd women went following Durgā;
thirteen thousand went behind Sarasvatī.

4.28.s:
prajagmurbhāratīpaścātsahasrāṇi daśa vrajāt ..
aparṇāsahacāriṇyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa .. 36 ..
4.28.d:
प्रजग्मुर्भारतीपश्चात्सहस्राणि दश व्रजात् ॥
अपर्णासहचारिण्यः सहस्राणि चतुर्दश ॥ 36 ॥
4.28.m:
Ten thousand went from Vraja behind Bhāratī;
fourteen thousand were the companions of Aparṇā.

4.28.s:
ratipaścādvayasyāśca sahasrāṇi yayurdaśa ..
gaṅgāvayasyāḥ prayayuḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa .. 37 ..
4.28.d:
रतिपश्चाद्वयस्याश्च सहस्राणि ययुर्दश ॥
गङ्गावयस्याः प्रययुः सहस्राणि चतुर्दश ॥ 37 ॥
4.28.m:
Ten thousand companions went behind Rati;
fourteen thousand companions went along with Gaṅgā.

4.28.s:
prajagmurambikāpaścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ..
satīpaścādyayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi trayodaśa ..38..
4.28.d:
प्रजग्मुरम्बिकापश्चात्सहस्राणि च षोडश ॥
सतीपश्चाद्ययुर्गोप्यः सहस्राणि त्रयोदश ॥38॥
4.28.m:
Sixteen thousand went behind Ambikā;
thirteen thousand cowherd women went behind Satī.

4.28.s:
nandinīsahacāriṇyaḥ sahasrāṇi yayurdaśa ..
prayayuḥ sundarīpaścātsahasrāṇi trayodaśa. ..39..
4.28.d:
नन्दिनीसहचारिण्यः सहस्राणि ययुर्दश ॥
प्रययुः सुन्दरीपश्चात्सहस्राणि त्रयोदश॥.39॥
4.28.m:
Ten thousand companions went with Nandinī;
thirteen thousand went behind Sundarī.

4.28.s:
yayuḥ kṛṣṇapriyāpaścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ..
yayurmadhumatīpaścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa..4.28.40..
4.28.d:
ययुः कृष्णप्रियापश्चात्सहस्राणि च षोडश ॥
ययुर्मधुमतीपश्चात्सहस्राणि च षोडश॥4.28.40॥
4.28.m:
Sixteen thousand went behind Kṛṣṇapriyā;
sixteen thousand went behind Madhumatī.

4.28.s:
yayuścampānugā gopyaḥ sahasrāṇi trayodaśa ..
candanālyo yayuḥ paścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa .. 41..
4.28.d:
ययुश्चम्पानुगा गोप्यः सहस्राणि त्रयोदश ॥
चन्दनाल्यो ययुः पश्चात्सहस्राणि च षोडश ॥ 41॥
4.28.m:
Thirteen thousand cowherd women went following Campā;
sixteen thousand companions of Candanā went behind.

4.28.s:
sarvā babhūvurekatra tatra tasthuḥ palaṃ mudā ..
tatrāyayurgopikāśca mālāhastāśca kāścana .. 42 ..
4.28.d:
सर्वा बभूवुरेकत्र तत्र तस्थुः पलं मुदा ॥
तत्राययुर्गोपिकाश्च मालाहस्ताश्च काश्चन ॥ 42 ॥
4.28.m:
They all came together in one place and stood there for a moment with joy.
And some cowherd women arrived there with garlands in their hands;

4.28.s:
cārucandanahastāśca kāścittatrāyayurvrajāt ..
śvetacāmarahastāśca kāścittatrāyayurmudā .. 43 ..
4.28.d:
चारुचन्दनहस्ताश्च काश्चित्तत्राययुर्व्रजात् ॥
श्वेतचामरहस्ताश्च काश्चित्तत्राययुर्मुदा ॥ 43 ॥
4.28.m:
some arrived there from Vraja with lovely sandalwood paste in their hands;
some arrived there joyfully with white fly-whisks in their hands;

4.28.s:
tatrāyayurgopakanyāḥ kāścitkastūrikākarāḥ ..
tatrāyayurgopakanyāḥ kāścitkuṃkumavāhikāḥ .. 44 ..
4.28.d:
तत्राययुर्गोपकन्याः काश्चित्कस्तूरिकाकराः ॥
तत्राययुर्गोपकन्याः काश्चित्कुंकुमवाहिकाः ॥ 44 ॥
4.28.m:
some cowherd maidens arrived there holding musk in their hands;
some cowherd maidens arrived there carrying saffron;

4.28.s:
kāścittatrāyayugopyastāmbūlapātravāhikāḥ ..
yāvatkāñcanavastrāṇāṃ vāhikā gopakanyakāḥ ..
kāścittatrāyayuḥ śīghraṃ yatra candrāvalī mudā..45..
4.28.d:
काश्चित्तत्राययुगोप्यस्ताम्बूलपात्रवाहिकाः ॥
यावत्काञ्चनवस्त्राणां वाहिका गोपकन्यकाः ॥
काश्चित्तत्राययुः शीघ्रं यत्र चन्द्रावली मुदा॥45॥
4.28.m:
some cowherd women arrived there carrying vessels of betel.
Cowherd maidens carrying as many golden garments [as needed],
and some [others], came there quickly with joy to where Candrāvalī was.

4.28.s:
sarvāścaikatra saṃbhūya sasmitāśca mudānvitāḥ ..
vidhāya rādhikāveṣaṃ sthānācca prayayurmudā..46..
4.28.d:
सर्वाश्चैकत्र संभूय सस्मिताश्च मुदान्विताः ॥
विधाय राधिकावेषं स्थानाच्च प्रययुर्मुदा॥46॥
4.28.m:
All assembling together in one place, smiling and filled with joy,
having adorned Rādhikā, they set out joyfully from that place.

4.28.s:
cakruḥ punaḥ punastāśca hariśabdajapaṃ pathi ..
prāpurvṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ dadṛśū rāsamaṇḍalam..47..
4.28.d:
चक्रुः पुनः पुनस्ताश्च हरिशब्दजपं पथि ॥
प्रापुर्वृन्दावनं रम्यं ददृशू रासमण्डलम्॥47॥
4.28.m:
Again and again on the path, they recited the name of Hari.
They reached delightful Vṛndāvana and saw the rāsa circle,

4.28.s:
svargebhyaḥ sundaraṃ dṛśyaṃ rākāpatikarānvitam ..
sunirjanaṃ kusumitaṃ vāsitaṃ puṣpavāyunā..48..
4.28.d:
स्वर्गेभ्यः सुन्दरं दृश्यं राकापतिकरान्वितम् ॥
सुनिर्जनं कुसुमितं वासितं पुष्पवायुना॥48॥
4.28.m:
a sight more beautiful than the heavens, touched by the rays of the full moon,
deeply solitary, blossomed, and perfumed with flower-laden breezes,

4.28.s:
nārīṇāṃ kāmajananaṃ munimohanakāraṇam ..
śuśruvustatra tāḥ sarvāḥ puṃskokilakaladhvanim .. 49 ..
4.28.d:
नारीणां कामजननं मुनिमोहनकारणम् ॥
शुश्रुवुस्तत्र ताः सर्वाः पुंस्कोकिलकलध्वनिम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.28.m:
awakening desire in women, an enchantment to sages.
There they all heard the melodious notes of male cuckoos,

4.28.s:
atisūkṣmakalaṃ cātibhramarāṇāṃ manoharam ..
prasūnamadhumattānāṃ bhramarīsaṅgasaṅginām ..4.28.50 ..
4.28.d:
अतिसूक्ष्मकलं चातिभ्रमराणां मनोहरम् ॥
प्रसूनमधुमत्तानां भ्रमरीसङ्गसङ्गिनाम् ॥4.28.50 ॥
4.28.m:
and the exquisite, subtle humming of black bees,
intoxicated with floral honey and sporting with female bees.

4.28.s:
śubhe kṣaṇe praviveśa rādhikā rāsamaṇḍalam ..
sarvābhirālibhiḥ sārdhaṃ dhyātvā kṛṣṇapadāmbujam .. 51 ..
4.28.d:
शुभे क्षणे प्रविवेश राधिका रासमण्डलम् ॥
सर्वाभिरालिभिः सार्धं ध्यात्वा कृष्णपदाम्बुजम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.28.m:
At an auspicious moment, Rādhikā entered the rāsa circle
along with all her companions, meditating on Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet.

4.28.s:
rādhāmārāttu saṃvīkṣya kṛṣṇastatra mudā'nvitaḥ ..
jagāmānuvrajanprītyā sasmito madanāturaḥ .. 52 ..
4.28.d:
राधामारात्तु संवीक्ष्य कृष्णस्तत्र मुदाऽन्वितः ॥
जगामानुव्रजन्प्रीत्या सस्मितो मदनातुरः ॥ 52 ॥
4.28.m:
Beholding Rādhā from afar, Kṛṣṇa was filled with joy;
smiling and overcome with love, he went toward her with affection.

4.28.s:
madhyasthāṃ sakhisaṅghānāṃ ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitām ..
divyavastraparīdhānāṃ sasmitāṃ vakralocanām.. 53 ..
4.28.d:
मध्यस्थां सखिसङ्घानां रत्नालङ्कारभूषिताम् ॥
दिव्यवस्त्रपरीधानां सस्मितां वक्रलोचनाम्॥ 53 ॥
4.28.m:
[She stood] in the midst of the circle of companions, adorned with jewelled ornaments,
wearing celestial garments, smiling, with sidelong glances,

4.28.s:
gajendragāminīṃ ramyāṃ munimānasamohinīm..
navīnaveṣavayasā rūpeṇātimanoharām ..54..
4.28.d:
गजेन्द्रगामिनीं रम्यां मुनिमानसमोहिनीम्॥
नवीनवेषवयसा रूपेणातिमनोहराम् ॥54॥
4.28.m:
walking like a noble elephant, lovely, bewitching the minds of sages,
exceedingly charming with her fresh dress, youth, and beauty,

4.28.s:
talaśroṇinitambānāṃ bhāraśeṣānvitāṃ parām ..
cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ śaraccandranibhānanām ..
bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam .. 55 ..
4.28.d:
तलश्रोणिनितम्बानां भारशेषान्वितां पराम् ॥
चारुचम्पकवर्णाभां शरच्चन्द्रनिभाननाम् ॥
बिभ्रतीं कबरीभारं मालतीमाल्यसंयुतम् ॥ 55 ॥
4.28.m:
peerless, carrying the splendid burden of her hips and buttocks,
radiant with the hue of lovely campaka flowers, her face resembling the autumn moon,

4.28.s:
rādhā dadarśa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram ..
navayauvanasaṃpannaṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitam .. .. 56 ..
4.28.d:
राधा ददर्श श्रीकृष्णं किशोरं श्यामसुन्दरम् ॥
नवयौवनसंपन्नं रत्नाभरणभूषितम् ॥ ॥ 56 ॥
4.28.m: endowed with fresh youth, adorned with jewelled ornaments,

4.28.s:
kandarpakoṭilāvaṇyalīlādhāma manoharam ..
prāṇādhikāṃ tāṃ paśyantīṃ paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā .. 97 ..
4.28.d:
कन्दर्पकोटिलावण्यलीलाधाम मनोहरम् ॥
प्राणाधिकां तां पश्यन्तीं पश्यन्तीं वक्रचक्षुषा ॥ 97 ॥
4.28.m: looking with slanted eyes upon her, who was dearer to him than life.

4.28.s:
paramādbhutarūpaṃ ca sarvatrānupamaṃ param ..
vicitraveṣaṃ cūḍāṃ ca bibhrataṃ sasmitaṃ mudā .. 58 ..
4.28.d:
परमाद्भुतरूपं च सर्वत्रानुपमं परम् ॥
विचित्रवेषं चूडां च बिभ्रतं सस्मितं मुदा ॥ 58 ॥
4.28.m:
Possessing a form exceedingly wondrous and universally incomparable,
wearing variegated dress and a crest, he smiled with delight.

4.28.s:
vakralocanakoṇena darśaṃdarśaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..
mukhamācchādayāñcakre vrīḍayā sasmitā satī .. 59 ..
4.28.d:
वक्रलोचनकोणेन दर्शंदर्शं पुनःपुनः ॥
मुखमाच्छादयाञ्चक्रे व्रीडया सस्मिता सती ॥ 59 ॥
4.28.m:
Looking at him again and again with the corner of her slanted eyes,
the virtuous lady covered her face in modesty, smiling.

4.28.s:
mūrcchāmavāpa sā sadyaḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ..
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgī babhūva hatacetanā .. 4.28.60 ..
4.28.d:
मूर्च्छामवाप सा सद्यः कामबाणप्रपीडिता ॥
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वाङ्गी बभूव हतचेतना ॥ 4.28.60 ॥
4.28.m:
Afflicted by the arrows of love, she instantly swooned;
with horripilation across all her limbs, she lost consciousness.

4.28.s:
kaṭākṣakāmabāṇaiśca viddhaḥ krīḍārasonmukhaḥ ..
mūrcchāṃ prāpya na papāta tasthau sthāṇusamo hariḥ ..61..
4.28.d:
कटाक्षकामबाणैश्च विद्धः क्रीडारसोन्मुखः ॥
मूर्च्छां प्राप्य न पपात तस्थौ स्थाणुसमो हरिः ॥61॥
4.28.m:
Pierced by the arrows of love from her sidelong glances, eager for the rasa of amorous play,
Hari fell into a faint, yet did not fall: he stood still like a tree trunk.

4.28.s:
papāta muralī tasya krīḍākamalamujjvalam ..
dvitīyaṃ pītavastraṃ ca śikhipicchaṃ śarīrataḥ ..62..
4.28.d:
पपात मुरली तस्य क्रीडाकमलमुज्ज्वलम् ॥
द्वितीयं पीतवस्त्रं च शिखिपिच्छं शरीरतः ॥62॥
4.28.m:
From his body dropped his flute, his bright toy lotus,
his upper yellow garment, and his peacock feather.

4.28.s:
kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya yayau rādhāntikaṃ mudā ..
kṛtvā vakṣasi tāṃ prītyā samāśliṣya cucumba saḥ .. 63 ..
4.28.d:
क्षणेन चेतनां प्राप्य ययौ राधान्तिकं मुदा ॥
कृत्वा वक्षसि तां प्रीत्या समाश्लिष्य चुचुम्ब सः ॥ 63 ॥
4.28.m:
Regaining consciousness in a moment, he joyfully went up to Rādhā;
holding her to his chest with affection and embracing her, he kissed her.

4.28.s:
śrīkṛṣṇasparśamātreṇa saṃprāpya cetanāṃ satī ..
prāṇādhikaṃ prāṇanāthaṃ samāśliṣya cucumba ha .. 64 ..
4.28.d:
श्रीकृष्णस्पर्शमात्रेण संप्राप्य चेतनां सती ॥
प्राणाधिकं प्राणनाथं समाश्लिष्य चुचुम्ब ह ॥ 64 ॥
4.28.m:
Regaining consciousness merely at Śrī Kṛṣṇa's touch, the virtuous lady
embraced and kissed the lord of her life, who was dearer to her than life itself.

4.28.s:
mano jahāra rādhāyāḥ kṛṣṇastasya ca sā mune ..
jagāma rādhayā sārdhaṃ rasiko ratimandiram .. 65 ..
4.28.d:
मनो जहार राधायाः कृष्णस्तस्य च सा मुने ॥
जगाम राधया सार्धं रसिको रतिमन्दिरम् ॥ 65 ॥
4.28.m:
Kṛṣṇa captivated Rādhā's heart, and she captivated his, O sage.
The connoisseur of rasa went with Rādhā to the chamber of love,

4.28.s:
ratnapradīpasaṃyuktaṃ ratnadarpaṇasaṃyutam ..
cārucampakaśayyābhiścandanāktābhī rājitam .. 66 ..
4.28.d:
रत्नप्रदीपसंयुक्तं रत्नदर्पणसंयुतम् ॥
चारुचम्पकशय्याभिश्चन्दनाक्ताभी राजितम् ॥ 66 ॥
4.28.m:
endowed with jewelled lamps and adorned with jewelled mirrors,
resplendent with lovely beds of campaka flowers anointed with sandalwood paste,

4.28.s:
karpūrānvitatāmbūlairbhogadravyaiḥ samanvitam ..
uvāca rādhayā sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇastatra mudānvitaḥ .. 67 ..
4.28.d:
कर्पूरान्वितताम्बूलैर्भोगद्रव्यैः समन्वितम् ॥
उवाच राधया सार्धं कृष्णस्तत्र मुदान्वितः ॥ 67 ॥
4.28.m:
provided with camphorated betel and articles of enjoyment.
There, filled with joy, Kṛṣṇa spoke with Rādhā.

4.28.s:
rādhayā dattatāmbūlaṃ cakhāda madhusūdanaḥ ..
rāseśvarī kṛṣṇadattaṃ tāmbūlaṃ bubhuje mudā .. 68 ..
4.28.d:
राधया दत्तताम्बूलं चखाद मधुसूदनः ॥
रासेश्वरी कृष्णदत्तं ताम्बूलं बुभुजे मुदा ॥ 68 ॥
4.28.m:
Madhusūdana chewed the betel offered by Rādhā,
and the queen of the rāsa joyfully enjoyed the betel given by Kṛṣṇa.

4.28.s:
dattaṃ carvitatāmbūlaṃ rādhāyai prabhuṇā mudā ..
cakhāda bhaktvā sā tūrṇaṃ prahasya madanāturā .. 69 ..
4.28.d:
दत्तं चर्वितताम्बूलं राधायै प्रभुणा मुदा ॥
चखाद भक्त्वा सा तूर्णं प्रहस्य मदनातुरा ॥ 69 ॥
4.28.m:
The half-chewed betel offered with joy to Rādhā by the lord,
she quickly ate with devotion, laughing, overcome with passion.

4.28.s:
rādhācarvitatāmbūlaṃ yayāce mādhavo mudā ..
na dadau rādhikā bhītā papāta caraṇāmbuje .. 4.28.70 ..
4.28.d:
राधाचर्वितताम्बूलं ययाचे माधवो मुदा ॥
न ददौ राधिका भीता पपात चरणाम्बुजे ॥ 4.28.70 ॥
4.28.m:
Mādhava joyfully begged for the betel chewed by Rādhā;
afraid, Rādhikā did not give it, but fell at his lotus feet.

4.28.s:
etasminnantare tatra sakāmaḥ suratonmukhaḥ ..
suṣvāpa rādhayā sārdhaṃ ratitalpe manohare .. 71 ..
4.28.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र सकामः सुरतोन्मुखः ॥
सुष्वाप राधया सार्धं रतितल्पे मनोहरे ॥ 71 ॥
4.28.m:
Meanwhile, filled with desire and eager for union,
he lay down with Rādhā upon the charming bed of love.

4.28.s:
śṛṅgārāṣṭaprakāraṃ ca viparītādikaṃ vibhuḥ ..
nakhadantakarāṇāṃ ca prahāraṃ ca yathocitam .. 72 ..
4.28.d:
शृङ्गाराष्टप्रकारं च विपरीतादिकं विभुः ॥
नखदन्तकराणां च प्रहारं च यथोचितम् ॥ 72 ॥
4.28.m:
The all-powerful lord performed the eight kinds of lovemaking, including inverted union,
and the appropriate marks of nails, teeth, and hands.

4.28.s:
kāmaśāstreṣu yadgopyaṃ cumbanāṣṭavidhaṃ param ..
kāminīnāṃ manohāri cakāra rasikeśvaraḥ .. 73 ..
4.28.d:
कामशास्त्रेषु यद्गोप्यं चुम्बनाष्टविधं परम् ॥
कामिनीनां मनोहारि चकार रसिकेश्वरः ॥ 73 ॥
4.28.m:
Whatever supreme secret of the eightfold kissing is found in the treatises on love,
which captivates the minds of loving women, the lord of rasikas performed.

4.28.s:
aṅgairaṅgāni pratyaṅgaiḥ pratyaṅgāni smarāturaḥ ..
cakārāśleṣaṇaṃ tatra kāmukīnāṃ sukhāvaham ..74..
4.28.d:
अङ्गैरङ्गानि प्रत्यङ्गैः प्रत्यङ्गानि स्मरातुरः ॥
चकाराश्लेषणं तत्र कामुकीनां सुखावहम् ॥74॥
4.28.m:
Overcome with desire, pressing limb against limb and part against part,
he embraced her there, bringing delight to women in love.

4.28.s:
śṛṅgārakuśalau tau tu kāmaśāstrasupaṇḍitau ..
ratiyuddhavirāmaśca na babhūva dvayorapi .. 75 ..
4.28.d:
शृङ्गारकुशलौ तौ तु कामशास्त्रसुपण्डितौ ॥
रतियुद्धविरामश्च न बभूव द्वयोरपि ॥ 75 ॥
4.28.m:
Skilled in lovemaking and highly versed in the treatises on love,
there was no cessation of the battle of love for either of the two.

4.28.s:
evaṃ gṛhe gṛhe ramye nānāmūrtiṃ vidhāya ca..
reme gopāṅganābhiśca suramye rāsamaṇḍale .. 76 ..
4.28.d:
एवं गृहे गृहे रम्ये नानामूर्तिं विधाय च॥
रेमे गोपाङ्गनाभिश्च सुरम्ये रासमण्डले ॥ 76 ॥
4.28.m:
Thus, assuming manifold forms in house after delightful house,
he dallied with the cowherd women in the enchanting circle of the rāsa dance. // 76

4.28.s:
gopīnāṃ nava lakṣāṇi gopānāṃ ca tathaiva ca ..

4.28.s:

शुशुभे कृष्णदेहश्च यथाऽद्रिर्गैरिकेण च ॥ 113 ॥
4.28.m:
even those to be done for pleasure, the Lord performed beyond them all.
Marked by the lines of the gopīs' bracelets and the red lac from their feet,
Kṛṣṇa's body shone like a mountain marked with red ochre.

4.28.s:
evaṃbhūte pūrṇarāsasaṃbhūte rāsamaṇḍale ..
samājagmuḥ surāḥ sarve sakalatrāśca sānugāḥ .. 114 ..
4.28.d:
एवंभूते पूर्णराससंभूते रासमण्डले ॥
समाजग्मुः सुराः सर्वे सकलत्राश्च सानुगाः ॥ 114 ॥
4.28.m:
When it had thus become a circle of the rāsa-dance born of the complete rāsa,
all the gods arrived, accompanied by their wives and attendants.

4.28.s:
suvarṇasyandanasthāśca kautukātsvagaṇāvṛtāḥ ..
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgāḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ .. 115 ..
4.28.d:
सुवर्णस्यन्दनस्थाश्च कौतुकात्स्वगणावृताः ॥
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वाङ्गाः कामबाणप्रपीडिताः ॥ 115 ॥
4.28.m:
Mounted on golden chariots, surrounded by their hosts out of eager curiosity,
with hair bristling all over their bodies, they were afflicted by the arrows of love.

4.28.s:
ṛṣayo munayaścaiva siddhāśca pitarastathā ..
vidyādharāśca gandharvā yakṣarākṣasakinnarāḥ ..
sastrīkāśca samājagmurdadṛśuśca mudā'nvitāḥ .. 116 ..
4.28.d:
ऋषयो मुनयश्चैव सिद्धाश्च पितरस्तथा ॥
विद्याधराश्च गन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसकिन्नराः ॥
सस्त्रीकाश्च समाजग्मुर्ददृशुश्च मुदाऽन्विताः ॥ 116 ॥
4.28.m:
The ṛṣis and the munis, the siddhas and the ancestors as well,
the vidyādharas, gandharvas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, and kinnaras,
all arrived with their wives and watched, filled with joy.

4.28.s:
divyasyandanamāruhya śātakaumbhavinirmitam ..
suśobhitaṃ ca maṇinā ratnasāraparicchadam .. 117 ..
4.28.d:
दिव्यस्यन्दनमारुह्य शातकौम्भविनिर्मितम् ॥
सुशोभितं च मणिना रत्नसारपरिच्छदम् ॥ 117 ॥
4.28.m:
Having mounted a heavenly chariot fashioned of gold,
handsomely adorned with gems and equipped with the finest jewels,

4.28.s:
vahniśuddhāṃśukenaiva veṣṭitaṃ sumanoharam ..
śvetacāmarayuktaṃ ca sadratnadarpaṇāmbujam .. 118 ..
4.28.d:
वह्निशुद्धांशुकेनैव वेष्टितं सुमनोहरम् ॥
श्वेतचामरयुक्तं च सद्रत्नदर्पणाम्बुजम् ॥ 118 ॥
4.28.m:
enveloped in fire-purified silk, most captivating to the mind,
fitted with white fly-whisks, fine jewels, mirrors, and lotus designs,

4.28.s:
śatacakraṃ citrayuktaṃ manoyāyi manoharam ..
sadratnasāranirmāṇakalaśojjvalaśekharam .. 119 ..
4.28.d:
शतचक्रं चित्रयुक्तं मनोयायि मनोहरम् ॥
सद्रत्नसारनिर्माणकलशोज्ज्वलशेखरम् ॥ 119 ॥
4.28.m:
having a hundred wheels, adorned with pictures, swift as thought, delightful,
its crest radiant with a pinnacle made of the finest gems—

4.28.s:
samājagāma bhagavānpārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ ..
vāmapārśve mahākālo dakṣiṇe nandikeśvaraḥ .. 4.28.120 ..
4.28.d:
समाजगाम भगवान्पार्वत्या सह शंकरः ॥
वामपार्श्वे महाकालो दक्षिणे नन्दिकेश्वरः ॥ 4.28.120 ॥
4.28.m:
the Blessed Śaṅkara arrived together with Pārvatī.
On his left side was Mahākāla, and on his right Nandikeśvara;

4.28.s:
purataḥ kārtikeyaśca svayaṃ devo gaṇeśvaraḥ ..
piṅgalākṣādayaḥ sarve pārṣadāḥ paritastayoḥ .. 121 ..
4.28.d:
पुरतः कार्तिकेयश्च स्वयं देवो गणेश्वरः ॥
पिङ्गलाक्षादयः सर्वे पार्षदाः परितस्तयोः ॥ 121 ॥
4.28.m:
in front was Kārtikeya, and the god Gaṇeśvara himself.
All his attendants, headed by Piṅgalākṣa, were round about the two of them,

4.28.s:
kṣetrapālādayaḥ sarve tathā'ṣṭau bhairaveśvarāḥ ..
vakṣaḥsthalasthitā durgā sasmitā vakralocanā .. 122 ..
4.28.d:
क्षेत्रपालादयः सर्वे तथाऽष्टौ भैरवेश्वराः ॥
वक्षःस्थलस्थिता दुर्गा सस्मिता वक्रलोचना ॥ 122 ॥
4.28.m:
as well as all the Kṣetrapālas and the eight lords of the Bhairavas.
Resting against his chest was Durgā, smiling, with sidelong glances.

4.28.s:
bhāratyā saha brahmā ca śātakaumbharathasthitaḥ..
vāme saptarṣayastasya dakṣiṇe sanakādayaḥ ..123..
4.28.d:
भारत्या सह ब्रह्मा च शातकौम्भरथस्थितः॥
वामे सप्तर्षयस्तस्य दक्षिणे सनकादयः ॥123॥
4.28.m:
And Brahmā arrived with Bhāratī, mounted on a golden chariot;
on his left were the Seven Rṣis, and on his right Sanaka and the others.

4.28.s:
suvarṇasyandanasthaśca dharmaḥ sākṣī ca karmaṇām..
vakṣasthalasthitā tasya mūrtiḥ smerānanā satī .. 124 ..
4.28.d:
सुवर्णस्यन्दनस्थश्च धर्मः साक्षी च कर्मणाम्॥
वक्षस्थलस्थिता तस्य मूर्तिः स्मेरानना सती ॥ 124 ॥
4.28.m:
And mounted on a golden chariot was Dharma, the witness of actions;
resting against his chest was the chaste Mūrti with a smiling face,

4.28.s:
paśyantī pūrṇarāsaṃ ca sakāmā vakralocanā ..
paritaḥ pārṣadāḥ sarve jvalanto brahmatejasā .. 125 ..
4.28.d:
पश्यन्ती पूर्णरासं च सकामा वक्रलोचना ॥
परितः पार्षदाः सर्वे ज्वलन्तो ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥ 125 ॥
4.28.m:
watching the complete rāsa, filled with desire, casting sidelong glances.
All around were his attendants, blazing with the radiance of Brahman.

4.28.s:
śacyā saha mahendraśca rohiṇyā ca kalānidhiḥ ..
svāhā sārddhaṃ svayaṃ vahniḥ sūryaśca saṃjñayā saha .. 126 ..
4.28.d:
शच्या सह महेन्द्रश्च रोहिण्या च कलानिधिः ॥
स्वाहा सार्द्धं स्वयं वह्निः सूर्यश्च संज्ञया सह ॥ 126 ॥
4.28.m:
Great Indra came with Śacī, and the Moon with Rohiṇī;
the Fire god himself with Svāhā, and the Sun with Saṃjñā.

4.28.s:
samājagāma kāmaśca ratiṃ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi ..
sarve grahāśca dikpālā ājagmuḥ sakalatrakāḥ .. 127 ..
4.28.d:
समाजगाम कामश्च रतिं कृत्वा च वक्षसि ॥
सर्वे ग्रहाश्च दिक्पाला आजग्मुः सकलत्रकाः ॥ 127 ॥
4.28.m:
Kāma arrived, holding Rati to his chest;
all the planets and the guardians of the directions came with their wives.

4.28.s:
ākāśasthāśca dadṛśuḥ sarāsaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ..
kecicca mumuhustatra mūrcchāmāpuśca kecana .. 128 ..
4.28.d:
आकाशस्थाश्च ददृशुः सरासं रासमण्डलम् ॥
केचिच्च मुमुहुस्तत्र मूर्च्छामापुश्च केचन ॥ 128 ॥
4.28.m:
Standing in the sky, they beheld the circle of the rāsa-dance along with the rāsa;
some there were infatuated, and some fell into a swoon.

4.28.s:
muhūrtaṃ ca surāḥ sarve sasmitāśca mudā'nvitāḥ..
candanadravavṛṣṭiṃ ca puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca cikṣipuḥ..129..
4.28.d:
मुहूर्तं च सुराः सर्वे सस्मिताश्च मुदाऽन्विताः॥
चन्दनद्रववृष्टिं च पुष्पवृष्टिं च चिक्षिपुः॥129॥
4.28.m:
For a moment, all the gods, smiling and filled with joy,
showered a rain of liquid sandalwood and a rain of flowers.

4.28.s:
kastūrīyuktamālyānāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ cakrurmunīśvarāḥ..
rāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā devapatnyaḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ..4.28.130..
4.28.d:
कस्तूरीयुक्तमाल्यानां वृष्टिं चक्रुर्मुनीश्वराः॥
रासं दृष्ट्वा देवपत्न्यः कामबाणप्रपीडिताः॥4.28.130॥
4.28.m:
The best of munis showered garlands fragrant with musk.
Beholding the rāsa, the wives of the gods were afflicted by the arrows of love.

4.28.s:
sthale ratirasaṃ kṛtvā jagāma yamunājalam ..
rādhayā saha kṛṣṇaśca pūrṇabrahma sanātanaḥ .. 131 ..
4.28.d:
स्थले रतिरसं कृत्वा जगाम यमुनाजलम् ॥
राधया सह कृष्णश्च पूर्णब्रह्म सनातनः ॥ 131 ॥
4.28.m:
Having enjoyed the pleasure of love on land, he entered the waters of the Yamunā—
Kṛṣṇa, the eternal complete Brahman, together with Rādhā.

4.28.s:
gopībhiḥ saha jagmuśca māyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇarūpikāḥ ..
prapīḍitāḥ kāmabāṇaiḥ krīḍāṃ cakrurjale mudā .. 132 ..
4.28.d:
गोपीभिः सह जग्मुश्च मायाः श्रीकृष्णरूपिकाः ॥
प्रपीडिताः कामबाणैः क्रीडां चक्रुर्जले मुदा ॥ 132 ॥
4.28.m:
And illusory forms bearing the form of Śrī Kṛṣṇa went with the gopīs;
afflicted by the arrows of love, they sported joyfully in the water.

4.28.s:
jalaṃ dadau rādhikāyai sakāmo mādhavaḥ svayam ..
dadau sā ca mādhavāya kāmārtāyāñjalitrayam .. 133 ..
4.28.d:
जलं ददौ राधिकायै सकामो माधवः स्वयम् ॥
ददौ सा च माधवाय कामार्तायाञ्जलित्रयम् ॥ 133 ॥
4.28.m:
Mādhava himself, filled with passion, splashed water upon Rādhikā;
and she, afflicted by passion, cast three handfuls of water upon Mādhava.

4.28.s:
vastraṃ jagrāha tasyāśca sā ca nagnā babhūva ha ..
mālāṃ ciccheda kabarīṃ cakāra śithilāṃ hariḥ .. 134 ..
4.28.d:
वस्त्रं जग्राह तस्याश्च सा च नग्ना बभूव ह ॥
मालां चिच्छेद कबरीं चकार शिथिलां हरिः ॥ 134 ॥
4.28.m:
And he seized her garment, so that she became naked;
Hari broke her garland and loosened her braid of hair.

4.28.s:
sindūrapakṣakaṃ luptaṃ veṣaṃ ca jalatāḍanaiḥ ..
bhrūvicitramoṣṭharāgaṃ luptaṃ kajjalalocanam .. 135 ..
4.28.d:
सिन्दूरपक्षकं लुप्तं वेषं च जलताडनैः ॥
भ्रूविचित्रमोष्ठरागं लुप्तं कज्जललोचनम् ॥ 135 ॥
4.28.m:
The red vermilion mark was erased and her adornment [ruined] by splashing water,
the paintings on her eyebrows and her lip rouge were washed away, and the collyrium on her eyes removed.

4.28.s:
tāṃ ca nagnāṃ samāśliṣya nimamajja jale hariḥ ..
prakṛtyā'bhyantare krīḍāṃ sutasthau ca tayā saha ..136..
4.28.d:
तां च नग्नां समाश्लिष्य निममज्ज जले हरिः ॥
प्रकृत्याऽभ्यन्तरे क्रीडां सुतस्थौ च तया सह ॥136॥
4.28.m:
Embracing her who was naked, Hari plunged into the water,
and, by his nature, remained engaged in joyful sport within with her.

4.28.s:
tāṃ ca nagnāṃ darśayitvā gopikāṃ krīḍayā natām ..
sasmitāṃ prerayāmāsa dūrato yamunājale .. 137 ..
4.28.d:
तां च नग्नां दर्शयित्वा गोपिकां क्रीडया नताम् ॥
सस्मितां प्रेरयामास दूरतो यमुनाजले ॥ 137 ॥
4.28.m:
Having displayed the naked cowherd maiden who was bent low in play,
he cast her, smiling, far off into the waters of the Yamunā.

4.28.s:
sā vegena samutthāya balājjagrāha mādhavam..
gṛhītvā muralīṃ kopātprerayāmāsa dūrataḥ .. 138 ..
4.28.d:
सा वेगेन समुत्थाय बलाज्जग्राह माधवम्॥
गृहीत्वा मुरलीं कोपात्प्रेरयामास दूरतः ॥ 138 ॥
4.28.m:
Rising swiftly, she forcibly seized Mādhava;
taking his flute, she threw it far away in anger.

4.28.s:
gṛhītvā pītavasanaṃ taṃ cakāra digambaram ..
vanamālāṃ ca ciccheda dadau toyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ .. 139 ..
4.28.d:
गृहीत्वा पीतवसनं तं चकार दिगम्बरम् ॥
वनमालां च चिच्छेद ददौ तोयं पुनः पुनः ॥ 139 ॥
4.28.m:
Snatching away his yellow garment, she made him sky-clad [naked];
she snapped his forest garland and repeatedly splashed him with water.

4.28.s:
hariṃ punaḥ samākṛṣya preṣayāmāsa pāthasi ..
gabhīre srotasi mune nimamajja jagatpatiḥ .. 4.28.140 ..
4.28.d:
हरिं पुनः समाकृष्य प्रेषयामास पाथसि ॥
गभीरे स्रोतसि मुने निममज्ज जगत्पतिः ॥ 4.28.140 ॥
4.28.m:
Pulling Hari again, she shoved him into the water.
The Lord of the Universe plunged into the deep current, O sage.

4.28.s:
utthāya mādhavaḥ śīghraṃ tāṃ gṛhītvā prahasya ca ..
kṛtvā vakṣasi nagnāṃ ca cucumba ca punaḥpunaḥ..
evaṃ tā mūrtayaḥ sarvā gopībhiḥ saha kautukāt ..
krīḍāṃ vicakruryamunātīranīre manohare .. 142 ..
4.28.d:
उत्थाय माधवः शीघ्रं तां गृहीत्वा प्रहस्य च ॥
कृत्वा वक्षसि नग्नां च चुचुम्ब च पुनःपुनः॥
एवं ता मूर्तयः सर्वा गोपीभिः सह कौतुकात् ॥
क्रीडां विचक्रुर्यमुनातीरनीरे मनोहरे ॥ 142 ॥
4.28.m:
Rising quickly and seizing her, laughing aloud,
Mādhava drew her naked form to his chest and kissed her again and again.
Thus all those forms [of Kṛṣṇa] playfully sport with the cowherd maidens
in the charming waters by the bank of the Yamunā.

4.28.s:
tīraṃ gatvā tayā sārdhaṃ harirnagnaśca magnayā ..
sā taṃ yayāce vasanaṃ sa ca tāṃ sasmitāṃ satīm ..143..
4.28.d:
तीरं गत्वा तया सार्धं हरिर्नग्नश्च मग्नया ॥
सा तं ययाचे वसनं स च तां सस्मितां सतीम् ॥143॥
4.28.m:
Having reached the bank together with her, the naked Hari and she who was immersed,
she begged him for a garment, and he begged that smiling, chaste maiden.

4.28.s:
rādhikāyai dadau vastraṃ ramyāṃ mālāṃ ca mādhavaḥ ..
pradadau haraye vastraṃ vaṃśī rāseśvarī tathā ..144..
4.28.d:
राधिकायै ददौ वस्त्रं रम्यां मालां च माधवः ॥
प्रददौ हरये वस्त्रं वंशी रासेश्वरी तथा ॥144॥
4.28.m:
Mādhava gave a garment and a lovely garland to Rādhikā;
likewise the Queen of the Rāsa gave Hari his garment and flute.

4.28.s:
candanāgurukastūrīṃ sarvāṅge kuṅkumānvitām..
kṛṣṇasya parayā bhaktyā dadau śroṇisthitasya ca .. 145 ..
4.28.d:
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीं सर्वाङ्गे कुङ्कुमान्विताम्॥
कृष्णस्य परया भक्त्या ददौ श्रोणिस्थितस्य च ॥ 145 ॥
4.28.m:
Sandalwood, agallochum, musk, together with saffron, over all his limbs,
she applied with supreme devotion on Kṛṣṇa who was seated on the bank.

4.28.s:
nirmāya cūḍāṃ lalitāṃ kāminīṃ cittamohinīm..
śobhanairmālatīmālyaiścakāra veṣṭanaṃ punaḥ .. 146 ..
4.28.d:
निर्माय चूडां ललितां कामिनीं चित्तमोहिनीम्॥
शोभनैर्मालतीमाल्यैश्चकार वेष्टनं पुनः ॥ 146 ॥
4.28.m:
Having fashioned a charming topknot, delightful and captivating the mind,
she bound it around again with beautiful garlands of jasmine.

4.28.s:
śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāyāśca kabarīṃ sumanoharām ..
kṛtvā kuṇḍalasaṃskāraṃ nirmame patrakāvalīm .. 147 ..
4.28.d:
श्रीकृष्णो राधिकायाश्च कबरीं सुमनोहराम् ॥
कृत्वा कुण्डलसंस्कारं निर्ममे पत्रकावलीम् ॥ 147 ॥
4.28.m:
And Śrī Kṛṣṇa arranged the exceedingly charming hair braid of Rādhikā,
adjusted her earrings, and painted decorative leaf-patterns [upon her].

4.28.s:
dadau lalāṭe sindūraṃ kastūrībindubhiḥ saha ..
tadadhaścandanenduṃ ca susūkṣmaṃ sumanoharam .. 148 ..
4.28.d:
ददौ ललाटे सिन्दूरं कस्तूरीबिन्दुभिः सह ॥
तदधश्चन्दनेन्दुं च सुसूक्ष्मं सुमनोहरम् ॥ 148 ॥
4.28.m:
On her forehead he placed vermilion along with dots of musk,
and beneath it a delicate, most charming crescent of sandalwood.

4.28.s:
nakhāṅgaṃ stanayorūrvorurasyeva ghanaṃ mudā ..
dattvā tāṃ vāsayāmāsa vahniśuddhāṃśukena vai .. 149 ..
4.28.d:
नखाङ्गं स्तनयोरूर्वोरुरस्येव घनं मुदा ॥
दत्त्वा तां वासयामास वह्निशुद्धांशुकेन वै ॥ 149 ॥
4.28.m:
Having joyfully marked nail-prints thickly on her breasts, thighs, and bosom,
he dressed her in a cloth purified by fire.

4.28.s:
candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumānāṃ draveṇa saḥ ..
kṛtvā vakṣasi saṃlipya cucumba ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 4.28.150 ..
4.28.d:
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमानां द्रवेण सः ॥
कृत्वा वक्षसि संलिप्य चुचुम्ब च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥ 4.28.150 ॥
4.28.m:
Having smeared her chest with the liquid paste
of sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and saffron, he kissed her repeatedly.

4.28.s:
punarāśleṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā dadau mālāṃ gale punaḥ ..
bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitāṃ kṛtvā mañjīracaraṇe dadau .. 151 ..
4.28.d:
पुनराश्लेषणं कृत्वा ददौ मालां गले पुनः ॥
भूषणैर्भूषितां कृत्वा मञ्जीरचरणे ददौ ॥ 151 ॥
4.28.m:
Embracing her once more, he placed a garland around her neck again;
having adorned her with ornaments, he placed anklets on her feet.

4.28.s:
alaktakaṃ caraṇayornakheṣu ca dadau punaḥ ..
evaṃ gopāśca gopīnāṃ vidadhau ca pṛthakpṛthak .. 152 ..
4.28.d:
अलक्तकं चरणयोर्नखेषु च ददौ पुनः ॥
एवं गोपाश्च गोपीनां विदधौ च पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 152 ॥
4.28.m:
He also applied red lacquer on her feet and toenails.
In this way the cowherds [manifestations of Kṛṣṇa] attended to each of the cowherd maidens individually.

4.28.s:
punaḥ prajagmustā mattāḥ sundaraṃ rāsamaṇḍalam..
pūrṇenducandrikāyuktaṃ ratiyogyaṃ sunirjanam ..153..
4.28.d:
पुनः प्रजग्मुस्ता मत्ताः सुन्दरं रासमण्डलम्॥
पूर्णेन्दुचन्द्रिकायुक्तं रतियोग्यं सुनिर्जनम् ॥153॥
4.28.m:
Enraptured, they went again to the beautiful rāsa-circle,
which was brightened by the moonlight of the full moon, suitable for lovemaking, and completely secluded,

4.28.s:
mādhavīketakīkundamālatīnāṃ manoharaiḥ ..
campayūthīmallikānāṃ puṣpaiśca surabhīkṛtam .. 154 ..
4.28.d:
माधवीकेतकीकुन्दमालतीनां मनोहरैः ॥
चम्पयूथीमल्लिकानां पुष्पैश्च सुरभीकृतम् ॥ 154 ॥
4.28.m:
perfumed with the delightful blossoms of mādhavī, ketakī, kunda, and mālatī,
and with flowers of campaka, yūthī, and mallikā.

4.28.s:
dṛṣṭvā ca sphuṭitaṃ puṣpaṃ cayanaṃ kartumīśvarī ..
gopīrniyojayāmāsa kautukena ca rādhikā .. 155 ..
4.28.d:
दृष्ट्वा च स्फुटितं पुष्पं चयनं कर्तुमीश्वरी ॥
गोपीर्नियोजयामास कौतुकेन च राधिका ॥ 155 ॥
4.28.m:
Seeing the blossomed flowers, the mistress Rādhikā,
playfully engaged the cowherd maidens in gathering them.

4.28.s:
kāścinniyojayāmāsa mālānirmāṇakarmaṇi ..
kāścittāmbūlasajjeṣu kāściñcandanagharṣaṇe...156..
4.28.d:
काश्चिन्नियोजयामास मालानिर्माणकर्मणि ॥
काश्चित्ताम्बूलसज्जेषु काश्चिञ्चन्दनघर्षणे॥.156॥
4.28.m:
Some she engaged in the work of making garlands,
some in preparing betel, and some in grinding sandalwood.

4.28.s:
mālā candanatāmbūlaṃ gopīdattaṃ ca sundarī ..
dadau kṛṣṇāya saṃprītyā sasmitā vakralocanā ..157..
4.28.d:
माला चन्दनताम्बूलं गोपीदत्तं च सुन्दरी ॥
ददौ कृष्णाय संप्रीत्या सस्मिता वक्रलोचना ॥157॥
4.28.m:
The garland, sandalwood, and betel given by the cowherd maidens, the fair lady,
smiling and with glancing eyes, lovingly offered to Kṛṣṇa.

4.28.s:
kāścinniyojanaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇasaṅgītakarmaṇi ..
mṛdaṅgamurajādīnāṃ vādaneṣu ca kāścana .. 158 ..
4.28.d:
काश्चिन्नियोजनं चक्रुः कृष्णसङ्गीतकर्मणि ॥
मृदङ्गमुरजादीनां वादनेषु च काश्चन ॥ 158 ॥
4.28.m:
Some made arrangements for songs to Kṛṣṇa,
and some in playing mṛdaṅga and muraja drums.

4.28.s:
evaṃ rāse ratiṃ kṛtvā līlayā hariṇā saha ..
vijahāra ca sarvatra nirjaneṣu manoharam .. 159 ..
4.28.d:
एवं रासे रतिं कृत्वा लीलया हरिणा सह ॥
विजहार च सर्वत्र निर्जनेषु मनोहरम् ॥ 159 ॥
4.28.m:
Having thus made love in the rāsa playfully with Hari,
she sported delightfully everywhere in secluded places:

4.28.s:
puṣpodyāneṣu ramyeṣu sarasāṃ ca taṭeṣu ca ..
kandare kandare ramye nadeṣu ca nadīṣu ca .. 4.28.160 ..
4.28.d:
पुष्पोद्यानेषु रम्येषु सरसां च तटेषु च ॥
कन्दरे कन्दरे रम्ये नदेषु च नदीषु च ॥ 4.28.160 ॥
4.28.m:
in beautiful flower gardens, on the banks of lakes,
in charming mountain caves, and by rivers and streams;

4.28.s:
atīva nirjanasthāne śmaśāne girigahvare ..
vāñchiteṣu ca nārīṇāṃ trayastriṃśadvaneṣu ca .. 161 ..
4.28.d:
अतीव निर्जनस्थाने श्मशाने गिरिगह्वरे ॥
वाञ्छितेषु च नारीणां त्रयस्त्रिंशद्वनेषु च ॥ 161 ॥
4.28.m:
in exceedingly secluded places, cremation grounds, mountain clefts,
and in the thirty-three forests desired by women:

4.28.s:
bhāṇḍīre śrīvane ramye kadambakānane tathā ..
tulasīkānane kundavane campakakānane ..162..
4.28.d:
भाण्डीरे श्रीवने रम्ये कदम्बकानने तथा ॥
तुलसीकानने कुन्दवने चम्पककानने ॥162॥
4.28.m:
in Bhāṇḍīra, in the charming Śrīvana, and in the kadamba grove,
in the tulasī grove, the kunda forest, the campaka grove,

4.28.s:
nimbāraṇye madhuvane jambīrakānane tathā ..
nālikeravane pūgavane ca kadalīvane .. 163 ..
4.28.d:
निम्बारण्ये मधुवने जम्बीरकानने तथा ॥
नालिकेरवने पूगवने च कदलीवने ॥ 163 ॥
4.28.m:
in the neem forest, Madhuvana, and the lime grove,
in the coconut forest, the areca palm grove, and the plantain grove,

4.28.s:
badarīkānane bilvavane nāriṅgakānane ..
aśvatthakānane vaṃśavane dāḍimakānane .. 164 ..
4.28.d:
बदरीकानने बिल्ववने नारिङ्गकानने ॥
अश्वत्थकानने वंशवने दाडिमकानने ॥ 164 ॥
4.28.m:
in the jujube grove, the bilva forest, the orange grove,
in the sacred fig grove, the bamboo thicket, and the pomegranate grove.

4.28.s:
mandārakānane tālavane cūtavane tathā ..
ketakīkānane'śokavane kharjūrakānane .. 165 ..
4.28.d:
मन्दारकानने तालवने चूतवने तथा ॥
केतकीकाननेऽशोकवने खर्जूरकानने ॥ 165 ॥
4.28.m:
In the grove of mandāra trees, in the palm forest, and likewise in the mango grove,
in the ketakī forest, in the aśoka grove, and in the date palm grove;

4.28.s:
āmrātakavane jambūgahane śālakānane ..
kaṭake kānane padmavane jātivane mune .. 166 ..
4.28.d:
आम्रातकवने जम्बूगहने शालकानने ॥
कटके कानने पद्मवने जातिवने मुने ॥ 166 ॥
4.28.m:
in the hog plum grove, in the dense rose apple forest, in the sāl forest,
on the ridge, in the woods, in the lotus grove, and in the jasmine grove, O sage,

4.28.s:
nyagrodhagahane ghore tathā śrīkhaṇḍakānane ..
prahṛṣṭakesaravane sarvato'pi vilakṣaṇe .. 167 ..
4.28.d:
न्यग्रोधगहने घोरे तथा श्रीखण्डकानने ॥
प्रहृष्टकेसरवने सर्वतोऽपि विलक्षणे ॥ 167 ॥
4.28.m:
in the dense, formidable banyan thicket, and likewise in the sandalwood grove,
[and] in the joyful kesara grove, remarkable in every way.

4.28.s:
evaṃ reme kautukena kāmāttriṃśaddivāniśam ..
tathā'pi mānasaṃ pūrṇaṃ na ca kiṃcidbabhūva ha .. 168 ..
4.28.d:
एवं रेमे कौतुकेन कामात्त्रिंशद्दिवानिशम् ॥
तथाऽपि मानसं पूर्णं न च किंचिद्बभूव ह ॥ 168 ॥
4.28.m:
Thus he revelled eagerly out of desire for thirty days and nights,
yet the heart was not satisfied in the least.

4.28.s:
na kāminīnāṃ kāmaśca śṛṅgāreṇa nivartate ..
adhikaṃ vardhate śaśvadyathā'gnirghṛtadhārayā .. 169 ..
4.28.d:
न कामिनीनां कामश्च शृङ्गारेण निवर्तते ॥
अधिकं वर्धते शश्वद्यथाऽग्निर्घृतधारया ॥ 169 ॥
4.28.m:
The desire of passionate women is not stilled by lovemaking;
it constantly grows greater, like fire with a stream of clarified butter.

4.28.s:
jagmurdevāḥ svagehaṃ ca devyaśca munayastathā ..
te sarve praśaśaṃsuśca vismayaṃ ca yayurmudā .. 4.28.170 ..
4.28.d:
जग्मुर्देवाः स्वगेहं च देव्यश्च मुनयस्तथा ॥
ते सर्वे प्रशशंसुश्च विस्मयं च ययुर्मुदा ॥ 4.28.170 ॥
4.28.m:
The gods went to their own abode, as did the goddesses and the sages;
they all praised [him] and were filled with wonder and joy.

4.28.s:
gehe gehe nṛpendrāṇāṃ lebhire janma bhārate ..
dagdhāḥ kāmāgnināṃ'śena devyaḥ śṛṅgāralālasāḥ .. 171 ..
4.28.d:
गेहे गेहे नृपेन्द्राणां लेभिरे जन्म भारते ॥
दग्धाः कामाग्निनांऽशेन देव्यः शृङ्गारलालसाः ॥ 171 ॥
4.28.m:
In the houses of royal rulers in Bhārata they took birth,
the goddesses burned by the fire of desire, [born] as portions, longing for lovemaking.

4.29.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
atha gopāṅganāḥ sarvāḥ kāmamattatayā mune ..
atiprauḍhāśca māninyo neśvaraṃ menire patim .. 1 ..
4.29.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
अथ गोपाङ्गनाः सर्वाः काममत्ततया मुने ॥
अतिप्रौढाश्च मानिन्यो नेश्वरं मेनिरे पतिम् ॥ 1 ॥

4.29.s:
kāścidūcuraho kṛṣṇa sasmitā vakralocanāḥ ..
mālatīpuṣpamuttolya dehi me mālikāmiti .. 2 ..
4.29.d:
काश्चिदूचुरहो कृष्ण सस्मिता वक्रलोचनाः ॥
मालतीपुष्पमुत्तोल्य देहि मे मालिकामिति ॥ 2 ॥

4.29.s:
kāścidūcuraye kṛṣṇa svakroḍe'smāṃśca kurviti ..
gṛhītvāśrīhareḥ skandhamāruroha ca kācana .. 3 ..
4.29.d:
काश्चिदूचुरये कृष्ण स्वक्रोडेऽस्मांश्च कुर्विति ॥
गृहीत्वाश्रीहरेः स्कन्धमारुरोह च काचन ॥ 3 ॥

4.29.s:
uvāca kāciddarpeṇa pramattā prāṇavallabham ..
svakīyapītavasanaṃ paridhāraya māmiti ..4..
4.29.d:
उवाच काचिद्दर्पेण प्रमत्ता प्राणवल्लभम् ॥
स्वकीयपीतवसनं परिधारय मामिति ॥4॥

4.29.s:
uvāca kācidīśaṃ taṃ sindūraṃ dehi māmiti ..
uvāca kācitprāṇeśaṃ śīghramāgatya sāmpratam .. 5 ..
4.29.d:
उवाच काचिदीशं तं सिन्दूरं देहि मामिति ॥
उवाच काचित्प्राणेशं शीघ्रमागत्य साम्प्रतम् ॥ 5 ॥

4.29.s:
kṛtvā kuntalasaṃskāraṃ kuru me kabarīmiti ..
kāścitsaṃprerayāmāsuḥ śrīkhaṇḍaṃ ballavāya ca ..6..
4.29.d:
कृत्वा कुन्तलसंस्कारं कुरु मे कबरीमिति ॥
काश्चित्संप्रेरयामासुः श्रीखण्डं बल्लवाय च ॥6॥

4.29.s:
svāṃgaveṣavidhāyinyo bhūṣārthaṃ śrutimūlayoḥ ..
uvāca kācitkāmena paraṃ saṃketapūrvakam .. 7 ..
4.29.d:
स्वांगवेषविधायिन्यो भूषार्थं श्रुतिमूलयोः ॥
उवाच काचित्कामेन परं संकेतपूर्वकम् ॥ 7 ॥

4.29.s:
paśyantī tanmukhāmbhojaṃ sasmitā maithunāya ca ..
kācijjagrāha muralīṃ balādākṛṣya mādhavam .. 8 ..
4.29.d:
पश्यन्ती तन्मुखाम्भोजं सस्मिता मैथुनाय च ॥
काचिज्जग्राह मुरलीं बलादाकृष्य माधवम् ॥ 8 ॥

4.29.s:
jahāra pītavasanaṃ kṛtvā nagnaṃ ca kāminī ..
kāminyaḥ kāścidityūcurmāninyo madhusūdanam .. 9 ..
4.29.d:
जहार पीतवसनं कृत्वा नग्नं च कामिनी ॥
कामिन्यः काश्चिदित्यूचुर्मानिन्यो मधुसूदनम् ॥ 9 ॥

4.29.s:
alaktakadravaṃ dehi pādayornakhareṣu ca ..
uvāca kācitpremṇā taṃ gaṇḍayoḥ stanayormama ..4.29.10..
4.29.d:
अलक्तकद्रवं देहि पादयोर्नखरेषु च ॥
उवाच काचित्प्रेम्णा तं गण्डयोः स्तनयोर्मम ॥4.29.10॥

4.29.s:
nānācitravicitrāḍhyāṃ karu patrāvalīmiti ..
kṛtvā'numānaṃ manasā dṛṣṭvā tāsāṃ pramattatām .. 11 ..
4.29.d:
नानाचित्रविचित्राढ्यां करु पत्रावलीमिति ॥
कृत्वाऽनुमानं मनसा दृष्ट्वा तासां प्रमत्तताम् ॥ 11 ॥

4.29.s:
mādhavo rādhayā sārddhamantardhānaṃ cakāra ha ..
atīva nirjane sthāne mudā svecchāmayo vibhuḥ .. 12 ..
4.29.d:
माधवो राधया सार्द्धमन्तर्धानं चकार ह ॥
अतीव निर्जने स्थाने मुदा स्वेच्छामयो विभुः ॥ 12 ॥

4.29.s:
kalāmānaprakāraṃ ca śṛṃgāraṃ ca cakāra ha ..
parvate parvate ramye dvīpedvīpe sunirjane .. .. 13 ..
4.29.d:
कलामानप्रकारं च शृंगारं च चकार ह ॥
पर्वते पर्वते रम्ये द्वीपेद्वीपे सुनिर्जने ॥ ॥ 13 ॥

4.29.s:
taṭe taṭe nadīnāṃ ca sarvajantuvivarjite ..
śrīgoṣṭhe ratnaśaile ca velāgaṅgātaṭe'pi ca .. 14 ..
4.29.d:
तटे तटे नदीनां च सर्वजन्तुविवर्जिते ॥
श्रीगोष्ठे रत्नशैले च वेलागङ्गातटेऽपि च ॥ 14 ॥

4.29.s:
kālinde ca pulinde ca mandire gandhamādane ..
manohare kundavane kāverītīranīraje .. 15 ..
4.29.d:
कालिन्दे च पुलिन्दे च मन्दिरे गन्धमादने ॥
मनोहरे कुन्दवने कावेरीतीरनीरजे ॥ 15 ॥

4.29.s:
puṣpabhadrāpulinaje puṣpodyāne supuṣpite ..
sarvatra ramaṇaṃ kṛtvā rādhāveṣaṃ vidhāya ca .. 16 ..
4.29.d:
पुष्पभद्रापुलिनजे पुष्पोद्याने सुपुष्पिते ॥
सर्वत्र रमणं कृत्वा राधावेषं विधाय च ॥ 16 ॥

4.29.s:
jagāma malayadroṇīṃ ramyāṃ candanavāyunā ..
śayyāṃ puṣpamayīṃ kṛtvā tatra reme tayā saha .. 17 ..
4.29.d:
जगाम मलयद्रोणीं रम्यां चन्दनवायुना ॥
शय्यां पुष्पमयीं कृत्वा तत्र रेमे तया सह ॥ 17 ॥

4.29.s:
atīva sukhasaṃbhogānmūrcchāṃ saṃprāpya rādhikā ..
kṛtvā vakṣasi govindaṃ pulakāñcitavigrahā ..18..
4.29.d:
अतीव सुखसंभोगान्मूर्च्छां संप्राप्य राधिका ॥
कृत्वा वक्षसि गोविन्दं पुलकाञ्चितविग्रहा ॥18॥

4.29.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ mūrcchitāṃ kṛṣṇo ghanaśroṇipayodharām ..
viluptaveṣāṃ kāmārtāṃ nagnāṃ śithilakuntalām .. 19 ..
4.29.d:
दृष्ट्वा तां मूर्च्छितां कृष्णो घनश्रोणिपयोधराम् ॥
विलुप्तवेषां कामार्तां नग्नां शिथिलकुन्तलाम् ॥ 19 ॥

4.29.s:
cetanāṃ kārayāmāsa kṛtvā vakṣasi tandritām ..
vāsayāmāsa vasanaṃ rādhāyāmekhalāmbaram .. 4.29.20 ..
4.29.d:
चेतनां कारयामास कृत्वा वक्षसि तन्द्रिताम् ॥
वासयामास वसनं राधायामेखलाम्बरम् ॥ 4.29.20 ॥

4.29.s:
kabarīṃ racayāmāsa kiṃcidvāmena vakratām ..
mālatīmālyasaṃyuktāṃ kundapuṣpaiśca veṣṭitām.. .. 21 ..
4.29.d:
कबरीं रचयामास किंचिद्वामेन वक्रताम् ॥
मालतीमाल्यसंयुक्तां कुन्दपुष्पैश्च वेष्टिताम्॥ ॥ 21 ॥

4.29.s:
tasyāḥ kapāle siṃdūratilakaṃ sundaraṃ dadau ..
gaṇḍayoḥ stanayościtrāṃ cakāra patrikāṃ mudā..22 ..
4.29.d:
तस्याः कपाले सिंदूरतिलकं सुन्दरं ददौ ॥
गण्डयोः स्तनयोश्चित्रां चकार पत्रिकां मुदा॥22 ॥

4.29.s:
sālaktakāṃśca nakharāṃścitritānpādapadmayoḥ ..
nakhaiḥ kṛtrimapadmāni nirmame śroṇivakṣasoḥ .. 23 ..
4.29.d:
सालक्तकांश्च नखरांश्चित्रितान्पादपद्मयोः ॥
नखैः कृत्रिमपद्मानि निर्ममे श्रोणिवक्षसोः ॥ 23 ॥

4.29.s:
utthāyātha tayā sārddhaṃ jagāma hi sarovaram ..
nānāprakārapadmānāṃ rājibhiśca virājitam .. 24 ..
4.29.d:
उत्थायाथ तया सार्द्धं जगाम हि सरोवरम् ॥
नानाप्रकारपद्मानां राजिभिश्च विराजितम् ॥ 24 ॥

4.29.s:
nirmalasphaṭikākārajalapūrṇaṃ manoharam ..
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ jalakukkuṭakūjitam ..25..
4.29.d:
निर्मलस्फटिकाकारजलपूर्णं मनोहरम् ॥
हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णं जलकुक्कुटकूजितम् ॥25॥

4.29.s:
madhulubdhamadhughrāṇāṃ padmasthānaṃ supadmajam ..
cāruṇā kalaśabdena śabditaṃ śaśvadeva hi .. 25 ..
4.29.d:
मधुलुब्धमधुघ्राणां पद्मस्थानं सुपद्मजम् ॥
चारुणा कलशब्देन शब्दितं शश्वदेव हि ॥ 25 ॥

4.29.s:
tatra snātvā jalakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha tayā saha ..
jalaṃ dadau rādhikāyai mudā sā mādhavāya ca .. 27 ..
4.29.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा जलक्रीडां चकार ह तया सह ॥
जलं ददौ राधिकायै मुदा सा माधवाय च ॥ 27 ॥

4.29.s:
sahasradalapadme ca gṛhītvā mādhavaḥ svayam..
ekaṃ dadau rādhikāyai rarakṣa svārthamekakam ..28 ..
4.29.d:
सहस्रदलपद्मे च गृहीत्वा माधवः स्वयम्॥
एकं ददौ राधिकायै ररक्ष स्वार्थमेककम् ॥28 ॥

4.29.s:
candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravamīpsitam ..
svāṅgaṃ dattvā rādhikāyai lilepa rādhikeśvaraḥ .. 29..
4.29.d:
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमद्रवमीप्सितम् ॥
स्वाङ्गं दत्त्वा राधिकायै लिलेप राधिकेश्वरः ॥ 29॥

4.29.s:
tato gacchaṃstayā sārddhaṃ dadarśa purato vaṭam ..
atīvottuṅgaśākhāgramativistṛtameva ca .. 4.29.30 ..
4.29.d:
ततो गच्छंस्तया सार्द्धं ददर्श पुरतो वटम् ॥
अतीवोत्तुङ्गशाखाग्रमतिविस्तृतमेव च ॥ 4.29.30 ॥

4.29.s:
mūle yojanaparyantaṃ chāyayā pariveṣṭitam ..
uvāsa tatra govindaḥ ketakīvanasannidhau ..31..
4.29.d:
मूले योजनपर्यन्तं छायया परिवेष्टितम् ॥
उवास तत्र गोविन्दः केतकीवनसन्निधौ ॥31॥

4.29.s:
puṣpāktena suśītena vāyunā surabhīkṛte ..
citraṃ rahasyaṃ suciraṃ purāṇaṃ ca purātanam .. .. 32 ..
4.29.d:
पुष्पाक्तेन सुशीतेन वायुना सुरभीकृते ॥
चित्रं रहस्यं सुचिरं पुराणं च पुरातनम् ॥ ॥ 32 ॥

4.29.s:
praharṣitaśca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kathayāmāsa rādhikām..
etasminnantare tatra dadarśa munipuṃgavam ..33 ..
4.29.d:
प्रहर्षितश्च श्रीकृष्णः कथयामास राधिकाम्॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र ददर्श मुनिपुंगवम् ॥33 ॥

4.29.s:
āgacchantaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā prasannavadanekṣaṇam ..
na dṛṣṭvā hṛdaye rūpamīśasya paramātmanaḥ .. 34 ..
4.29.d:
आगच्छन्तं च तं दृष्ट्वा प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणम् ॥
न दृष्ट्वा हृदये रूपमीशस्य परमात्मनः ॥ 34 ॥
4.29.m:
approaching, with cheerful face and eyes.
No longer seeing within his heart the form of the Lord, the Paramātman,

4.29.s:
dhyānādviratamagre ca paśyantaṃ bahireva tat ..
sarvāvayavavakraṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ sarvadigambaram .. 35 ..
4.29.d:
ध्यानाद्विरतमग्रे च पश्यन्तं बहिरेव तत् ॥
सर्वावयववक्रं च कृष्णं सर्वदिगम्बरम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.29.m:
he had ceased from meditation and was beholding that very form externally before him—
crooked in every limb, dark, entirely sky-clad [naked],

4.29.s:
nāmnā'ṣṭavakraṃ jaṭilaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ..
mukhato'gnimudgirantaṃ taporāśimivotthitam .. 36 ..
4.29.d:
नाम्नाऽष्टवक्रं जटिलं ज्वलन्तं ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥
मुखतोऽग्निमुद्गिरन्तं तपोराशिमिवोत्थितम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.29.m:
named Aṣṭāvakra, with matted hair, blazing with the splendour of Brahman,
as if pouring fire from his mouth, like a mass of ascetic power arisen.

4.29.s:
aho kiṃ vā brahmatejo mūrtimantamiha svayam ..
nakhaśmaśrusudīrghaṃ ca śāṃtaṃ tejasvinaṃ param .. 37 ..
4.29.d:
अहो किं वा ब्रह्मतेजो मूर्तिमन्तमिह स्वयम् ॥
नखश्मश्रुसुदीर्घं च शांतं तेजस्विनं परम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.29.m:
[One might wonder:] Ah, is the splendour of Brahman itself embodied here?
His nails and beard were very long; he was peaceful, supremely radiant,

4.29.s:
puṭāñjaliyutaṃ bhaktyā bhītaṃ praṇatakaṃdharam ..
dṛṣṭvā hasantīṃ rādhāṃ tāṃ vārayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ..38..
4.29.d:
पुटाञ्जलियुतं भक्त्या भीतं प्रणतकंधरम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा हसन्तीं राधां तां वारयामास माधवः ॥38॥
4.29.m:
with folded hands in devotion, fearful, his neck bowed down.
Seeing Rādhā laughing [at him], Mādhava restrained her,

4.29.s:
prabhāvaṃ kathayāmāsa munīndrasya mahātmanaḥ ..
atha praṇamya govindaṃ tuṣṭāva munipuṃgavaḥ ..
yatstotraṃ ca purā dattaṃ śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā .. 39 ..
4.29.d:
प्रभावं कथयामास मुनीन्द्रस्य महात्मनः ॥
अथ प्रणम्य गोविन्दं तुष्टाव मुनिपुंगवः ॥
यत्स्तोत्रं च पुरा दत्तं शंकरेण महात्मना ॥ 39 ॥
4.29.m:
and recounted the power of that great-souled king of sages.
Then, having bowed to Govinda, the eminent sage praised him
with the hymn of praise previously given [to him] by the great-souled Śaṅkara.

4.29.s:
aṣṭāvakra uvāca ..
guṇātīta guṇādhāra guṇabīja guṇātmaka ..
guṇīśa guṇināṃ bīja guṇāyana namo'stu te .. 4.29.40 ..
4.29.d:
अष्टावक्र उवाच ॥
गुणातीत गुणाधार गुणबीज गुणात्मक ॥
गुणीश गुणिनां बीज गुणायन नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 4.29.40 ॥
4.29.m: O Lord of the gunas, seed of those who possess gunas, abode of the gunas, homage to you!

4.29.s:
siddhisvarūpa siddhyeśa siddhibīja parātpara ..
siddhisiddhiguṇādhīśa siddhānāṃ gurave namaḥ .. 41 ..
4.29.d:
सिद्धिस्वरूप सिद्ध्येश सिद्धिबीज परात्पर ॥
सिद्धिसिद्धिगुणाधीश सिद्धानां गुरवे नमः ॥ 41 ॥
4.29.m:
O embodiment of perfection, Lord of perfection, seed of perfection, higher than the highest!
O sovereign Lord of perfection and its qualities, homage to the guru of the perfected ones!

4.29.s:
he vedabīja vedajña vedinvedavidāṃ vara ..
vedājñātādyarūpeśa vedājñeśa namo'stu te.. 42 ..
4.29.d:
हे वेदबीज वेदज्ञ वेदिन्वेदविदां वर ॥
वेदाज्ञाताद्यरूपेश वेदाज्ञेश नमोऽस्तु ते॥ 42 ॥
4.29.m:
O seed of the Vedas, knower of the Vedas, possessing knowledge of the Vedas, best among knowers of the Vedas!
O Lord whose form is unknown to the Vedas, Lord of the injunctions of the Vedas, homage to you!

4.29.s:
brahmānanteśa śeṣendra dharmādīnāmadhīśvara ..
sarva sarveśa śarveśa bījarūpa namo'stu te .. 43 ..
4.29.d:
ब्रह्मानन्तेश शेषेन्द्र धर्मादीनामधीश्वर ॥
सर्व सर्वेश शर्वेश बीजरूप नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 43 ॥
4.29.m:
O Lord of Brahmā and Ananta, supreme Lord of Śeṣa, Indra, Dharma, and the rest!
O All, Lord of all, Lord of Śarva, embodiment of the seed, homage to you!

4.29.s:
prakṛte prākṛta prajña prakṛtīśa parātpara ..
saṃsāravṛkṣa tadbīja phalarūpa namo'stu te .. 44 ..
4.29.d:
प्रकृते प्राकृत प्रज्ञ प्रकृतीश परात्पर ॥
संसारवृक्ष तद्बीज फलरूप नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 44 ॥
4.29.m:
O Prakṛti, knowing Prakṛti, wise one, Lord of Prakṛti, higher than the highest!
O tree of worldly existence, its seed, having the form of its fruit, homage to you!

4.29.s:
sṛṣṭisthityantabījeśa sṛṣṭisthityantakāraṇa ..
mahāvirāṭtarorbīja rādhikeśa namo'stu te .. 45 ..
4.29.d:
सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तबीजेश सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तकारण ॥
महाविराट्तरोर्बीज राधिकेश नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 45 ॥
4.29.m:
O Lord of the seed of creation, preservation, and dissolution, cause of creation, preservation, and dissolution!
O seed of the great Virāj-tree, Lord of Rādhikā, homage to you!

4.29.s:
aho yasya trayaḥ skandhā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ..
śākhāpraśākhā vedādyāstapāṃsi kusumāni ca .. 46 ..
4.29.d:
अहो यस्य त्रयः स्कन्धा ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ॥
शाखाप्रशाखा वेदाद्यास्तपांसि कुसुमानि च ॥ 46 ॥
4.29.m:
Ah, of which tree the three trunks are Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara,
the Vedas and other texts are the branches and twigs, and ascetic practices are the blossoms,

4.29.s:
saṃsāraviphalā eva prakṛtyaṃkurameva ca ..
tadādhāra nirādhāra sarvādhāra namo'stu te .. 47 ..
4.29.d:
संसारविफला एव प्रकृत्यंकुरमेव च ॥
तदाधार निराधार सर्वाधार नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 47 ॥
4.29.m:
while the fruits are the transmigratory states, and Prakṛti is the sprout—
to you who are its support, who are without support, the support of all, homage to you!

4.29.s:
tejorūpa nirākāra pratyakṣānūhameva ca ..
sarvākārātipratyakṣa svecchāmaya namo'stu te .. 48 ..
4.29.d:
तेजोरूप निराकार प्रत्यक्षानूहमेव च ॥
सर्वाकारातिप्रत्यक्ष स्वेच्छामय नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 48 ॥
4.29.m:
O embodiment of light, formless one, perceivable and beyond deduction,
having all forms, most evident, constituted of your own will, homage to you!

4.29.s:
ityuktvā sa muniśreṣṭho nipatya caraṇāmbuje ..
prāṇāṃstatyāja yogena tayoḥ pratyakṣa eva ca .. 49 ..
4.29.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स मुनिश्रेष्ठो निपत्य चरणाम्बुजे ॥
प्राणांस्तत्याज योगेन तयोः प्रत्यक्ष एव च ॥ 49 ॥
4.29.m:
Having spoken thus, that best of sages fell at his lotus feet,
and cast off his life-breaths through yoga right before their eyes.

4.29.s:
papāta tatra taddehaḥ pādapadmasamīpataḥ ..
tattejaśca samuttasthau jvaladagniśikhopamam .. 4.29.50 ..
4.29.d:
पपात तत्र तद्देहः पादपद्मसमीपतः ॥
तत्तेजश्च समुत्तस्थौ ज्वलदग्निशिखोपमम् ॥ 4.29.50 ॥
4.29.m:
His body fell there near the lotus feet,
and his splendour rose up like a blazing flame of fire.

4.29.s:
saptatālapramāṇaṃ tu cotthāya ca papāta ha..
bhrāmaṃ bhrāmaṃ ca parito līnaṃ cābhūtpadāmbuje..51..
4.29.d:
सप्ततालप्रमाणं तु चोत्थाय च पपात ह॥
भ्रामं भ्रामं च परितो लीनं चाभूत्पदाम्बुजे॥51॥
4.29.m:
Rising to the height of seven palm trees, it descended,
and circling round and round, it dissolved into his lotus feet.

4.29.s:
aṣṭāvakrakṛtaṃ stotraṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet ..
paraṃ nirvāṇa mokṣaṃ ca samāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ .. 52 ..
4.29.d:
अष्टावक्रकृतं स्तोत्रं प्रातरुत्थाय यः पठेत् ॥
परं निर्वाण मोक्षं च समाप्नोति न संशयः ॥ 52 ॥
4.29.m:
Whoever rises early in the morning and recites this hymn composed by Aṣṭāvakra
attains supreme Nirvāṇa and liberation—of this there is no doubt. (52)

4.29.s:
prāṇādhiko mumukṣūṇāṃ stotrarājaśca nārada ..
hariṇā'ho purā datto vaikuṇṭhe śaṃkarāya ca .. 53 ..
4.29.d:
प्राणाधिको मुमुक्षूणां स्तोत्रराजश्च नारद ॥
हरिणाऽहो पुरा दत्तो वैकुण्ठे शंकराय च ॥ 53 ॥
4.29.m:
O Nārada, this king of hymns is dearer than life to those desiring liberation;
ah, it was given of old by Hari to Śaṅkara in Vaikuṇṭha. (53)

4.30.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
mahāmune rahasyaṃ ca śrutaṃ brahmankimadbhutam ..
mṛte munau kiṃ cakāra śrīkṛṣṇo bhaktavatsalaḥ .. 1 ..
4.30.d:
॥ नारद उवाच ॥ ॥
महामुने रहस्यं च श्रुतं ब्रह्मन्किमद्भुतम् ॥
मृते मुनौ किं चकार श्रीकृष्णो भक्तवत्सलः ॥ 1 ॥
4.30.m: Nārada said: / O great sage, O Brahman, a secret and wonderful thing has been heard! / When the sage died, what did Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who is affectionate to his devotees, do? (1) / Śrī Nārāyaṇa said: / Seeing the sage dead, Kṛṣṇa prepared to perform the funeral rites; / placing his body upon his chest, he wept aloud like an ordinary man. (2) / Embracing him with both arms, he pressed him tightly out of intense grief; / from the friction of his thunderbolt-like limbs, a heap of ashes poured forth from the corpse. (3) / The body of the great-souled one was devoid of blood, flesh, and bones; / for sixty thousand years, O sage, he had gone without food. (4) / His blood, flesh, and bones had been burned away by the blazing digestive fire, / as he was bereft of external awareness, his mind fixed upon Hari's lotus feet. (5) / Constructing a funeral pyre with sandalwood timber, Madhusūdana, / performing the fire ceremony right there, placed him [upon it] out of sorrow. (6) / He applied fire to the pyre, having laid wood over the corpse, / and as the pyre blazed up, the all-pervading Lord swooned for a moment. (7) / When his body was reduced to ashes, celestial kettledrums sounded in heaven, / and instantly, ah, a shower of flowers fell from the sky. (8) / Meanwhile, right there, an exquisite chariot crafted from the essence of jewels, / moving at the speed of thought, furnished with garments and garlands, (9) / accompanied by foremost attendants of excellent form who resembled Śrī Kṛṣṇa, / appeared from Goloka before Hari. (10) / Quickly alighting from the chariot, the foremost attendants of Hari, / all equal in form, bowed to the two lords of Rādhikā, (11) / caused the lordly sage—who had assumed a subtle body—to bow down, / and placing that body upon the chariot, they went to supreme Goloka. (12) / When the lordly sage had departed for Goloka, the virtuous woman who sports in Vṛndāvana / was filled with astonishment and questioned the Lord of the universe. (13) / Śrī Rādhikā said: / Who is this foremost of sages, O Lord, whose every limb was crooked, / having the form of an extremely dwarfish person, exceedingly fiery yet very hideous? (14)

4.30.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
dṛṣṭvā mṛtaṃ muniṃ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃskāraṃ kartumudyataḥ ..
kṛtvā vakṣasi taddehaṃ rurodoccairyathā naraḥ ..2..
4.30.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
दृष्ट्वा मृतं मुनिं कृष्णः संस्कारं कर्तुमुद्यतः ॥
कृत्वा वक्षसि तद्देहं रुरोदोच्चैर्यथा नरः ॥2॥

4.30.s:
bāhubhyāṃ ca samāśliṣya pipeṣodriktamohataḥ ..
nirgataṃ bhasmanikaraṃ śavādvajrāṃgagharṣaṇāt .. 3 ..
4.30.d:
बाहुभ्यां च समाश्लिष्य पिपेषोद्रिक्तमोहतः ॥
निर्गतं भस्मनिकरं शवाद्वज्रांगघर्षणात् ॥ 3 ॥

4.30.s:
raktamāṃsāsthihīnaṃ taccharīraṃ ca mahātmanaḥ ..
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi nirāhāraḥ kṛto mune .. 4 ..
4.30.d:
रक्तमांसास्थिहीनं तच्छरीरं च महात्मनः ॥
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि निराहारः कृतो मुने ॥ 4 ॥

4.30.s:
dagdhaṃ lohitamāṃsāsthi jvalatā jaṭharāgninā ..
bāhyajñānavihīnasya haripādābjacetasaḥ .. 5 ..
4.30.d:
दग्धं लोहितमांसास्थि ज्वलता जठराग्निना ॥
बाह्यज्ञानविहीनस्य हरिपादाब्जचेतसः ॥ 5 ॥

4.30.s:
citāṃ candanakāṣṭhena nirmāya madhusūdanaḥ ..
kṛtvā'gnikāryaṃ tatraiva sthāpayāmāsa śokataḥ .. 6 ..
4.30.d:
चितां चन्दनकाष्ठेन निर्माय मधुसूदनः ॥
कृत्वाऽग्निकार्यं तत्रैव स्थापयामास शोकतः ॥ 6 ॥

4.30.s:
dadau citāyāmagniṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ dattvā śavopari ..
jvalitāyāṃ citā yāṃ ca mūrcchāmāpa kṣaṇaṃ vibhuḥ ..7..
4.30.d:
ददौ चितायामग्निं च काष्ठं दत्त्वा शवोपरि ॥
ज्वलितायां चिता यां च मूर्च्छामाप क्षणं विभुः ॥7॥

4.30.s:
taddehe bhasmasādbhūte nedurdundubhayo divi ..
babhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca tatkṣaṇādgaganādaho .. 8 ..
4.30.d:
तद्देहे भस्मसाद्भूते नेदुर्दुन्दुभयो दिवि ॥
बभूव पुष्पवृष्टिश्च तत्क्षणाद्गगनादहो ॥ 8 ॥

4.30.s:
etasminnantare tatra ratnasāravinirmitam ..
syandanaṃ ca manoyāyi vastramālyaparicchadam .. 9 ..
4.30.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र रत्नसारविनिर्मितम् ॥
स्यन्दनं च मनोयायि वस्त्रमाल्यपरिच्छदम् ॥ 9 ॥

4.30.s:
pārṣadapravarairyuktaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasadṛśairvaraiḥ ..
āvirbabhūva golokātsundaraṃ purato hareḥ .. 4.30.10 ..
4.30.d:
पार्षदप्रवरैर्युक्तं श्रीकृष्णसदृशैर्वरैः ॥
आविर्बभूव गोलोकात्सुन्दरं पुरतो हरेः ॥ 4.30.10 ॥

4.30.s:
avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ pārṣadapravarā hareḥ ..
sarve samānarūpāste praṇamya rādhikeśvarau 11 ..
4.30.d:
अवरुह्य रथात्तूर्णं पार्षदप्रवरा हरेः ॥
सर्वे समानरूपास्ते प्रणम्य राधिकेश्वरौ 11 ॥

4.30.s:
dhṛtavantaṃ sūkṣmadehaṃ praṇamayya munīśvaram ..
rathe kṛtvā tu taṃ dehaṃ jammurgolokamuttamam .. 12 ..
4.30.d:
धृतवन्तं सूक्ष्मदेहं प्रणमय्य मुनीश्वरम् ॥
रथे कृत्वा तु तं देहं जम्मुर्गोलोकमुत्तमम् ॥ 12 ॥

4.30.s:
gate munīndre golokaṃ vṛndāvanavinodinī ..
babhūva vismitā sādhvī papraccha jagadīśvaram .. 13 ..
4.30.d:
गते मुनीन्द्रे गोलोकं वृन्दावनविनोदिनी ॥
बभूव विस्मिता साध्वी पप्रच्छ जगदीश्वरम् ॥ 13 ॥

4.30.s:
śrīrādhikovāca ..
ko'yaṃ nātha muniśreṣṭhaḥ sarvāvayavava krimaḥ ..
atikharvajanākārastejīyānatikutsitaḥ .. 14 ..
4.30.d:
श्रीराधिकोवाच ॥
कोऽयं नाथ मुनिश्रेष्ठः सर्वावयवव क्रिमः ॥
अतिखर्वजनाकारस्तेजीयानतिकुत्सितः ॥ 14 ॥

4.30.s:
kathaṃ vā nirgataṃ bhasma dehādasya kimadbhutam ..
sākṣādvilīnaṃ yatteja stvatpādābje'nalopamam .. 15 ..
4.30.d:
कथं वा निर्गतं भस्म देहादस्य किमद्भुतम् ॥
साक्षाद्विलीनं यत्तेज स्त्वत्पादाब्जेऽनलोपमम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.30.m: And how did ashes pour out of his body? What a wonder! / And his fire-like splendour dissolved right into your lotus feet! (15) / Mounted on the chariot, that virtuous one instantly went to Goloka; / for whose sake did you, who are self-content, weep, (16) / and perform the funeral rites with tear-filled eyes? / Relate the whole story in detail and at once, O Lord! (17) / Hearing Rādhikā's words, Madhusūdana smiled, / and began to tell the tale, though it belonged to another epoch. (18) / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / The secret of Aṣṭāvakra is renowned everywhere, O beloved; / later, in the course of time, you will hear it in context from the mouths of the wise. (19) / The lordly sage Aṣṭāvakra is renowned throughout the three worlds; / the three worlds are filled with the fame of his birth. (20) / Hearing Kṛṣṇa's words, the beloved of Hari became dejected; / with her throat, lips, and palate parched, she spoke gently and with effort. (21) / Rādhikā said: / If the mind of a thirsty person was not satisfied in an ocean of nectar, / can he become quenched by drinking water from a cow's footprint? (22) / You are the Lord of the Vedas, of the teachers of the Vedas, and of Mahāviṣṇu, / the progenitor of the Creator; who else can speak better than you? (23) / Hearing Rādhikā's words, Kṛṣṇa became pleased, / and spoke of the secret that was to be hidden, supremely wondrous. (24) / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen, O beloved! I shall relate an ancient narrative, / by hearing and reciting which all sin is destroyed. (25) / From the navel-lotus of Mahāviṣṇu, who is a portion of mine, / the Ordainer of the worlds was born by a part of me when the three worlds were flooded with water. (26) / Of old, four sons were born from the mind of Brahmā; / all were devoted to Nārāyaṇa and blazing with the splendour of Brahman. (27) / They were five-year-old children, naked as if ignorant, / devoid of external consciousness, yet experts in the reality of Brahman: (28) / Sanaka, Sananda, and thirdly Sanātana,

4.30.s:
rathasthaḥ puṇyavānsadyo golakaṃ ca jagāma ha ..
svātmārāmasya yaddheto rodanaṃ te babhūva ha .. 16 ..
4.30.d:
रथस्थः पुण्यवान्सद्यो गोलकं च जगाम ह ॥
स्वात्मारामस्य यद्धेतो रोदनं ते बभूव ह ॥ 16 ॥

4.30.s:
tvayā kṛtaṃ ca satkāramaśrupūrṇena cakṣuṣā ..
sarvaṃ vivaraṇaṃ tūrṇaṃ saṃvyasya kathaya prabho .. 17 ..
4.30.d:
त्वया कृतं च सत्कारमश्रुपूर्णेन चक्षुषा ॥
सर्वं विवरणं तूर्णं संव्यस्य कथय प्रभो ॥ 17 ॥

4.30.s:
rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ
kathāṃ kathitumārebhe yugāntaragatāmapi .. 18 ..
4.30.d:
राधिकावचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मधुसूदनः
कथां कथितुमारेभे युगान्तरगतामपि ॥ 18 ॥

4.30.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
rahasyamaṣṭāvakrīyaṃ vikhyātaṃ sarvataḥ priye ..
paścācchroṣyasi kālena prasaṅge viduṣāṃ mukhāt ..19..
4.30.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
रहस्यमष्टावक्रीयं विख्यातं सर्वतः प्रिये ॥
पश्चाच्छ्रोष्यसि कालेन प्रसङ्गे विदुषां मुखात् ॥19॥

4.30.s:
aṣṭāvakro munīndro'pi vikhyāto bhuvanatraye ..
paripūrṇaṃ yadyaśasā janmanā tajjagattrayam..4.30.20..
4.30.d:
अष्टावक्रो मुनीन्द्रोऽपि विख्यातो भुवनत्रये ॥
परिपूर्णं यद्यशसा जन्मना तज्जगत्त्रयम्॥4.30.20॥

4.30.s:
kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vimanaskā haripriyā ..
uvāca madhuraṃ yatnācchuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā .. 21 ..
4.30.d:
कृष्णस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा विमनस्का हरिप्रिया ॥
उवाच मधुरं यत्नाच्छुष्ककण्ठोष्ठतालुका ॥ 21 ॥

4.30.s:
rādhikovāca ..
yattṛṣālormanaḥ pūrṇa na babhūva sudhāmbudhau ..
sa vitṛpto bhavati kiṃ goṣpadodakapānataḥ .. 22 ..
4.30.d:
राधिकोवाच ॥
यत्तृषालोर्मनः पूर्ण न बभूव सुधाम्बुधौ ॥
स वितृप्तो भवति किं गोष्पदोदकपानतः ॥ 22 ॥

4.30.s:
vedānāṃ vedavaktṝṇāṃ vidhāturjanakasya ca ..
mahāviṣṇorīśvarastvaṃ ko'nyo vaktā'sti tvatparaḥ ..23..
4.30.d:
वेदानां वेदवक्तॄणां विधातुर्जनकस्य च ॥
महाविष्णोरीश्वरस्त्वं कोऽन्यो वक्ताऽस्ति त्वत्परः ॥23॥

4.30.s:
rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā tuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇo babhūva ha ..
uvāca gopanīyaṃ ca rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam .. 24 ..
4.30.d:
राधिकावचनं श्रुत्वा तुष्टः कृष्णो बभूव ह ॥
उवाच गोपनीयं च रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम् ॥ 24 ॥

4.30.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu kānte pravakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
śravaṇātkathanādyasya sarvaṃ pāpaṃ praṇaśyati .. 25 ..
4.30.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
शृणु कान्ते प्रवक्ष्येऽहमितिहासं पुरातनम् ॥
श्रवणात्कथनाद्यस्य सर्वं पापं प्रणश्यति ॥ 25 ॥

4.30.s:
mahāviṣṇornābhipadmādbabhūva jagatāṃ vidhiḥ ..
mamāṃśasya matkalayā jalākīrṇe jagattraye .. 26 ..
4.30.d:
महाविष्णोर्नाभिपद्माद्बभूव जगतां विधिः ॥
ममांशस्य मत्कलया जलाकीर्णे जगत्त्रये ॥ 26 ॥

4.30.s:
putrā babhūvuścatvāro brahmaṇo mānasātpurā ..
nārāyaṇaparāḥ sarve jvalanto brahmatejasā .. 27 ..
4.30.d:
पुत्रा बभूवुश्चत्वारो ब्रह्मणो मानसात्पुरा ॥
नारायणपराः सर्वे ज्वलन्तो ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥ 27 ॥

4.30.s:
śiśavaḥ pañcavarṣīyā nagnā ajñānino yathā ..
bāhyajñānavihīnāśca brahmatattvaviśāradāḥ .. 28 ..
4.30.d:
शिशवः पञ्चवर्षीया नग्ना अज्ञानिनो यथा ॥
बाह्यज्ञानविहीनाश्च ब्रह्मतत्त्वविशारदाः ॥ 28 ॥

4.30.s:
sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ ..
sanatkumāro bhagavānete catvāra eva ca ..29..
4.30.d:
सनकश्च सनन्दश्च तृतीयश्च सनातनः ॥
सनत्कुमारो भगवानेते चत्वार एव च ॥29॥

4.30.s:
tānuvāca jagaddhātā sṛṣṭiṃ kuruta putrakāḥ ..
te na tasthuḥ piturvākye prayayustapase mama ..4.30.30..
4.30.d:
तानुवाच जगद्धाता सृष्टिं कुरुत पुत्रकाः ॥
ते न तस्थुः पितुर्वाक्ये प्रययुस्तपसे मम ॥4.30.30॥

4.30.s:
vidhātā vimanaskaśca tanayeṣu gateṣu ca ..
piturduḥkhāya prabhavetputraścedavacaskaraḥ .. 31 ..
4.30.d:
विधाता विमनस्कश्च तनयेषु गतेषु च ॥
पितुर्दुःखाय प्रभवेत्पुत्रश्चेदवचस्करः ॥ 31 ॥

4.30.s:
jñānena nirmame putrānsvāṅgeṣu ca tapodhanān ..
vedavedāṅgavijñāṃśca jvalato brahmatejasā ..32..
4.30.d:
ज्ञानेन निर्ममे पुत्रान्स्वाङ्गेषु च तपोधनान् ॥
वेदवेदाङ्गविज्ञांश्च ज्वलतो ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥32॥

4.30.s:
atriḥ pulastyaḥ pulaho marīcirbhṛguraṅgirāḥ ..
kraturvasiṣṭho voḍhuśca kapilaścāsuriḥ kaviḥ ..33..
4.30.d:
अत्रिः पुलस्त्यः पुलहो मरीचिर्भृगुरङ्गिराः ॥
क्रतुर्वसिष्ठो वोढुश्च कपिलश्चासुरिः कविः ॥33॥

4.30.s:
śaṅkuḥ śaṅkhaḥ pañcaśikhaḥ pracetāste tapodhanāḥ ..
bahukālaṃ tapastaptvā cakruḥ sṛṣṭiṃ tadājñayā .. 34 ..
4.30.d:
शङ्कुः शङ्खः पञ्चशिखः प्रचेतास्ते तपोधनाः ॥
बहुकालं तपस्तप्त्वा चक्रुः सृष्टिं तदाज्ञया ॥ 34 ॥

4.30.s:
kalatravantaste sarve saṃsāraṃ kartumu nmukhāḥ ..
babhūvuḥ putrapautrāśca sarveṣāṃ ca tapasvinām.. 39..
4.30.d:
कलत्रवन्तस्ते सर्वे संसारं कर्तुमु न्मुखाः ॥
बभूवुः पुत्रपौत्राश्च सर्वेषां च तपस्विनाम्॥ 39॥

4.30.s:
tadastu ca kathā bahvī munivaṃśānukīrtanī ..
cārvī puṇyasvarūpā ca prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu sundari .. 36 ..
4.30.d:
तदस्तु च कथा बह्वी मुनिवंशानुकीर्तनी ॥
चार्वी पुण्यस्वरूपा च प्रकृतं शृणु सुन्दरि ॥ 36 ॥

4.30.s:
pracetasaḥ sutaḥ śrīmānasito munipuṅgavaḥ ..
sakalatrastapastepe divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam .. 37 ..
4.30.d:
प्रचेतसः सुतः श्रीमानसितो मुनिपुङ्गवः ॥
सकलत्रस्तपस्तेपे दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् ॥ 37 ॥

4.30.s:
na babhūva sutastasya prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyataḥ ..
taṃ samboddhuṃ babhūvātha satyā vāgaśarīriṇī..38..
4.30.d:
न बभूव सुतस्तस्य प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं समुद्यतः ॥
तं सम्बोद्धुं बभूवाथ सत्या वागशरीरिणी॥38॥

4.30.s:
kathaṃ tyajasi prāṇāṃstvaṃ gaccha śaṅkarasannidhim ..
siddhaṃ kuru gṛhītvā ca mantraṃ śaṅkaravaktrataḥ .. 39 ..
4.30.d:
कथं त्यजसि प्राणांस्त्वं गच्छ शङ्करसन्निधिम् ॥
सिद्धं कुरु गृहीत्वा च मन्त्रं शङ्करवक्त्रतः ॥ 39 ॥

4.30.s:
mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ te sadyaḥ sākṣādbhaviṣyati ..
vareṇābhīṣṭadevyāśca putraste bhavitā dhuvam .. 4.30.40 ..
4.30.d:
मन्त्राधिष्ठातृदेवीं ते सद्यः साक्षाद्भविष्यति ॥
वरेणाभीष्टदेव्याश्च पुत्रस्ते भविता धुवम् ॥ 4.30.40 ॥

4.30.s:
śrutvaitaccaritaṃ vipro jagāma śivasannidhim ..
yogināmapyagamyaṃ ca śivalokaṃ nirāmayam .. 41 ..
4.30.d:
श्रुत्वैतच्चरितं विप्रो जगाम शिवसन्निधिम् ॥
योगिनामप्यगम्यं च शिवलोकं निरामयम् ॥ 41 ॥

4.30.s:
sakalatro yathā yogī tuṣṭāva yogināṃ gurum ..
puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ..42..
4.30.d:
सकलत्रो यथा योगी तुष्टाव योगिनां गुरुम् ॥
पुटाञ्जलियुतो भूत्वा भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरः ॥42॥

4.30.s:
asita uvāca ..
jagadguro namastubhyaṃ śivāya śivadāya ca ..
yogīndrāṇāṃ ca yogīndra gurūṇāṃ gurave namaḥ .. 43 ..
4.30.d:
असित उवाच ॥
जगद्गुरो नमस्तुभ्यं शिवाय शिवदाय च ॥
योगीन्द्राणां च योगीन्द्र गुरूणां गुरवे नमः ॥ 43 ॥
4.30.m: and the blessed Sanatkumāra—these four alone. / The creator of the universe said to them, “Children, produce creation!” / They did not abide by their father's word; they departed to perform asceticism directed toward me. / When his sons had gone, the creator was despondent. / If a son is disobedient, he becomes a cause of sorrow to his father. / Through knowledge he fashioned from his own limbs sons rich in asceticism, / learned in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, blazing with the splendour of Brahman: / Atri, Pulastya, Pulaha, Marīci, Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras, / Kratu, Vasiṣṭha, Voḍhu, Kapila, Āsuri, Kavi, / Śaṅku, Śaṅkha, Pañcaśikha, and Pracetas—rich in asceticism. / Having performed asceticism for a long time, by his command they brought forth creation. / Having taken wives, all of them turned their minds to worldly life; / sons and grandsons were born to all those ascetics. / Be that as it may, there is a lengthy story recounting the lineages of the sages, / charming and consisting of merit; hear of the matter at hand, O beautiful one. / The illustrious son of Pracetas was Asita, an eminent sage; / with his wife he performed asceticism for a celestial thousand years. / No son was born to him; he was ready to give up his life. / Then a true incorporeal voice arose to instruct him: / “Why do you give up your life? Go into the presence of Śaṅkara. / Receiving a mantra from the mouth of Śaṅkara, attain its perfection. / The presiding goddess of the mantra will at once appear visibly before you; / by the boon of the chosen goddess, a son will surely be born to you.” / Having heard this event, the brahmin went into the presence of Śiva, / into the trouble-free Śivaloka, unapproachable even to yogins. / Together with his wife, the yogin praised the guru of yogins, / with joined hands, his neck bowed in devotion. / Asita said: / “Salutations to you, O guru of the world, to Śiva, bestower of auspiciousness! / Salutations to the supreme yogin among supreme yogins, to the guru of gurus!

4.30.s:
mṛtyomṛrtyusvarūpeṇa mṛtyusaṃsārakhaṇḍana..
mṛtyorīśa mṛtyubīja mṛtyuñjaya namo'stu te .. 44 ..
4.30.d:
मृत्योमृर्त्युस्वरूपेण मृत्युसंसारखण्डन॥
मृत्योरीश मृत्युबीज मृत्युञ्जय नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 44 ॥
4.30.m: O you who, in the form of death to death, shatter the worldly existence of death! / O lord of death, O seed of death, O conqueror of death, salutations to you! / O time-form of those who reckon, O lord of the death of time, O cause, / O you beyond time, O death to time, salutations to you! / O you beyond the gunas, O support of the gunas, O seed of the gunas, whose nature is the gunas! / O lord of the virtuous, seed of the virtuous, salutations to the guru of the virtuous! / O whose nature is Brahman, knower of Brahman, devoted to contemplation of Brahman! / O you who are the very form of the seed of Brahman, O seed of Brahman, salutations to you!” / Having thus praised Śiva and bowed down, the lord of sages stood before him, / full of compassion for the distressed, his eyes filled with tears, his body covered in horripilation. / If one who eats sacrificial food for one year reads with devotion this hymn of praise / composed by Asita to the great-souled Śaṅkara, / he will obtain a Vaiṣṇava son, wise and long-lived. / The poor and sorrowful becomes wealthy; the dumb becomes learned. / The wifeless gains a wife of good character and a devoted wife; / having enjoyed happiness in this world, he goes at last into the presence of Śiva. / In ancient times this hymn of praise was given by Brahmā to Pracetas; / by Pracetas this excellent hymn was given to his own son Asita. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Having heard the sage’s hymn of praise, the blessed Śaṅkara himself, / affectionate to his devotees, spoke to the son of Brahmā, his devotee. / Śaṅkara said: / “Be steady, O best of sages; I know what you desire. / Truly a son shall be born to you, from my portion, equal to me. / I will give you an incomparable mantra, exceedingly hard for all to attain.” / Having spoken thus, he gave your very own sixteen-syllabled mantra, / the hymn of praise, the method of worship, and the most wonderful armour / named Saṃsāravijaya, along with the preparatory rites, / saying: “The chosen goddess will become visible to grant a boon.” / Having spoken thus, Rudra ceased; bowing to him, he departed. / That Asita muttered the supreme mantra for a hundred years.

4.30.m: Manifesting visibly, a boon was granted to him by you in ancient times, O faithful one, [saying]: / “Truly a son shall be born to you, a son possessing great wisdom.” / Having given the boon, you went to Goloka, into my presence. / And in course of time a son was born to him from a portion of Śiva, / devoted to Brahman, named Devala, handsome as Kandarpa. / Joyfully he took in marriage the daughter of King Suyajña, / Ratnamālāvatī, the beautiful one who enchanteth all. / In secluded places, here and there, for a hundred years with her / he took delight, skilled and foremost in the act of love with women. / Later on, that eminent sage became detached; / renouncing all pleasure, most virtuous, remembering Śrī Hari. / Rising at night from his bed, dispassionate, the ascetic, / went to Mount Gandhamādana for asceticism, O lovely one. / Awakening from sleep and not seeing her husband, the devoted wife / lamented bitterly from sorrow, consumed by the fire of separation. / Standing up, sitting down, she wept aloud again and again; / her mind was then like grain in a heated pan. / Giving up food, the beautiful woman abandoned her life; / her son performed the cremation rites and other funeral deeds for her. / That sage performed asceticism in a cave of Mount Gandhamādana / for a celestial thousand years, devoted to me, his senses conquered. / By fate, Rambhā, yearning for amorous sport, saw him, / exceedingly handsome, tranquil, fair as Kandarpa. / Having carefully dressed herself, she who bewitches the minds of the three worlds, / approaching him in that solitary place, spoke to him. / Rambhā said: / “Understand my words, O virtuous one, captivating to passionate women! / Abandoning harsh [asceticism], enjoy me in private, me who bestow pleasure! / You are the best among the worthy on earth; I am a fair-hipped maiden choosing my own husband. / Rare is the fresh union of a discerning woman and a discerning man!”

4.30.s:
