svargabhoganimittaṃ ca bhogasārā vayaṃ mune .. 73 ..
4.30.d:
यज्ञं कुर्वन्ति भूपाला भारते स्वर्गहेतुकम् ॥
स्वर्गभोगनिमित्तं च भोगसारा वयं मुने ॥ 73 ॥
4.30.m:
Kings perform sacrifices in Bhārata for the sake of heaven, / and we, O sage, are the essence of enjoyment, meant for the pleasures of heaven. / 73
Who would not find pleasure seeing my pair of breasts, my thighs, / and my lovely lotus face accompanied by smiles and the arching of brows? / 74
The rasa of women is the essence of pleasure, sought after even by sages; / the enjoyment of pleasure with a passionate woman in private is exceedingly hard to attain. / 75
Be he a god, a human, a gandharva, or a rākṣasa, / he who is deprived of Rambhā's lovemaking is ignorant in the pleasures of women. / 76
He who has conquered his senses and does not enjoy a loving woman arrived in private / will surely dwell in the Kumbhīpāka hell for as many years as there are hairs on his body. / 77
Indeed, he shares the sin of her murder and is ruined by her curse; / through Mohinī's curse the Creator became unworthy of worship in the three worlds. / 78
A wanton woman does not look with such wrath upon the killer / of her husband, son, or kin as she does upon him by whom she, when present, is rejected. / 79
A wanton woman considers her paramour dearest of all; / if abandoned by him, she is indeed capable of killing him. / 80
A wanton woman is more cruel than predatory beasts and murderers of the innocent; / she is wicked, always devoid of pity, and terrible in every birth. / 81
Abandon your meditation, best of sages! Enjoy this fruit of your austerity: / take me, who have arrived in private, for long-lasting happiness! / 82
Hearing Rambhā's words, he, agitated with apprehension, spoke to her / beneficial, true, the essence of wisdom, yielding happiness in the end. / 83
Devala said: / Listen, Rambhā! I shall speak the supreme word, the essence of the Vedas, / suited to the duty of the family, true for ascetic brāhmaṇas. / 84
This is dharma: a twice-born man taking pleasure in his own wife at the proper time / is always honoured everywhere, both in this world and the next. / 85
A brāhmaṇa, a kṣatriya, or a vaiśya who takes pleasure in another's woman— / Lakṣmī, angered, departs even from the house of that unhonoured man. / 86
He is utterly despised everywhere here, and has no right to his own rituals.

4.30.s:

देवल उवाच ॥

4.30.s:

4.30.m:
In the other world he must dwell in the blind well for a full hundred years. / 87
A woman who has presented herself may be accepted by a householder, not by an ascetic; / in rejecting passionate women there is fault: the householder incurs a curse and incurs sin. / 88
Even Brahmā, the creator of the world, is not free of passion, having a wife; / there is fault in rejection, but that never applies to us who have renounced women. / 89
He who abandons his own wife and takes another man's woman / suffers the loss of fame, wealth, and life, and is like one dead while alive. / 90
He who has no fame on earth, his life is fruitless. / What use are great wealth, a kingdom, or pleasure to an ascetic? / 91
What need have you of me, desireless and old? / Look, O mother, O beautiful woman, upon a handsome, well-dressed youth! / 92
Hearing these words, the best of the apsarases was enraged; / trembling, her lower lip quivering, she spoke to him again. / 93
Rambhā said: / You have the lovely splendour of campaka, are handsome like Kandarpa, / radiant through the power of your tapas, well-adorned, and pleasing to a woman. / 94
Except for you, to whom else shall I go? Who is there, a man greater than you? / What wanton woman, smitten with love, can live having abandoned you? / 95
Enjoy me quickly, O best of the twice-born, me who am constantly scorched by the fire of love! / Love destroys me apart from you, like an elephant a plantain tree. / 96
Otherwise, I shall pronounce a curse; speak, best of those who know the Vedas! / Either accept me, or accept a dreadful curse at once! / 97
My vital breaths are scorched, my mind is scorched, and my very self is scorched continuously; / may it reach extinction through drinking the nectar of fresh lovemaking! / 98
Whoever, afflicted with sorrow through inner torment, truly curses someone, / not even the Creator, the lord of the universe, is capable of breaking that curse. / 99
Hearing Rambhā's words, the twice-born man became absorbed in meditation; / remaining silent, he said nothing, and she, out of anger, cursed him: / 100

द्विजो रम्भावचः श्रुत्वा बभूव ध्यानतत्परः ॥

हे वक्रचित्त ते विप्र सर्वावयववक्रिमम् ॥
शरीरमञ्जनाकारं रूपयौवनवर्जितम् ॥ 1 ॥
अतीवविकृताकारं त्रिषु लोकेषु गर्हितम् ॥
पुरातनं तपो नष्टं सद्यो भवतु निश्चितम् ॥ 2 ॥
इत्युक्त्वा पुंश्चली कामात्कामलोकं जगाम ह ॥
अचिरेण मुनीन्द्रश्च न ददर्श हरेः पदम् ॥3॥
पदारविन्दविरहात्समुद्विग्नो बभूव ह॥
स्वाङ्गं च दृष्ट्वा विकृतं पूर्वपुण्यविवर्जितम्॥4 ॥

आश्वासश्च कृतः प्रीत्या ततः शान्तो बभूव ह ॥
अङ्गान्यष्टौ च वक्राणि दृष्ट्वा तूर्णं महामुनेः ॥ 6 ॥

4.31.d:
वल्मीकाच्छादितं देहं दृष्ट्वा धाता कृपानिधिः ॥
आजगाम वरं दातुं तपःस्थानं सुनिर्जनम् ॥6॥

4.31.s:
kamaṇḍalujalenaiva mama dehodbhavena ca..
siṣeca taṃ ca mantreṇa mayā dattena yogavit .. 7 ..
4.31.d:
कमण्डलुजलेनैव मम देहोद्भवेन च॥
सिषेच तं च मन्त्रेण मया दत्तेन योगवित् ॥ 7 ॥

4.31.s:
kamaṇḍalujalasparśādutthāya nṛpatiḥ svayam ..
nanāma bhaktyā jagatāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ ca puraḥ sthitam..8..
4.31.d:
कमण्डलुजलस्पर्शादुत्थाय नृपतिः स्वयम् ॥
ननाम भक्त्या जगतां स्रष्टारं च पुरः स्थितम्॥8॥

4.31.s:
sa taṃ namantaṃ rājānamuvāca kamalodbhavaḥ ..
varaṃ vṛṇviti rājendra yatte manasi vāñchitam .. 9 ..
4.31.d:
स तं नमन्तं राजानमुवाच कमलोद्भवः ॥
वरं वृण्विति राजेन्द्र यत्ते मनसि वाञ्छितम् ॥ 9 ॥

4.31.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā varaṃ vavre parātparam ..
mamaiva caraṇe bhaktiṃ madīyaṃ dāsyameva ca ..4.31.10..
4.31.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वरं वव्रे परात्परम् ॥
ममैव चरणे भक्तिं मदीयं दास्यमेव च ॥4.31.10॥

4.31.s:
kṛpayā ca varaṃ brahmā dattavānabhivāñchitam ..
sa ca tatpuratastasthau kāmadevasamaprabhaḥ ..11..
4.31.d:
कृपया च वरं ब्रह्मा दत्तवानभिवाञ्छितम् ॥
स च तत्पुरतस्तस्थौ कामदेवसमप्रभः ॥11॥

4.31.s:
etasminnantare rājā dadarśa rathamuttamam ..
ākāśānnipatantaṃ vai śatasūryasamaprabham .. 12 ..
4.31.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजा ददर्श रथमुत्तमम् ॥
आकाशान्निपतन्तं वै शतसूर्यसमप्रभम् ॥ 12 ॥

4.31.s:
tejasā''cchāditaṃ sarvaṃ supradīptaṃ diśo daśa ..
ratnendrasāranirmāṇaṃ śatacakrasamanvitam .. 13 ..
4.31.d:
तेजसा'ऽच्छादितं सर्वं सुप्रदीप्तं दिशो दश ॥
रत्नेन्द्रसारनिर्माणं शतचक्रसमन्वितम् ॥ 13 ॥

4.31.s:
amūlyaratnaracitaṃ vicitrakalaśojjvalam ..
muktāmāṇikyahīrāṇāṃ mālājālaiśca rājitam .. 14 ..
4.31.d:
अमूल्यरत्नरचितं विचित्रकलशोज्ज्वलम् ॥
मुक्तामाणिक्यहीराणां मालाजालैश्च राजितम् ॥ 14 ॥

4.31.s:
sadratnadarpaṇairdīptairatīva sumanoharam ..
bhūṣitaṃ divyavastraiśca śvetacāmarakoṭibhiḥ .. 15 ..
4.31.d:
सद्रत्नदर्पणैर्दीप्तैरतीव सुमनोहरम् ॥
भूषितं दिव्यवस्त्रैश्च श्वेतचामरकोटिभिः ॥ 15 ॥

4.31.s:
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālaiḥ suśobhitam ..
manoyāyi mahāścaryaṃ nānācitreṇa citritam ..16..
4.31.d:
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाजालैः सुशोभितम् ॥
मनोयायि महाश्चर्यं नानाचित्रेण चित्रितम् ॥16॥

4.31.s:
veṣṭitaṃ pārṣadairdivyai ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaiḥ..
caturbhujaiḥ śyāmalaiśca jvaladbhiḥ sthirayauvanaiḥ .. 17 ..
4.31.d:
वेष्टितं पार्षदैर्दिव्यै रत्नभूषणभूषितैः॥
चतुर्भुजैः श्यामलैश्च ज्वलद्भिः स्थिरयौवनैः ॥ 17 ॥

4.31.s:
pītavastraparīdhānaiścandanāgurucarcitaiḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā rathasthāndevāṃśca nanāma nṛpatirmudā .. 18 ..
4.31.d:
पीतवस्त्रपरीधानैश्चन्दनागुरुचर्चितैः ॥
दृष्ट्वा रथस्थान्देवांश्च ननाम नृपतिर्मुदा ॥ 18 ॥

4.31.s:
sahasā tasya śirasi puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ..
nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge cānakāśca manoharāḥ .. 19 ..
4.31.d:
सहसा तस्य शिरसि पुष्पवृष्टिर्बभूव ह ॥
नेदुर्दुन्दुभयः स्वर्गे चानकाश्च मनोहराः ॥ 19 ॥

4.31.s:
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ prakurvanto mudā''śiṣam ..
praśaśaṃsuḥ surāḥ sarve rājānaṃ harṣanirbharāḥ .. 4.31.20 ..
4.31.d:
ऋषयो मुनयः सिद्धाः प्रकुर्वन्तो मुदा'ऽशिषम् ॥
प्रशशंसुः सुराः सर्वे राजानं हर्षनिर्भराः ॥ 4.31.20 ॥

4.31.s:
rājā ca pārṣadāndhyātvā tadrūpaśca babhūva ha ..
pārṣadāstaṃ rathe kṛtvā nītvā jagmurmamālayam .. 21 ..
4.31.d:
राजा च पार्षदान्ध्यात्वा तद्रूपश्च बभूव ह ॥
पार्षदास्तं रथे कृत्वा नीत्वा जग्मुर्ममालयम् ॥ 21 ॥

4.31.s:
madīyaḥ pārṣado bhūtvā sa ca tasthau mamāntike ..
tataḥ svamandiraṃ yāntaṃ dadarśa mohinī vidhim ..22..
4.31.d:
मदीयः पार्षदो भूत्वा स च तस्थौ ममान्तिके ॥
ततः स्वमन्दिरं यान्तं ददर्श मोहिनी विधिम् ॥22॥

4.31.s:
puṣpodyāne ca ramye ca puṣpacandanavāyunā..
sadyo mumoha taṃ dṛṣṭvā pradagdhā madānānalaiḥ..23..
4.31.d:
पुष्पोद्याने च रम्ये च पुष्पचन्दनवायुना॥
सद्यो मुमोह तं दृष्ट्वा प्रदग्धा मदानानलैः॥23॥

4.31.s:
vilokya vakranayanā jugopa sasmitaṃ mukham..
sindūrabinduṃ dadhatī kastūrībindunā saha..24..
4.31.d:
विलोक्य वक्रनयना जुगोप सस्मितं मुखम्॥
सिन्दूरबिन्दुं दधती कस्तूरीबिन्दुना सह॥24॥

4.31.s:
cārucampakavarṇābhā satataṃ sthirayauvanā..
bṛhannitambayugalā pīnaśroṇipayodharā ..25..
4.31.d:
चारुचम्पकवर्णाभा सततं स्थिरयौवना॥
बृहन्नितम्बयुगला पीनश्रोणिपयोधरा ॥25॥
4.31.m: with large hips, and plump hips and breasts,

4.31.s:
śaratpārvaṇaśubhrāṃśuprabhāmuṣṭakarānanā ..
sūkṣmavastraparīdhānā ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitā .. 26 ..
4.31.d:
शरत्पार्वणशुभ्रांशुप्रभामुष्टकरानना ॥
सूक्ष्मवस्त्रपरीधाना रत्नालंकारभूषिता ॥ 26 ॥
4.31.m:
with a face whose brilliance eclipsed the radiance of the autumnal full moon,
wearing fine garments, decorated with gem-encrusted ornaments,

4.31.s:
trailokyaṃ mohituṃ śaktā kaṭākṣaireva līlayā ..
atīva kāminī śaśvadgajendramandagāminī ..27..
4.31.d:
त्रैलोक्यं मोहितुं शक्ता कटाक्षैरेव लीलया ॥
अतीव कामिनी शश्वद्गजेन्द्रमन्दगामिनी ॥27॥
4.31.m:
capable of enchanting the three worlds effortlessly merely with her side-glances,
exceedingly passionate, constantly walking with the slow gait of a lordly elephant.

4.31.s:
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgī mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa vartmani ..
sannirīkṣya ca tāṃ brahmā jagāma śrīhariṃ smaran .. 28 ..
4.31.d:
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वाङ्गी मूर्च्छां संप्राप वर्त्मनि ॥
सन्निरीक्ष्य च तां ब्रह्मा जगाम श्रीहरिं स्मरन् ॥ 28 ॥
4.31.m:
With all her limbs thrilling with horripilation, she fell into a faint on the path.
Looking carefully at her, Brahmā went on his way, remembering Śrī Hari.

4.31.s:
sa vikāraṃ na hi prāpa hyātmārāmo jiteṃdriyaḥ ..
brahmalokaṃ ca saṃprāpa brahmā ca jagatāṃ patiḥ .. 29 ..
4.31.d:
स विकारं न हि प्राप ह्यात्मारामो जितेंद्रियः ॥
ब्रह्मलोकं च संप्राप ब्रह्मा च जगतां पतिः ॥ 29 ॥
4.31.m:
He suffered no agitation, indeed finding delight in the Self, his senses conquered;
and Brahmā, the lord of the worlds, reached Brahmaloka.

4.31.s:
sakāmā sā ca kulaṭā babhūva hatacetanā ..
divāniśaṃ cintayantī svapne jñāne caturmukham .. 4.31.30 ..
4.31.d:
सकामा सा च कुलटा बभूव हतचेतना ॥
दिवानिशं चिन्तयन्ती स्वप्ने ज्ञाने चतुर्मुखम् ॥ 4.31.30 ॥
4.31.m:
Filled with lust, that wanton woman lost all consciousness,
thinking day and night of the Four-Faced One in dreams and in waking consciousness.

4.31.s:
sarvaṃ jāraṃ visasmāra tatyāja harimīśvarī ..
uttiṣṭhantī nivasatī śayanaṃ kurvatī kṣaṇam ..31..
4.31.d:
सर्वं जारं विसस्मार तत्याज हरिमीश्वरी ॥
उत्तिष्ठन्ती निवसती शयनं कुर्वती क्षणम् ॥31॥
4.31.m:
She forgot all her paramours; the mistress abandoned Hari.
Rising, resting, lying down for a moment,

4.31.s:
taptapātre yathā sasyaṃ bhramatyeva tathā pathi ..
etasminnantare rambhā vidagdhā'psarasāṃ varā .. .. 32 ..
4.31.d:
तप्तपात्रे यथा सस्यं भ्रमत्येव तथा पथि ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रम्भा विदग्धाऽप्सरसां वरा ॥ ॥ 32 ॥
4.31.m:
she wandered on the path just like grain on a heated pan.
At that moment, Rambhā, clever and the best of Apsarases, [approached].

4.31.s:
gacchantī kāmalokaṃ sā sakāmā tena vartmanā ..
dṛṣṭvā sahacarīṃ tatra śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukām ..
abhiprāyeṇa bubudhe papraccha sasmitā tadā .. 33 ..
4.31.d:
गच्छन्ती कामलोकं सा सकामा तेन वर्त्मना ॥
दृष्ट्वा सहचरीं तत्र शुष्ककण्ठोष्ठतालुकाम् ॥
अभिप्रायेण बुबुधे पप्रच्छ सस्मिता तदा ॥ 33 ॥
4.31.m:
Going on her way filled with passion toward Kāmaloka,
and seeing her companion there with parched throat, lips, and palate,
she grasped [her condition] by her intention and then asked with a smile: // 33

4.31.s:
rambhovāca ..
kathamevaṃvidhā tvaṃ hi trailokyacittamohini .. 34 ..
4.31.d:
रम्भोवाच ॥
कथमेवंविधा त्वं हि त्रैलोक्यचित्तमोहिनि ॥ 34 ॥
4.31.m: Why are you in such a state, O bewitcher of the mind of the three worlds? // 34

4.31.s:
vada śīghraṃ mahābhāge rambhā'haṃ cetanaṃ kuru ..
kamuddiśya sakāmā tvaṃ gaccha tvaṃ kāntamīpsitam ..35..
4.31.d:
वद शीघ्रं महाभागे रम्भाऽहं चेतनं कुरु ॥
कमुद्दिश्य सकामा त्वं गच्छ त्वं कान्तमीप्सितम् ॥35॥
4.31.m:
Speak quickly, fortunate one! I am Rambhā; regain your senses!
Toward whom are you filled with passion? Go to the beloved you desire! // 35

4.31.s:
kulaṭā sarvasaubhāgyā na vayaṃ kulapālikāḥ ..
sarve vyagrā indriyāṇāṃ sukhāya bhuvanatraye ..36..
4.31.d:
कुलटा सर्वसौभाग्या न वयं कुलपालिकाः ॥
सर्वे व्यग्रा इन्द्रियाणां सुखाय भुवनत्रये ॥36॥
4.31.m:
We are unchaste women possessing all good fortune, not preservers of family lineage.
Everyone in the three worlds is intent upon the pleasure of the senses. // 36

4.31.s:
yānti prāṇā yataḥ kāle kā lajjā tatra jīvinām ..
na cātmanaḥ paraḥ kaścitpriyo'sti bhuvanatraye ..37..
4.31.d:
यान्ति प्राणा यतः काले का लज्जा तत्र जीविनाम् ॥
न चात्मनः परः कश्चित्प्रियोऽस्ति भुवनत्रये ॥37॥
4.31.m:
Since life-breaths depart in time, what shame is there in that for living beings?
And there is nothing in the three worlds dearer than oneself. // 37

4.31.s:
kānte'patye svabandhau ca sneho yaḥ svātmahetukaḥ ..
sambandhaḥ svātmano yāvattāvatsneho'sti tatra vai .. 38 ..
4.31.d:
कान्तेऽपत्ये स्वबन्धौ च स्नेहो यः स्वात्महेतुकः ॥
सम्बन्धः स्वात्मनो यावत्तावत्स्नेहोऽस्ति तत्र वै ॥ 38 ॥
4.31.m:
Whatever affection exists toward a lover, a child, and one's own kinsman is caused by oneself.
Indeed, as long as a connection exists with oneself, so long does affection exist toward them. // 38

4.31.s:
yeṣu yanmānasaṃ śaśvatteṣāṃ prāṇāsta eva hi ..
gacchantīṃ kāmalokaṃ ca sakāmāṃ paśya māṃ priye .. 39 ..
4.31.d:
येषु यन्मानसं शश्वत्तेषां प्राणास्त एव हि ॥
गच्छन्तीं कामलोकं च सकामां पश्य मां प्रिये ॥ 39 ॥
4.31.m:
Those on whom one's mind constantly dwells are truly one's very life-breaths.
See me, dear friend, going to Kāmaloka full of passion! // 39

4.31.s:
saha sakhyā samālokya manasā gaccha taṃ priyam ..
nibaddhya nīvī keśāṃśca kṛtvā veṣamabhīpsitam .. 4.31.40 ..
4.31.d:
सह सख्या समालोक्य मनसा गच्छ तं प्रियम् ॥
निबद्ध्य नीवी केशांश्च कृत्वा वेषमभीप्सितम् ॥ 4.31.40 ॥
4.31.m:
Having deliberated with your friend, go in your mind to that beloved.
Fastening your garment's knot and your hair, and putting on the desired attire, // 40

4.31.s:
munimohanabījaṃ ca taṃ mohaṃ kuru mohini ..
kathayasva mahābhāge vacanaṃ hṛdayaṃgamam .. 41 ..
4.31.d:
मुनिमोहनबीजं च तं मोहं कुरु मोहिनि ॥
कथयस्व महाभागे वचनं हृदयंगमम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.31.m:
cause that infatuation, O Mohinī, which is the seed of enchanting sages.
Speak, fortunate one, words that touch the heart! // 41

4.31.s:
rakṣātmānaṃ prabhāvaṃ ca strījātīnāṃ jagattraye ..
svābhiprāyaśca suratau na prakāśyaḥ kadācana ..42..
4.31.d:
रक्षात्मानं प्रभावं च स्त्रीजातीनां जगत्त्रये ॥
स्वाभिप्रायश्च सुरतौ न प्रकाश्यः कदाचन ॥42॥
4.31.m:
Protect yourself and the dignity of the race of women in the three worlds.
One's inner intention regarding lovemaking is never to be disclosed, // 42

4.31.s:
svāntaṃ kāntaṃ svānuraktamṛjvīṃ sahacarīṃ vinā ..
tasmādyatnena hṛdvākyaṃ prakāśyaṃ ca priye priye .. 43 ..
4.31.d:
स्वान्तं कान्तं स्वानुरक्तमृज्वीं सहचरीं विना ॥
तस्माद्यत्नेन हृद्वाक्यं प्रकाश्यं च प्रिये प्रिये ॥ 43 ॥
4.31.m:
except to one's own heart, a lover devoted to oneself, and a sincere female companion.
Therefore, the word of the heart should carefully be revealed, my dear, only to someone dear. // 43

4.31.s:
anyathā copahāsāya maraṇāyaiva kalpate ..
tasyāśca vacanaṃ śrutvā sasmitā sā sulajjitā ..
hṛdyaṃ ca kathayāmāsa yaddhetostādṛśī gatiḥ .. 44 ..
4.31.d:
अन्यथा चोपहासाय मरणायैव कल्पते ॥
तस्याश्च वचनं श्रुत्वा सस्मिता सा सुलज्जिता ॥
हृद्यं च कथयामास यद्धेतोस्तादृशी गतिः ॥ 44 ॥
4.31.m:
Otherwise, it leads only to mockery and death.
Having heard her words, she smiled, deeply embarrassed,
and recounted the matter of her heart, the reason for which she was in such a state. // 44

4.31.s:
mohinyuvāca ..
yāvaddṛṣṭo mayā rambhe nirjane caturānanaḥ .. 45 ..
4.31.d:
मोहिन्युवाच ॥
यावद्दृष्टो मया रम्भे निर्जने चतुराननः ॥ 45 ॥
4.31.m: Ever since the four-faced one was seen by me in solitude, O Rambhā, // 45

4.31.s:
tāvanmano me'tidagdhaṃ śaśvanmanasijānalaiḥ ..
na dattamātmane bhakṣyamantare na hi rocate .. .. 46 ..
4.31.d:
तावन्मनो मेऽतिदग्धं शश्वन्मनसिजानलैः ॥
न दत्तमात्मने भक्ष्यमन्तरे न हि रोचते ॥ ॥ 46 ॥
4.31.m:
so long has my heart been terribly scorched constantly by the fires of love.
No food is given to myself, for within it pleases me not at all. // 46

4.31.s:
jānāmi nāhamudayaṃ yāminīśadineśayoḥ ..
adhunā nahi bhedo me satataṃ svapnajñānayoḥ .. 47 ..
4.31.d:
जानामि नाहमुदयं यामिनीशदिनेशयोः ॥
अधुना नहि भेदो मे सततं स्वप्नज्ञानयोः ॥ 47 ॥
4.31.m:
I know not the rising of the lord of the night or the lord of the day;
now there is constantly no difference to me between dream and waking consciousness. // 47

4.31.s:
mama prāṇāḥ pratīkṣante tasyāliṅganameva ca ..
kṣaṇaṃ vijñāya na ciraṃ yāsyanti nānyathā priye .. 48 ..
4.31.d:
मम प्राणाः प्रतीक्षन्ते तस्यालिङ्गनमेव च ॥
क्षणं विज्ञाय न चिरं यास्यन्ति नान्यथा प्रिये ॥ 48 ॥
4.31.m:
My life-breaths await only his embrace.
Discerning a single moment, not long will they remain; they will depart, my dear, not otherwise. // 48

4.31.s:
kāmajvālākalāpaiśca svarṇākāraṃ kalevaram ..
anāhāreṇa cedānīṃ babhūva dagdhaśailavat ..49..
4.31.d:
कामज्वालाकलापैश्च स्वर्णाकारं कलेवरम् ॥
अनाहारेण चेदानीं बभूव दग्धशैलवत् ॥49॥
4.31.m:
Through the flames of passion, this golden body
has now become like a burnt mountain through lack of food. // 49

4.31.s:
gantuṃ sthātuṃ na śaktā'haṃ śayanaṃ kartumudyatā..
dhigastu puṃścalījātiṃ māmeva ca viśeṣataḥ ..4.31.50..
4.31.d:
गन्तुं स्थातुं न शक्ताऽहं शयनं कर्तुमुद्यता॥
धिगस्तु पुंश्चलीजातिं मामेव च विशेषतः ॥4.31.50॥
4.31.m:
I am not able to walk or stand; I am prepared to lie down.
Fie on the race of wanton women, and especially on me! // 50

4.31.s:
kamupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi vada rambhe'tisāmpratam ..
lajjāṃ vā'pi śarīraṃ vā visṛjāmi ca kiṃ dvayoḥ..51..
4.31.d:
कमुपायं करिष्यामि वद रम्भेऽतिसाम्प्रतम् ॥
लज्जां वाऽपि शरीरं वा विसृजामि च किं द्वयोः॥51॥
4.31.m:
What means shall I adopt? Speak, Rambhā, at this very moment!
Shall I abandon shame or my body—which of the two? // 51

4.31.s:
mohinīvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasyāpsarasāṃ varā ..
tāmuvāca hitaṃ nītamupāyaṃ śubhakāraṇam .. 52 ..
4.31.d:
मोहिनीवचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्याप्सरसां वरा ॥
तामुवाच हितं नीतमुपायं शुभकारणम् ॥ 52 ॥
4.31.m:
Hearing Mohinī's words, the best of the apsarases laughed
and spoke to her a beneficial, prudent means that causes good fortune. // 52

4.31.s:
rambhovāca ..
evametadaho bhadre bhadrasya kāraṇaṃ tava ..
sarvaṃ tvapanayiṣyāmi śṛṇūpāyaṃ bhayaṃ tyaja .. 53 ..
4.31.d:
रम्भोवाच ॥
एवमेतदहो भद्रे भद्रस्य कारणं तव ॥
सर्वं त्वपनयिष्यामि शृणूपायं भयं त्यज ॥ 53 ॥
4.31.m:
So it is, ah, auspicious one! This is the cause of your good fortune.
I shall remove everything; hear the means and abandon fear! // 53

4.31.s:
kṛtvā veṣamapūrvaṃ ca pūrvamārādhya manmatham ..
tena sārddhaṃ svayaṃ gatvā mohaṃ kuru ca bhāmini .. ..54..
4.31.d:
कृत्वा वेषमपूर्वं च पूर्वमाराध्य मन्मथम् ॥
तेन सार्द्धं स्वयं गत्वा मोहं कुरु च भामिनि ॥ ॥54॥
4.31.m:
Having assumed an extraordinary attire, and having first worshipped Manmatha,
go yourself with him and enchant him, O passionate woman! // 54

4.31.s:
jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmakam ..
vinā kāmasahāyena kā śaktā jetumīśvaram ..55..
4.31.d:
जितेन्द्रियाणां प्रवरं साक्षान्नारायणात्मकम् ॥
विना कामसहायेन का शक्ता जेतुमीश्वरम् ॥55॥
4.31.m:
He is the foremost of those who have conquered the senses, the very embodiment of Nārāyaṇa.
Without Kāma as an ally, who is able to conquer the Lord? // 55

4.31.s:
bhaja kāmaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā puṣkare vraja mohini ..
sadyaḥ sākṣātsa bhavitā dayāluryoṣitāṃ prabhuḥ ..56..
4.31.d:
भज कामं तपः कृत्वा पुष्करे व्रज मोहिनि ॥
सद्यः साक्षात्स भविता दयालुर्योषितां प्रभुः ॥56॥
4.31.m:
Worship Kāma! Having performed austerity at Puṣkara, go, O Mohinī!
He will immediately manifest in person, the compassionate lord of women. // 56

4.31.s:
ityuktvā tāmapsarasāṃ pravarā kāmamantikam ..
jagāmendriyaśāntyarthaṃ sā jagāma ca puṣkaram .. 57 ..
4.31.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तामप्सरसां प्रवरा काममन्तिकम् ॥
जगामेन्द्रियशान्त्यर्थं सा जगाम च पुष्करम् ॥ 57 ॥
4.31.m:
Having spoken thus to her, the foremost of the apsarases went near to Kāma
for the sake of calming her senses, and the other went to Puṣkara. // 57

4.31.s:
puṣkare ca tapaḥ kṛtvā kāmaṃ saṃprāpya mohinī ..
jagāma tena sārddhaṃ ca brahmalokamanāmayam .. 58 ..
4.31.d:
पुष्करे च तपः कृत्वा कामं संप्राप्य मोहिनी ॥
जगाम तेन सार्द्धं च ब्रह्मलोकमनामयम् ॥ 58 ॥
4.31.m:
Having performed austerity at Puṣkara and having obtained Kāma, Mohinī
went together with him to healthy Brahmaloka. // 58

4.31.s:
dadarśa nirjanasthaṃ ca mohinī kamalodbhavam ..
tameva mohanaṃ kartuṃ samārebhe puraḥ sthitā .. 59 ..
4.31.d:
ददर्श निर्जनस्थं च मोहिनी कमलोद्भवम् ॥
तमेव मोहनं कर्तुं समारेभे पुरः स्थिता ॥ 59 ॥
4.31.m:
Mohinī saw the lotus-born one seated in solitude,
and standing before him, she began to enchant him. // 59

4.31.s:
kṣaṇaṃ nanarta suciraṃ sugānena kṣaṇaṃ jagau ..
saṃgītaṃ mama saṃbandhi bhaktānāṃ cittamohanam .. 4.31.60 ..
4.31.d:
क्षणं ननर्त सुचिरं सुगानेन क्षणं जगौ ॥
संगीतं मम संबन्धि भक्तानां चित्तमोहनम् ॥ 4.31.60 ॥
4.31.m:
For a moment she danced; for a long time, with melodious singing, she sang for a moment
the music pertaining to me, which enchants the hearts of devotees. // 60

4.31.s:
vidhātā jagatāṃ tasyāḥ śrutvā saṃgītamīpsitam ..
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo mumoha sāśrulocanaḥ .. 61 ..
4.31.d:
विधाता जगतां तस्याः श्रुत्वा संगीतमीप्सितम् ॥
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वाङ्गो मुमोह साश्रुलोचनः ॥ 61 ॥
4.31.m:
The Creator of the worlds, having heard her pleasing music,
with all his limbs bristling with hair, he swooned, his eyes filled with tears.

4.31.s:
dṛṣṭvā mugdhaṃ caturvaktraṃ mohinī hṛṣṭamānasā ..
kalāpramāṇaṃ bhāvaṃ ca cakāra tatra līlayā .. 62 ..
4.31.d:
दृष्ट्वा मुग्धं चतुर्वक्त्रं मोहिनी हृष्टमानसा ॥
कलाप्रमाणं भावं च चकार तत्र लीलया ॥ 62 ॥
4.31.m:
Seeing the four-faced [creator] enchanted, Mohinī, joyful at heart,
sportively displayed an amorous mood measured in rhythmic movements.

4.31.s:
svāṅgaṃ saṃdarśayāmāsa smerabhrūbhaṅgapūrvakam ..
kā lajjā tasya saṃsāre yaḥ kāmahatacetanaḥ .. 63 ..
4.31.d:
स्वाङ्गं संदर्शयामास स्मेरभ्रूभङ्गपूर्वकम् ॥
का लज्जा तस्य संसारे यः कामहतचेतनः ॥ 63 ॥
4.31.m:
She revealed her body, accompanied by a smile and a knit of her brows.
What shame is there in the world for one whose consciousness is struck down by lust?

4.31.s:
vijñāya brahmā tadbhāvaṃ natavaktro babhūva ha ..
pradāya tasyā dānaṃ ca virataḥ śrīhariṃ smaran .. 64 ..
4.31.d:
विज्ञाय ब्रह्मा तद्भावं नतवक्त्रो बभूव ह ॥
प्रदाय तस्या दानं च विरतः श्रीहरिं स्मरन् ॥ 64 ॥
4.31.m:
Perceiving her intention, Brahmā bowed his face.
Bestowing a gift upon her, he ceased, meditating on Śrī Hari.

4.31.s:
vijñāya brahmaṇo bhāvaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā ..
hatodyamā sā tuṣṭāva kāmaṃ kāmapradaṃ varam .. 65 ..
4.31.d:
विज्ञाय ब्रह्मणो भावं शुष्ककण्ठोष्ठतालुका ॥
हतोद्यमा सा तुष्टाव कामं कामप्रदं वरम् ॥ 65 ॥
4.31.m:
Perceiving Brahmā's state, her throat, lips, and palate dried up,
and, her efforts thwarted, she praised Kāma, the supreme granter of desires:

4.31.s:
mohinyuvāca ..
sarvendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ viṣṇoraṃśaṃ ca mānasam ..
tadeva karmaṇāṃ bījaṃ tadudbhava namo'stu te .. 66 ..
4.31.d:
मोहिन्युवाच ॥
सर्वेन्द्रियाणां प्रवरं विष्णोरंशं च मानसम् ॥
तदेव कर्मणां बीजं तदुद्भव नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 66 ॥
4.31.m:
"The mind is the foremost of all senses, a portion of Viṣṇu;
it is the very seed of actions. O you who are born from it, homage to you!

4.31.s:
svayamātmā hi bhagavāñjñānarūpo maheśvaraḥ ..
namo brahmañjagatsraṣṭastadudbhava namo'stu te .. 67 ..
4.31.d:
स्वयमात्मा हि भगवाञ्ज्ञानरूपो महेश्वरः ॥
नमो ब्रह्मञ्जगत्स्रष्टस्तदुद्भव नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 67 ॥
4.31.m:
The Lord himself is the Self, Maheśvara in the form of knowledge.
Homage to Brahmā, the creator of the world! O you born from him, homage to you!

4.31.s:
sṛṣṭiḥ sarvaśarīreṣu dṛṣṭiśca yogināmapi ..
jagatsādhya durārādhya durnivāra namo'stu te ..68..
4.31.d:
सृष्टिः सर्वशरीरेषु दृष्टिश्च योगिनामपि ॥
जगत्साध्य दुराराध्य दुर्निवार नमोऽस्तु ते ॥68॥
4.31.m:
You are the procreative urge in all bodies, and the vision even of yogins.
O you who can subdue the world, difficult to worship, difficult to resist, homage to you!

4.31.s:
sarvājita jagajjetarjīva jīvamanohara..
ratibīja ratisvāminratipriya namo'stu te .. 69 ..
4.31.d:
सर्वाजित जगज्जेतर्जीव जीवमनोहर॥
रतिबीज रतिस्वामिन्रतिप्रिय नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 69 ॥
4.31.m:
Unconquered by all, conqueror of the world, vivifier, captivator of the living!
Seed of pleasure, lord of Rati, dear to Rati, homage to you!

4.31.s:
śaśvadyoṣidadhiṣṭhāna yoṣitprāṇādhikapriya ..
yoṣidvāhana yoṣāstra yoṣidbandho namo'stu te .. 4.31.70 ..
4.31.d:
शश्वद्योषिदधिष्ठान योषित्प्राणाधिकप्रिय ॥
योषिद्वाहन योषास्त्र योषिद्बन्धो नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 4.31.70 ॥
4.31.m:
Perpetual dwelling in women, dearer to women than life itself,
whose vehicle is woman, whose weapon is woman, friend of women, homage to you!

4.31.s:
patisādhyakarāśeṣarūpādhāra guṇāśraya ..
sugandhivātasaciva madhumitra namo'stu te .. 71 ..
4.31.d:
पतिसाध्यकराशेषरूपाधार गुणाश्रय ॥
सुगन्धिवातसचिव मधुमित्र नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 71 ॥
4.31.m:
Subduer of husbands, receptacle of all beauty, refuge of virtues,
having the fragrant breeze as minister, friend of Spring, homage to you!

4.31.s:
śaśvadyonikṛtādhāra strīsaṃdarśanavardhana ..
vidagdhānāṃ virahiṇāṃ prāṇāntaka namo'stu te .. 72 ..
4.31.d:
शश्वद्योनिकृताधार स्त्रीसंदर्शनवर्धन ॥
विदग्धानां विरहिणां प्राणान्तक नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 72 ॥
4.31.m:
Having a perpetual seat in the womb, increased by the sight of women,
ender of the lives of clever lovers separated [from their loves], homage to you!

4.31.s:
akṛpā yeṣu te'narthāsteṣāṃ jñānavināśanam ..
anūharūpabhakteṣu kṛpāsindho namo'stu te .. 73 ..
4.31.d:
अकृपा येषु तेऽनर्थास्तेषां ज्ञानविनाशनम् ॥
अनूहरूपभक्तेषु कृपासिन्धो नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 73 ॥
4.31.m:
Those upon whom you have no mercy suffer calamities, and their knowledge is destroyed;
O ocean of mercy to devotees whose forms are beyond conjecture, homage to you!

4.31.s:
tapasvināṃ ca tapasāṃ vighnabījāvalīlayā ..
manaḥ sakāmaṃ muktānāṃ kartuṃ śakta namo'stu te .. 74 ..
4.31.d:
तपस्विनां च तपसां विघ्नबीजावलीलया ॥
मनः सकामं मुक्तानां कर्तुं शक्त नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 74 ॥
4.31.m:
You sportively become the seed of obstacle to the austerities of ascetics;
able to make the mind of the liberated full of desire, homage to you!

4.31.s:
tapaḥsādhyāścārādhyāśca sadaivaṃ pāñcabhautikāḥ ..
pañcendriyakṛtādhāra pañcabāṇa namo'stu te .. 75 ..
4.31.d:
तपःसाध्याश्चाराध्याश्च सदैवं पाञ्चभौतिकाः ॥
पञ्चेन्द्रियकृताधार पञ्चबाण नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 75 ॥
4.31.m:
The beings made of the five elements are ever subdued and worshipped by austerity;
O you whose foundation is set in the five senses, five-arrowed one, homage to you!"

4.31.s:
mohinītyevamuktvā tu manasā sā vidheḥ puraḥ ..
virarāma namravaktrā babhūva dhyānatatparā .. 76 ..
4.31.d:
मोहिनीत्येवमुक्त्वा तु मनसा सा विधेः पुरः ॥
विरराम नम्रवक्त्रा बभूव ध्यानतत्परा ॥ 76 ॥
4.31.m:
Having thus spoken in her mind before the Creator, Mohinī
ceased, her face bowed, intent on meditation.

4.31.s:
uktaṃ mādhyaṃdine kānte stotrametanmanoharam ..
purā durvāsasā dattaṃ mohinyai gandhamādane .. 77 ..
4.31.d:
उक्तं माध्यंदिने कान्ते स्तोत्रमेतन्मनोहरम् ॥
पुरा दुर्वाससा दत्तं मोहिन्यै गन्धमादने ॥ 77 ॥
4.31.m:
This charming hymn was recited in the Mādhyandina [recension], beloved;
formerly it was given by Durvāsas to Mohinī on Mount Gandhamādana.

4.31.s:
stotrametanmahāpuṇyaṃ kāmī bhaktyā yadā paṭhet ..
abhīṣṭaṃ labhate nūnaṃ niṣkalaṅko bhaved dhruvam ..78..
4.31.d:
स्तोत्रमेतन्महापुण्यं कामी भक्त्या यदा पठेत् ॥
अभीष्टं लभते नूनं निष्कलङ्को भवेद् ध्रुवम् ॥78॥
4.31.m:
When a passionate person recites this greatly meritorious hymn with devotion,
he surely attains his desire and will certainly become blemishless.

4.31.s:
ceṣṭāṃ na kurute kāmaḥ kadācidapi taṃ priyam ..
bhavedarogī śrīyuktaḥ kāmadevasamaprabhaḥ ..
vanitāṃ labhate sādhvīṃ patnīṃ trailokyamohinīm .. 79 ..
4.31.d:
चेष्टां न कुरुते कामः कदाचिदपि तं प्रियम् ॥
भवेदरोगी श्रीयुक्तः कामदेवसमप्रभः ॥
वनितां लभते साध्वीं पत्नीं त्रैलोक्यमोहिनीम् ॥ 79 ॥

4.32.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
mohinīstavanenaiva kāmastuṣṭo babhūva ha ..
cakāra śarasaṃdhānamantarikṣe sthitaḥ svayam .. 1 ..
4.32.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
मोहिनीस्तवनेनैव कामस्तुष्टो बभूव ह ॥
चकार शरसंधानमन्तरिक्षे स्थितः स्वयम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.32.m: Kāma was pleased by that very praise from Mohinī;

4.32.s:
mantrapūtaṃ mahāstraṃ ca cikṣepa pitaraṃ mudā ..
babhūva cañcalo brahmā kāmāstreṇa ca kāmukaḥ .. 2 ..
4.32.d:
मन्त्रपूतं महास्त्रं च चिक्षेप पितरं मुदा ॥
बभूव चञ्चलो ब्रह्मा कामास्त्रेण च कामुकः ॥ 2 ॥

4.32.s:
kṣaṇaṃ nirīkṣaṇaṃ cakre mohinyāsye punaḥpunaḥ ..
jñānaṃ prāpya tadā dhātā virarāma hariṃ smaran ..3..
4.32.d:
क्षणं निरीक्षणं चक्रे मोहिन्यास्ये पुनःपुनः ॥
ज्ञानं प्राप्य तदा धाता विरराम हरिं स्मरन् ॥3॥

4.32.s:
bubudhe manasā sarvaṃ caritaṃ manmathasya ca ..
śaśāpa taṃ sutamapi vidhātā krodhavihvalaḥ .. 4 ..
4.32.d:
बुबुधे मनसा सर्वं चरितं मन्मथस्य च ॥
शशाप तं सुतमपि विधाता क्रोधविह्वलः ॥ 4 ॥

4.32.s:
he kāma yauvanonmatta mūḍhaiśvaryeṇa garvita ..
bhavitā darpabhaṅgaste gurorme helanāditi .. 5 ..
4.32.d:
हे काम यौवनोन्मत्त मूढैश्वर्येण गर्वित ॥
भविता दर्पभङ्गस्ते गुरोर्मे हेलनादिति ॥ 5 ॥

4.32.s:
hatodyamo jagāmāśu manmatho madhunā saha ..
brahmaṇaḥ śāpabhītaśca śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ .. 6 ..
4.32.d:
हतोद्यमो जगामाशु मन्मथो मधुना सह ॥
ब्रह्मणः शापभीतश्च शुष्ककण्ठोष्ठतालुकः ॥ 6 ॥

4.32.s:
ityuvāca jagaddhātā mohinīṃ madanāturām ..
caturvaktraṃ ca paśyantīṃ sasmitaṃ vakracakṣuṣā .. 7 ..
4.32.d:
इत्युवाच जगद्धाता मोहिनीं मदनातुराम् ॥
चतुर्वक्त्रं च पश्यन्तीं सस्मितं वक्रचक्षुषा ॥ 7 ॥

4.32.s:
brahmovāca ..
mātarmohini gaccha tvaṃ niṣphalaṃ karma cātra te ..
jñātastavābhiprāyaśca nāhaṃ yogyo'sya karmaṇaḥ .. 8 ..
4.32.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
मातर्मोहिनि गच्छ त्वं निष्फलं कर्म चात्र ते ॥
ज्ञातस्तवाभिप्रायश्च नाहं योग्योऽस्य कर्मणः ॥ 8 ॥

4.32.s:
vede jugupsitaṃ karma tadeva kartumakṣamaḥ ..
vedakartā svayamahaṃ vyavasthākārako bhave .. 9 ..
4.32.d:
वेदे जुगुप्सितं कर्म तदेव कर्तुमक्षमः ॥
वेदकर्ता स्वयमहं व्यवस्थाकारको भवे ॥ 9 ॥

4.32.s:
akīrtiṃ vedavaktuśca nindyaṃ ca kimataḥ param ..
upasthitā ca yā yoṣidatyājyā rāgiṇāmapi ..4.32.10..
4.32.d:
अकीर्तिं वेदवक्तुश्च निन्द्यं च किमतः परम् ॥
उपस्थिता च या योषिदत्याज्या रागिणामपि ॥4.32.10॥

4.32.s:
śrutau śrutamiti tyājyā sarvadaiva tapasvinām ..
aho sarvaiḥ parityājyā puṃścalī ca viśeṣataḥ .. 11 ..
4.32.d:
श्रुतौ श्रुतमिति त्याज्या सर्वदैव तपस्विनाम् ॥
अहो सर्वैः परित्याज्या पुंश्चली च विशेषतः ॥ 11 ॥

4.32.s:
dhanāyuḥprāṇayaśasāṃ nāśinī duḥkhadāyinī ..
svakāryatatparā śaśvatparakāryavināśinī ..12..
4.32.d:
धनायुःप्राणयशसां नाशिनी दुःखदायिनी ॥
स्वकार्यतत्परा शश्वत्परकार्यविनाशिनी ॥12॥

4.32.s:
niṣṭhurā navaghātibhyaḥ sarvāpadbījarūpiṇī ..
vidyuddīptirjale rekhā lobhānmaitrī yathā bhavet .. 13 ..
4.32.d:
निष्ठुरा नवघातिभ्यः सर्वापद्बीजरूपिणी ॥
विद्युद्दीप्तिर्जले रेखा लोभान्मैत्री यथा भवेत् ॥ 13 ॥

4.32.s:
paradrohādyathā saṃpatkulaṭāprema tatsamam ..
sarvebhyo hiṃsrajantubhyo vipadbījā sadaiva hi ..14..
4.32.d:
परद्रोहाद्यथा संपत्कुलटाप्रेम तत्समम् ॥
सर्वेभ्यो हिंस्रजन्तुभ्यो विपद्बीजा सदैव हि ॥14॥

4.32.s:
yo viśvasettāṃ saṃmūḍho vipattasya padepade ..
tvaṃ ca rūpavatī dhanyā vañcitā kāmukaiḥ sadā..15..
4.32.d:
यो विश्वसेत्तां संमूढो विपत्तस्य पदेपदे ॥
त्वं च रूपवती धन्या वञ्चिता कामुकैः सदा॥15॥

4.32.s:
yūnāṃ saṃpatsvarūpā ca viṣatulyā tapasvinām..
tvamevāpsarasāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvadā sthirayauvanā ..16..
4.32.d:
यूनां संपत्स्वरूपा च विषतुल्या तपस्विनाम्॥
त्वमेवाप्सरसां श्रेष्ठा सर्वदा स्थिरयौवना ॥16॥
4.32.m:
the embodiment of good fortune to youth, but poison to ascetics.
You are the foremost of apsarases, endowed with eternal youth.

4.32.s:
tavaiva karma yogyaṃ ca yuvānaṃ paśya sundari ..
tvaṃ vidagdhā ca yoṣitsu vidagdhānveṣaṇaṃ kuru .. 17 ..
4.32.d:
तवैव कर्म योग्यं च युवानं पश्य सुन्दरि ॥
त्वं विदग्धा च योषित्सु विदग्धान्वेषणं कुरु ॥ 17 ॥
4.32.m:
O beautiful woman, find a young man fit for your deeds;
clever among women as you are, seek out a clever man!

4.32.s:
vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo guṇavānbhavet ..
jarāturo'haṃ vṛddhaśca tapasvī vaiṣṇavo dvijaḥ ..18..
4.32.d:
विदग्धाया विदग्धेन संगमो गुणवान्भवेत् ॥
जरातुरोऽहं वृद्धश्च तपस्वी वैष्णवो द्विजः ॥18॥

4.32.s:
asvatantraḥ parādhīnaḥ kā ratiḥ puṃścalīṣu me ..
aye vatse gaccha śīghraṃ vihāya pitaraṃ ca mām ..19..
4.32.d:
अस्वतन्त्रः पराधीनः का रतिः पुंश्चलीषु मे ॥
अये वत्से गच्छ शीघ्रं विहाय पितरं च माम् ॥19॥
4.32.m: Go quickly, my child, leaving me, who am your father!

4.32.s:
nātrā'haṃ ca jagatsraṣṭā tasmāttava pitā sadā..
manmathaṃ caṃdramitraṃ ca jayantaṃ nalakūbaram .. 4.32.20 ..
4.32.d:
नात्राऽहं च जगत्स्रष्टा तस्मात्तव पिता सदा॥
मन्मथं चंद्रमित्रं च जयन्तं नलकूबरम् ॥ 4.32.20 ॥
4.32.m:
I am the creator of the world here; therefore I am always your father.
[Go to] Manmatha, to the Moon's friend, to Jayanta, to Nalakūbara,

4.32.s:
svarvaidyau caṃdratanayaṃ ditiputrāṃśca suṃdarān ..
kāmaśāstreṣu niṣṇātānratikarmaviśāradān .. .. 21 ..
4.32.d:
स्वर्वैद्यौ चंद्रतनयं दितिपुत्रांश्च सुंदरान् ॥
कामशास्त्रेषु निष्णातान्रतिकर्मविशारदान् ॥ ॥ 21 ॥
4.32.m:
to the two celestial physicians, to the Moon's son, and to the handsome sons of Diti—
who are learned in the treatises on love and skilled in the art of pleasure.

4.32.s:
yā māṃ yāsi hi tāṃstyaktvā sā vidagdhā ca kāmukī ..
sadā saṃbhogaviṣaye striyaṃ prārthayate pumān ..22 ..
4.32.d:
या मां यासि हि तांस्त्यक्त्वा सा विदग्धा च कामुकी ॥
सदा संभोगविषये स्त्रियं प्रार्थयते पुमान् ॥22 ॥
4.32.m:
Abandoning them, you come to me—that clever, lustful woman!
A man constantly solicits a woman for sexual pleasure;

4.32.s:
strī cetprayāti puruṣaṃ viparītaṃ viḍambanam ..
sarveṣāṃ caiva ratnānāṃ strīratnaṃ durlabhaṃ param ..23 ..
4.32.d:
स्त्री चेत्प्रयाति पुरुषं विपरीतं विडम्बनम् ॥
सर्वेषां चैव रत्नानां स्त्रीरत्नं दुर्लभं परम् ॥23 ॥
4.32.m:
if a woman approaches a man, it is an unnatural mockery.
Of all jewels, the jewel of a woman is the most rare;

4.32.s:
svayaṃ prārthayate svāmī na tu svāminameva ca..
yoṣijjātiṣu dhik tāśca svayaṃ yāḥ samupasthitāḥ..24..
4.32.d:
स्वयं प्रार्थयते स्वामी न तु स्वामिनमेव च॥
योषिज्जातिषु धिक् ताश्च स्वयं याः समुपस्थिताः॥24॥
4.32.m:
the master seeks it himself, and not the jewel the master.
Fie upon those among womankind who present themselves unasked!

4.32.s:
bhaveddūraṃ svalpamūlyaṃ ratnaṃ svayamupasthitam ..
nityaṃ pumānstriyaṃ yāti strī vā yāti ca na priyam .. 25 ..
4.32.d:
भवेद्दूरं स्वल्पमूल्यं रत्नं स्वयमुपस्थितम् ॥
नित्यं पुमान्स्त्रियं याति स्त्री वा याति च न प्रियम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.32.m:
A gem that presents itself unsought becomes cheap and of little value.
A man always goes to a woman, but a woman does not pursue a lover.

4.32.s:
lokācāreṣu vedeṣu na strī yāti parapriyam ..
svavastu bhuṅkte yaḥ kāle śāstroktavidhipūrvakam ..26..
4.32.d:
लोकाचारेषु वेदेषु न स्त्री याति परप्रियम् ॥
स्ववस्तु भुङ्क्ते यः काले शास्त्रोक्तविधिपूर्वकम् ॥26॥
4.32.m:
In worldly custom and in the Vedas, a woman does not approach another's beloved.
He who enjoys his own property at the proper time in accordance with scriptural injunctions

4.32.s:
sa pūjyo na bhavetpūjyo yadratiḥ paravastuṣu ..
kaḥ kasya śatrurabale niśāmaya jagattraye .. 27 ..
4.32.d:
स पूज्यो न भवेत्पूज्यो यद्रतिः परवस्तुषु ॥
कः कस्य शत्रुरबले निशामय जगत्त्रये ॥ 27 ॥
4.32.m:
is worthy of honor, but he whose delight is in the possessions of others cannot be honored.
Consider, O frail woman: who is whose enemy in the three worlds?

4.32.s:
svendriyāḥ śatravaḥ sarve śatrutā yannimittataḥ ..
vedoktācaraṇe sarvaṃ mitraṃ ca jagatāṃ jagat .. 28 ..
4.32.d:
स्वेन्द्रियाः शत्रवः सर्वे शत्रुता यन्निमित्ततः ॥
वेदोक्ताचरणे सर्वं मित्रं च जगतां जगत् ॥ 28 ॥
4.32.m:
One's own senses are all one's enemies, for enmity arises because of them.
When one acts according to the Vedas, the whole world of living beings is a friend;

4.32.s:
kṛte vedaviruddhe ca mitraṃ śatrurbhaveddhruvam ..
vedoktaṃ kṛtavantaṃ ca haristuṣṭo divāniśam .. 29 ..
4.32.d:
कृते वेदविरुद्धे च मित्रं शत्रुर्भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥
वेदोक्तं कृतवन्तं च हरिस्तुष्टो दिवानिशम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.32.m:
but when one acts against the Vedas, a friend surely becomes a foe.
Hari is pleased day and night with one who acts according to the Vedas;

4.32.s:
harau tuṣṭe jagattuṣṭaṃ tasminruṣṭe bhavo ripuḥ ..
kutrāsti kulaṭājātiḥ sādhvījātiśca kutra vā .. 4.32.30 ..
4.32.d:
हरौ तुष्टे जगत्तुष्टं तस्मिन्रुष्टे भवो रिपुः ॥
कुत्रास्ति कुलटाजातिः साध्वीजातिश्च कुत्र वा ॥ 4.32.30 ॥
4.32.m:
when Hari is pleased, the world is pleased, and when he is angry, existence itself is an enemy.
Where is the class of unchaste women, and where is the class of virtuous women?

4.32.s:
svakīyācaraṇātsarvaṃ bhave bhavati karmaṇaḥ ..
strījātiḥ prakṛteraṃśā nārāyaṇavinirmitā .. 31 ..
4.32.d:
स्वकीयाचरणात्सर्वं भवे भवति कर्मणः ॥
स्त्रीजातिः प्रकृतेरंशा नारायणविनिर्मिता ॥ 31 ॥
4.32.m:
Everything in this world arises from one's own conduct, from action.
Womankind is a portion of Prakṛti, fashioned by Nārāyaṇa;

4.32.s:
duḥśīlā puṃścalī nindyā suśīlā ca pativratā ..
pativratāstu trividhāḥ puṃścalīṣu ca yoṣitaḥ .. 32 ..
4.32.d:
दुःशीला पुंश्चली निन्द्या सुशीला च पतिव्रता ॥
पतिव्रतास्तु त्रिविधाः पुंश्चलीषु च योषितः ॥ 32 ॥
4.32.m:
one who is ill-behaved is a blameworthy, unchaste woman, while one of good conduct is a devoted wife.
There are three kinds of devoted wives, and among women there are unchaste ones;

4.32.s:
tāsāmevaṃvidhā nāsti svayaṃ yāti parapriyam ..
strījātīnāṃ ca madhye ca kā'styevaṃ kulakajjalā ..33..
4.32.d:
तासामेवंविधा नास्ति स्वयं याति परप्रियम् ॥
स्त्रीजातीनां च मध्ये च काऽस्त्येवं कुलकज्जला ॥33॥
4.32.m:
yet among them there is none such that goes of her own accord to another's beloved.
Who among the races of women is such a stain upon her family

4.32.s:
bhave ratyai svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā veṣaṃ kṛtvā prayāti tam ..
kṣobhitā yadi paśyantī bhakṣyadravyamasādhyakam .. ..34..
4.32.d:
भवे रत्यै स्वयं दृष्ट्वा वेषं कृत्वा प्रयाति तम् ॥
क्षोभिता यदि पश्यन्ती भक्ष्यद्रव्यमसाध्यकम् ॥ ॥34॥
4.32.m:
that, seeing him herself, she adorns herself and approaches him for sexual union?
If a woman is agitated upon seeing an unattainable edible object,

4.32.s:
vaikulyānnahi tatsādhyaṃ sāmānyameva kevalam ..
ityevamuktvā jagatāṃ vidhātā virarāma ca ..
vaktuṃ samudyatā sā ca kopaprasphuritādharā .. 35 ..
4.32.d:
वैकुल्यान्नहि तत्साध्यं सामान्यमेव केवलम् ॥
इत्येवमुक्त्वा जगतां विधाता विरराम च ॥
वक्तुं समुद्यता सा च कोपप्रस्फुरिताधरा ॥ 35 ॥
4.32.m:
it cannot be attained simply through agitation; it remains mere ordinary craving."
Having spoken thus, the Creator of the worlds ceased.
And she, her lower lip trembling with anger, prepared to speak.

4.32.s:
mohinyuvāca ..
jñātaṃ sarvaṃ jagaddhātaścaritaṃ tava sāṃpratam .. 36 ..
4.32.d:
मोहिन्युवाच ॥
ज्ञातं सर्वं जगद्धातश्चरितं तव सांप्रतम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.32.m: "O creator of the world, your conduct is now fully known to me!

4.32.s:
tvayā nibodhitā nītirmano me na sthiraṃ bhavet ..
bhūtaṃ tvayi viśiṣṭaṃ ca yāvaddṛṣṭaḥ kṣaṇe bhavān ..37..
4.32.d:
त्वया निबोधिता नीतिर्मनो मे न स्थिरं भवेत् ॥
भूतं त्वयि विशिष्टं च यावद्दृष्टः क्षणे भवान् ॥37॥
4.32.m:
Though taught by you in moral conduct, my mind cannot be steady;
it became deeply fixed upon you the very moment you were seen.

4.32.s:
tvadvaktradṛṣṭimātreṇa sarve jārāśca vismṛtāḥ ..
dehaṃ kāmāgninā dagdhaṃ yadā tyaktuṃ samudyatā .. 38 ..
4.32.d:
त्वद्वक्त्रदृष्टिमात्रेण सर्वे जाराश्च विस्मृताः ॥
देहं कामाग्निना दग्धं यदा त्यक्तुं समुद्यता ॥ 38 ॥
4.32.m:
By the mere sight of your face, all lovers were forgotten.
When I was about to abandon this body consumed by the fire of love,

4.32.s:
niṣiṣedha ca māṃ rambhā pradadau mantramīdṛśam ..
tadā kāmasahāyena tvatsamīpaṃ samāgatā ..39..
4.32.d:
निषिषेध च मां रम्भा प्रददौ मन्त्रमीदृशम् ॥
तदा कामसहायेन त्वत्समीपं समागता ॥39॥
4.32.m:
Rambhā stopped me and gave me such an incantation as this:
Then, with Kāma as my helper, I came into your presence.

4.32.s:
samadhustava śāpena sa jagāma hatodyamaḥ ..
aho gantumaśaktā'haṃ tvayā yadyapi bhartsitā .. 4.32.40 ..
4.32.d:
समधुस्तव शापेन स जगाम हतोद्यमः ॥
अहो गन्तुमशक्ताऽहं त्वया यद्यपि भर्त्सिता ॥ 4.32.40 ॥
4.32.m:
Together with Madhu, he departed, his effort foiled by your curse;
yet alas, I am unable to go, though rebuked by you.

4.32.s:
sarvāṅgeṣveva me jāḍyaṃ babhūva sāṃprataṃ vibho ..
kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho na māṃ hantuṃ tvamarhasi .. 41 ..
4.32.d:
सर्वाङ्गेष्वेव मे जाड्यं बभूव सांप्रतं विभो ॥
कृपां कुरु कृपासिन्धो न मां हन्तुं त्वमर्हसि ॥ 41 ॥
4.32.m:
Stiffness has come over all my limbs right now, O Lord!
Show mercy, O ocean of mercy; you should not destroy me.

4.32.s:
tavāśleṣaṇamātreṇa vijvarā'haṃ suniścitam ..
tvameva jagatāṃ dhātā kulaṭā'haṃ ca karmaṇā .. 42 ..
4.32.d:
तवाश्लेषणमात्रेण विज्वराऽहं सुनिश्चितम् ॥
त्वमेव जगतां धाता कुलटाऽहं च कर्मणा ॥ 42 ॥
4.32.m:
By your mere embrace I shall surely become free of fever.
You indeed are the creator of the worlds, and I am an unchaste woman by karma.

4.32.s:
santo garvaṃ na kurvanti karmasādhyāśca jīvinaḥ ..
kaścitprayāti yānena vahanti taṃ ca kecana ..43..
4.32.d:
सन्तो गर्वं न कुर्वन्ति कर्मसाध्याश्च जीविनः ॥
कश्चित्प्रयाति यानेन वहन्ति तं च केचन ॥43॥
4.32.m:
The virtuous do not feel pride, and living beings are governed by karma.
One travels by carriage, and others carry him;

4.32.s:
karaṃ gṛhṇāti nṛpatiḥ karmaṇā dadati prajāḥ ..
kaścitsiṃhāsanasthaśca nṛpamātraśca kaścana .. 44 ..
4.32.d:
करं गृह्णाति नृपतिः कर्मणा ददति प्रजाः ॥
कश्चित्सिंहासनस्थश्च नृपमात्रश्च कश्चन ॥ 44 ॥
4.32.m:
the king takes tax by karma, and the subjects pay it;
one sits upon a throne, and another is a mere king.

4.32.s:
karmaṇā vāhakāḥ kecitkecidvāhanapālakāḥ ..
sūkarījaṭharaṃ kaścinsaṃprayāti svakarmaṇā .. 45 ..
4.32.d:
कर्मणा वाहकाः केचित्केचिद्वाहनपालकाः ॥
सूकरीजठरं कश्चिन्संप्रयाति स्वकर्मणा ॥ 45 ॥
4.32.m:
By karma some are carriers, and some are drivers of mounts;
one enters the belly of a sow by one's own karma,

4.32.s:
kaścicchacyāśca jaṭharaṃ tava putrāśca kecana ..
kecitkṛtvā harerbhaktiṃ karmaṇā tasya pārṣadāḥ .. 46 ..
4.32.d:
कश्चिच्छच्याश्च जठरं तव पुत्राश्च केचन ॥
केचित्कृत्वा हरेर्भक्तिं कर्मणा तस्य पार्षदाः ॥ 46 ॥
4.32.m:
one enters the belly of Śacī, and others become your sons;
some, having offered devotion to Hari, become his attendants by karma;

4.32.s:
kecidbhavanti kṛmayo viṣṭhāyāṃ daivadoṣataḥ ..
svargaṃ prayānti rājendrāḥ kecicca svasvakarmaṇā .. 47 ..
4.32.d:
केचिद्भवन्ति कृमयो विष्ठायां दैवदोषतः ॥
स्वर्गं प्रयान्ति राजेन्द्राः केचिच्च स्वस्वकर्मणा ॥ 47 ॥
4.32.m:
some become worms in feces through the fault of destiny;
sovereign kings and some others go to heaven by their own karma;

4.32.s:
kecitprayānti narakaṃ viṇmūtre tatra pacyate ..
karmaṇā kaścidindrendraḥ surāṇāṃ pravaraḥ svayam..48..
4.32.d:
केचित्प्रयान्ति नरकं विण्मूत्रे तत्र पच्यते ॥
कर्मणा कश्चिदिन्द्रेन्द्रः सुराणां प्रवरः स्वयम्॥48॥
4.32.m:
some go to hell and are boiled there in feces and urine;
by karma one becomes the lord of Indras, himself the foremost of the gods;

4.32.s:
kecitsurā narāḥ kecitkecicca kṣudrajantavaḥ ..
kecicca karmaṇā viprā varṇaśreṣṭhā mahītale .. 49 ..
4.32.d:
केचित्सुरा नराः केचित्केचिच्च क्षुद्रजन्तवः ॥
केचिच्च कर्मणा विप्रा वर्णश्रेष्ठा महीतले ॥ 49 ॥
4.32.m:
some are gods, some are men, and some are petty creatures;
and by karma some are brāhmaṇas, the highest caste on earth;

4.32.s:
kecidbhūpā vaiśyaśūdrāḥ kecicca mlecchajātayaḥ..
kecitsvakarmaṇā prājñā jñānena sarvadarśinaḥ ..4.32.50..
4.32.d:
केचिद्भूपा वैश्यशूद्राः केचिच्च म्लेच्छजातयः॥
केचित्स्वकर्मणा प्राज्ञा ज्ञानेन सर्वदर्शिनः ॥4.32.50॥
4.32.m:
some are kings, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras, and some are outcaste tribes;
some, by their own karma, are wise, seeing everything through knowledge;

4.32.s:
kecinmūrkhāḥ kecidandhāḥ svāṅgahīnāśca kecana ..
kecicchāstraṃ bodhayanti śiṣyavargānsvakarmaṇā ..51..
4.32.d:
केचिन्मूर्खाः केचिदन्धाः स्वाङ्गहीनाश्च केचन ॥
केचिच्छास्त्रं बोधयन्ति शिष्यवर्गान्स्वकर्मणा ॥51॥
4.32.m:
some are fools, some are blind, and others are deficient in limbs;
some teach the scripture to groups of pupils by their own karma;

4.32.s:
kecitpaṭhanti sarvārthaṃ jānanti guruvaktrataḥ ..
bhavanti karmaṇā keciddehe sthāvarajaṅgame ..52..
4.32.d:
केचित्पठन्ति सर्वार्थं जानन्ति गुरुवक्त्रतः ॥
भवन्ति कर्मणा केचिद्देहे स्थावरजङ्गमे ॥52॥
4.32.m:
some read and understand the entire meaning from the mouth of a guru;
some, by karma, come to be in stationary and moving bodies;

4.32.s:
tapasvī navaghātī ca tvaṃ ca brahmā ca karmaṇā ..
kācitsvakarmaṇā sādhvī pūjyeha ca paratra ca ..53..
4.32.d:
तपस्वी नवघाती च त्वं च ब्रह्मा च कर्मणा ॥
काचित्स्वकर्मणा साध्वी पूज्येह च परत्र च ॥53॥
4.32.m:
an ascetic, a slayer of men, you, and Brahmā—all are by karma.
A woman is virtuous by her own karma, to be honoured here and in the hereafter;

4.32.s:
kācidveśyā tadāhāraṃ bhuṅkte kṛtvā'ṅga vikrayam ..
svarveśyā'haṃ surapure surabhogyā supūjitā ..54..
4.32.d:
काचिद्वेश्या तदाहारं भुङ्क्ते कृत्वाऽङ्ग विक्रयम् ॥
स्वर्वेश्याऽहं सुरपुरे सुरभोग्या सुपूजिता ॥54॥
4.32.m:
another is a courtesan, who eats her food having sold her body.
I am a courtesan of heaven in the city of the gods, enjoyed by the gods and highly revered,

4.32.s:
yeṣāmāliṅganenaiva karmaṇāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ bhavet ..
manaḥ svabhāvabījaṃ ca svabhāvaḥ karmabījakaḥ .. 99 ..
4.32.d:
येषामालिङ्गनेनैव कर्मणां खण्डनं भवेत् ॥
मनः स्वभावबीजं च स्वभावः कर्मबीजकः ॥ 99 ॥
4.32.m:
by whose mere embrace the [fruits of] deeds are destroyed.
The mind is the seed of one's nature, and one's nature is the seed of karma;

4.32.s:
tatkarmaphalabījaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ janako hariḥ ..
phalaṃ dadāti niyataṃ karmadvārā vibhuḥ svayam .. 56 ..
4.32.d:
तत्कर्मफलबीजं च सर्वेषां जनको हरिः ॥
फलं ददाति नियतं कर्मद्वारा विभुः स्वयम् ॥ 56 ॥
4.32.m:
the seed of the fruit of that karma, and the father of all, is Hari.
The Lord himself unfailingly bestows the fruit through karma;

4.32.s:
sarvebhyo balavānnityaṃ karmarūpī janārdanaḥ ..
kuto hetorniṃnditā'haṃ tvayaiva bhartsitā katham .. 57 ..
4.32.d:
सर्वेभ्यो बलवान्नित्यं कर्मरूपी जनार्दनः ॥
कुतो हेतोर्निंन्दिताऽहं त्वयैव भर्त्सिता कथम् ॥ 57 ॥
4.32.m:
Janārdana, in the form of karma, is ever stronger than all.
For what reason have I been reviled, and why rebuked by you alone?

4.32.s:
jagatsraṣṭurīśvarasya pādābjaṃ draṣṭumāgatā ..
svapne yasya padadvandvaṃ na hi paśyanti yoginaḥ .. 58 ..
4.32.d:
जगत्स्रष्टुरीश्वरस्य पादाब्जं द्रष्टुमागता ॥
स्वप्ने यस्य पदद्वन्द्वं न हि पश्यन्ति योगिनः ॥ 58 ॥
4.32.m:
I came to behold the lotus feet of the Lord, the creator of the world,
whose pair of feet yogins do not behold even in a dream.

4.32.s:
tamīśvaraṃ patiṃ kartumicchayā svayamāgatā ..
gatvā hi kasyacitsthānamaspṛśyeha paratra ca .. 59 ..
4.32.d:
तमीश्वरं पतिं कर्तुमिच्छया स्वयमागता ॥
गत्वा हि कस्यचित्स्थानमस्पृश्येह परत्र च ॥ 59 ॥
4.32.m:
I came of my own accord with the desire to make that Lord my husband.
Indeed, having gone to someone's place, [a woman] is untouchable here and in the hereafter;

4.32.s:
kasyacitpādarajasā yaśasā bhānti yoṣitaḥ ..
ityuktvā mohinī śīghraṃ gatvovāsa hareḥ puraḥ .. 4.32.60 ..
4.32.d:
कस्यचित्पादरजसा यशसा भान्ति योषितः ॥
इत्युक्त्वा मोहिनी शीघ्रं गत्वोवास हरेः पुरः ॥ 4.32.60 ॥
4.32.m:
by the dust of another's feet, women shine with renown.”
Having spoken thus, Mohinī quickly went and sat before Hari.

4.32.s:
svayaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ cakampe kulaṭābhayāt ..
sasmitā vakranayanā kāmabhāvaṃ cakāra ha .. 61 ..
4.32.d:
स्वयं विधाता जगतां चकम्पे कुलटाभयात् ॥
सस्मिता वक्रनयना कामभावं चकार ह ॥ 61 ॥
4.32.m:
The creator of the worlds himself trembled out of fear of the unchaste woman.
Smiling, with sidelong glances, she displayed passionate desire,

4.32.s:
svāṅgaṃ ca darśayāmāsa kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ..
etasminnantare kāmaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvayogavit .. 62 ..
4.32.d:
स्वाङ्गं च दर्शयामास कामबाणप्रपीडिता ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कामः सर्वज्ञः सर्वयोगवित् ॥ 62 ॥
4.32.m:
and, tormented by the arrows of Kāma, she displayed her own body.
At that moment Kāma, all-knowing and master of all yoga,

4.32.s:
āvirbhūya pañca bāṇānnicikṣepa ca brahmaṇi ..
sammohanaṃ samudvegaṃ bījastambhitakāraṇam .. 63 ..
4.32.d:
आविर्भूय पञ्च बाणान्निचिक्षेप च ब्रह्मणि ॥
सम्मोहनं समुद्वेगं बीजस्तम्भितकारणम् ॥ 63 ॥
4.32.m:
manifested himself and discharged five arrows at Brahmā:
the bewitching, the agitating, that which causes the semen to be held back,

4.32.s:
unmattabījaṃ jvaladaṃ śaśvaccetanahārakam ..
etānprakṣipya madano'pyantarikṣasthitaḥ svayam..64..
4.32.d:
उन्मत्तबीजं ज्वलदं शश्वच्चेतनहारकम् ॥
एतान्प्रक्षिप्य मदनोऽप्यन्तरिक्षस्थितः स्वयम्॥64॥
4.32.m: Discharging these, Madana himself, standing in the atmosphere,

4.32.s:
kiṃkarānpreṣayāmāsa saṃmohāya piturmudā ..
vasantaṃ kokilālīśca gandhavātaṃ manoharam .. 65 ..
4.32.d:
किंकरान्प्रेषयामास संमोहाय पितुर्मुदा ॥
वसन्तं कोकिलालीश्च गन्धवातं मनोहरम् ॥ 65 ॥
4.32.m:
joyfully sent forth his servants to bewilder his father:
Spring, flocks of cuckoos, and the enchanting fragrant breeze.

4.32.s:
niyujyābhyantaraṃ gatvā tadvikāraṃ cakāra ha ..
puṃskokilaḥ kalaṃ rāvamuvāca tatsamīpataḥ...
ṣaṭpadaḥ sundaraṃ sūkṣmaṃ juguñje purataḥ sthitaḥ..
śaśvadvavau gandhavaho mando'tiśītalaḥ priye .. 67 ..
4.32.d:
नियुज्याभ्यन्तरं गत्वा तद्विकारं चकार ह ॥
पुंस्कोकिलः कलं रावमुवाच तत्समीपतः॥।
षट्पदः सुन्दरं सूक्ष्मं जुगुञ्जे पुरतः स्थितः॥
शश्वद्ववौ गन्धवहो मन्दोऽतिशीतलः प्रिये ॥ 67 ॥

4.32.s:
satataṃ muditastatra babhrāma ca madhuḥ svayam ..
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo babhūva jagatāṃ vidhiḥ .. 68 ..
4.32.d:
सततं मुदितस्तत्र बभ्राम च मधुः स्वयम् ॥
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वाङ्गो बभूव जगतां विधिः ॥ 68 ॥
4.32.m:
and Madhu himself roamed there constantly rejoicing.
All the limbs of the creator of the worlds bristled with horripilation;

4.32.s:
dadarśa mohinī bhāvaṃ prahasya ca punaḥ punaḥ ..
atīva vakranayanā kāmāstrahatacetanā .. 69..
4.32.d:
ददर्श मोहिनी भावं प्रहस्य च पुनः पुनः ॥
अतीव वक्रनयना कामास्त्रहतचेतना ॥ 69॥
4.32.m:
and Mohinī, laughing again and again, gazed upon his emotion.
with extremely sidelong glances, her mind struck by the arrows of love.

4.32.s:
vidhātā bubudhe sarvaṃ sarvabandhanibandhanam..
niyantuṃ na manaḥ śaktaḥ sasmāra śrīhariṃ bhiyā .. 4.32.70 ..
4.32.d:
विधाता बुबुधे सर्वं सर्वबन्धनिबन्धनम्॥
नियन्तुं न मनः शक्तः सस्मार श्रीहरिं भिया ॥ 4.32.70 ॥
4.32.m:
The Creator understood everything, the cause of binding all beings.
Unable to restrain his mind, out of fear he remembered Śrī Hari.

4.32.s:
tuṣṭāva manasā kṛṣṇaṃ śāntaṃ hṛtpaṅkajasthitam ..
dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ hariṃ pītāmbaraṃ param .. 71 ..
4.32.d:
तुष्टाव मनसा कृष्णं शान्तं हृत्पङ्कजस्थितम् ॥
द्विभुजं मुरलीहस्तं हरिं पीताम्बरं परम् ॥ 71 ॥
4.32.m:
In his mind he praised Kṛṣṇa, tranquil and situated in the lotus of the heart:
two-armed, flute in hand, Hari clad in yellow garments, supreme,

4.32.s:
atīva kamanīyaṃ ca kiśoraṃ sthirayauvanam ..
ratnālaṃkārabhūṣāḍhyaṃ sasmitaṃ śyāmasundaram .. 72 ..
4.32.d:
अतीव कमनीयं च किशोरं स्थिरयौवनम् ॥
रत्नालंकारभूषाढ्यं सस्मितं श्यामसुन्दरम् ॥ 72 ॥
4.32.m:
exceedingly charming, youthful, possessing constant youth,
richly adorned with jewel ornaments, smiling, dark and handsome.

4.32.s:
brahmovāca ..
rakṣa rakṣa hare māṃ ca nimagnaṃ kāmasāgare ..
duṣkīrtijalapūrṇe ca duṣpāre bahusaṃkaṭe .. 73 ..
4.32.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
रक्ष रक्ष हरे मां च निमग्नं कामसागरे ॥
दुष्कीर्तिजलपूर्णे च दुष्पारे बहुसंकटे ॥ 73 ॥
4.32.m:
Protect, protect me, O Hari, sunken in the ocean of desire,
filled with the waters of ill fame, impassable, and full of great dangers;

4.32.s:
bhaktivismṛtibīje ca vipatsopānadustare ..
atīva nirmalajñānacakṣuḥprachannakāraṇe .. 74 ..
4.32.d:
भक्तिविस्मृतिबीजे च विपत्सोपानदुस्तरे ॥
अतीव निर्मलज्ञानचक्षुःप्रछन्नकारणे ॥ 74 ॥
4.32.m:
the seed of forgetting devotion, an insurmountable flight of steps to calamity,
the cause of veiling the exceedingly clear eye of knowledge;

4.32.s:
janmormisaṃghasahite yoṣinnakraughasaṃkule ..
ratisrotaḥsamāyukte gaṃbhīre ghora eva ca .. 75 ..
4.32.d:
जन्मोर्मिसंघसहिते योषिन्नक्रौघसंकुले ॥
रतिस्रोतःसमायुक्ते गंभीरे घोर एव च ॥ 75 ॥
4.32.m:
accompanied by waves of rebirths, swarming with crocodiles in the form of women,
joined with the currents of sexual passion, deep and truly terrible;

4.32.s:
prathamāmṛtarūpe ca pariṇāmaviṣālaye ..
yamālayapradeśāya muktidvārātivismṛte..76..
4.32.d:
प्रथमामृतरूपे च परिणामविषालये ॥
यमालयप्रदेशाय मुक्तिद्वारातिविस्मृते॥76॥
4.32.m:
having the form of nectar at first, but in the end an abode of poison;
leading to the realm of Yama, utterly forgetting the door to liberation!

4.32.s:
buddhyā taraṇyā vijñānairuddharāsmānataḥ svayam ..
svayaṃ ca tvaṃ karṇadhāraḥ prasīda madhusūdana ..77..
4.32.d:
बुद्ध्या तरण्या विज्ञानैरुद्धरास्मानतः स्वयम् ॥
स्वयं च त्वं कर्णधारः प्रसीद मधुसूदन ॥77॥
4.32.m:
By the boat of intellect and by insights, rescue us yourself from this;
and you yourself be the helmsman. Be gracious, O Madhusūdana!

4.32.s:
madvidhāḥ katicinnātha niyojyā bhavakarmaṇi..
santi viśveśa vidhayo he viśveśvara mādhava .. 78 ..
4.32.d:
मद्विधाः कतिचिन्नाथ नियोज्या भवकर्मणि॥
सन्ति विश्वेश विधयो हे विश्वेश्वर माधव ॥ 78 ॥
4.32.m:
How many creators like me, O Lord, are to be appointed to the work of worldly existence?
There are many such creators, O Lord of the universe, O Sovereign of the universe, O Mādhava!

4.32.s:
na karmakṣetramevedaṃ brahmaloko'yamīpsitaḥ ..
tathāpi naḥ spṛhā kāme tvadbhaktivyavadhāyake..79 ..
4.32.d:
न कर्मक्षेत्रमेवेदं ब्रह्मलोकोऽयमीप्सितः ॥
तथापि नः स्पृहा कामे त्वद्भक्तिव्यवधायके॥79 ॥
4.32.m:
This is certainly not the field of action; this is Brahmaloka, the desired realm.
Even so, we feel desire for passion, which creates an obstruction to devotion to you.

4.32.s:
he nātha karuṇāsindho dīnabandho kṛpāṃ kuru ..
tvaṃ maheśa mahājñātā duḥsvapnaṃ māṃ na darśaya .. 4.32.80 ..
4.32.d:
हे नाथ करुणासिन्धो दीनबन्धो कृपां कुरु ॥
त्वं महेश महाज्ञाता दुःस्वप्नं मां न दर्शय ॥ 4.32.80 ॥
4.32.m: You are the Great Lord, the knower of all: do not show me an evil dream.

4.32.s:
ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā virarāma sanātanaḥ ..
dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ matpadābjaṃ śaśvatsasmāra māmiti .. 81 ..
4.32.d:
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां धाता विरराम सनातनः ॥
ध्यायंध्यायं मत्पदाब्जं शश्वत्सस्मार मामिति ॥ 81 ॥
4.32.m:
Having spoken thus, the eternal Creator of the worlds fell silent.
Meditating repeatedly on my lotus feet, he constantly remembered me in this way.

4.32.s:
brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ stotraṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ paṭhet ..
sa caivākarṇya viṣaye na nimagno bhaveddhruvam .. 82 ..
4.32.d:
ब्रह्मणा च कृतं स्तोत्रं भक्तियुक्तश्च यः पठेत् ॥
स चैवाकर्ण्य विषये न निमग्नो भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ 82 ॥
4.32.m:
Whoever, endowed with devotion, recites the hymn of praise composed by Brahmā,
and even having heard it, will certainly not sink into sense objects.

4.32.s:
mama māyāṃ vinirjitya saṃjñānaṃ labhate dhruvam ..
iha loke bhaktiyukto madbhaktapravaro bhavet .. 83 ..
4.32.d:
मम मायां विनिर्जित्य संज्ञानं लभते ध्रुवम् ॥
इह लोके भक्तियुक्तो मद्भक्तप्रवरो भवेत् ॥ 83 ॥
4.32.m:
Having conquered my illusion, he surely attains true knowledge.
In this world, endowed with devotion, he becomes foremost among my devotees.

4.33.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
kṛtvā brahmā hareḥ stotraṃ tasthau tasyāḥ samīpataḥ ..
manomattagajendraṃ ca kāmāsaktaṃ nivārayan .. 1 ..
4.33.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
कृत्वा ब्रह्मा हरेः स्तोत्रं तस्थौ तस्याः समीपतः ॥
मनोमत्तगजेन्द्रं च कामासक्तं निवारयन् ॥ 1 ॥

4.33.s:
divyajñānāṃkuśe naiva mayā dattena rādhike ..
uvāca mohinī taṃ ca parihāsaparaṃ vacaḥ .. 2 ..
4.33.d:
दिव्यज्ञानांकुशे नैव मया दत्तेन राधिके ॥
उवाच मोहिनी तं च परिहासपरं वचः ॥ 2 ॥

4.33.s:
mohinyuvāca .. iṅgitenaiva nārīṇāṃ sadyo mattaṃ bhavenmanaḥ ..
karotyākṛṣya saṃbhogaṃ yaḥ sa evottamo vibho .. 3 ..
4.33.d:
मोहिन्युवाच ॥ इङ्गितेनैव नारीणां सद्यो मत्तं भवेन्मनः ॥
करोत्याकृष्य संभोगं यः स एवोत्तमो विभो ॥ 3 ॥

4.33.s:
jñātvā sphuṭamabhiprāyaṃ nāryā saṃpreṣito hi yaḥ ..
paścātkaroti śṛṅgāraṃ puruṣaḥ sa ca madhyamaḥ .. 4 ..
4.33.d:
ज्ञात्वा स्फुटमभिप्रायं नार्या संप्रेषितो हि यः ॥
पश्चात्करोति शृङ्गारं पुरुषः स च मध्यमः ॥ 4 ॥

4.33.s:
punaḥpunaḥ preṣitaśca striyā kāmārtayā ca yaḥ ..
tayā na lipto rahasi sa klībo na pumānaho ..5..
4.33.d:
पुनःपुनः प्रेषितश्च स्त्रिया कामार्तया च यः ॥
तया न लिप्तो रहसि स क्लीबो न पुमानहो ॥5॥

4.33.s:
gṛhī tapasvī kāmī vā tyajetstriyamupasthitām ..
vrajetparatra narakamapūjyaśca bhavediha ..6..
4.33.d:
गृही तपस्वी कामी वा त्यजेत्स्त्रियमुपस्थिताम् ॥
व्रजेत्परत्र नरकमपूज्यश्च भवेदिह ॥6॥

4.33.s:
naṣṭaśrīrbhraṣṭarūpaśca bhraṣṭabuddhirbhaved dhruvam..
sa sadyaḥ klībatāṃ yāti brahmañchāpena yoṣitaḥ..7..
4.33.d:
नष्टश्रीर्भ्रष्टरूपश्च भ्रष्टबुद्धिर्भवेद् ध्रुवम्॥
स सद्यः क्लीबतां याति ब्रह्मञ्छापेन योषितः॥7॥

4.33.s:
uttiṣṭha jagatīnātha pāraṃ kuru smarārṇave ..
nimagnāṃ dustare ghore karṇadhāra bhayānake ..8..
4.33.d:
उत्तिष्ठ जगतीनाथ पारं कुरु स्मरार्णवे ॥
निमग्नां दुस्तरे घोरे कर्णधार भयानके ॥8॥

4.33.s:
atīva nirjanasthāne sarvajantuvivarjite ..
sugandhivāyunā ramye puṃskokilarutaśrute .. 9 ..
4.33.d:
अतीव निर्जनस्थाने सर्वजन्तुविवर्जिते ॥
सुगन्धिवायुना रम्ये पुंस्कोकिलरुतश्रुते ॥ 9 ॥

4.33.s:
satataṃ tvanmanaskāṃ māṃ dāsīṃ janmani janmani ..
krīṇīhi ratipaṇyenāmūlyaratnena satvaram ..4.33.10 ..
4.33.d:
सततं त्वन्मनस्कां मां दासीं जन्मनि जन्मनि ॥
क्रीणीहि रतिपण्येनामूल्यरत्नेन सत्वरम् ॥4.33.10 ॥

4.33.s:
ityuktvā mohinī sadyo jagatsraṣṭuśca brahmaṇaḥ ..
vicakarṣa varaṃ vastraṃ sasmitā kāmavihvalā .. 11 ..
4.33.d:
इत्युक्त्वा मोहिनी सद्यो जगत्स्रष्टुश्च ब्रह्मणः ॥
विचकर्ष वरं वस्त्रं सस्मिता कामविह्वला ॥ 11 ॥

4.33.s:
vijñāya samayaṃ dhātā tāmuvāca bhayāturaḥ ..
pīyūṣatulyaṃ vacanaṃ varaṃ vinayapūrvakam .. 12 ..
4.33.d:
विज्ञाय समयं धाता तामुवाच भयातुरः ॥
पीयूषतुल्यं वचनं वरं विनयपूर्वकम् ॥ 12 ॥

4.33.s:
brahmovāca ..
śṛṇu mohini madvākyaṃ satyasāraṃ hitaṃ sphuṭam ..
na kuru tvaṃ ca trailokye strījātīnāmapatrapām .. 13 ..
4.33.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
शृणु मोहिनि मद्वाक्यं सत्यसारं हितं स्फुटम् ॥
न कुरु त्वं च त्रैलोक्ये स्त्रीजातीनामपत्रपाम् ॥ 13 ॥

4.33.s:
tyaja māmambike putraṃ vṛddhaṃ niṣkāmameva ca ..
tvatkarmayogyarasikaṃ yuvānaṃ paśya susmite .. 14 ..
4.33.d:
त्यज मामम्बिके पुत्रं वृद्धं निष्काममेव च ॥
त्वत्कर्मयोग्यरसिकं युवानं पश्य सुस्मिते ॥ 14 ॥

4.33.s:
niṣekāllabhate patnī guruṃ bhartuḥ śubhāśubham ..
mantraśilpamapatyaṃ ca sarvametanna yatnataḥ .. 15 ..
4.33.d:
निषेकाल्लभते पत्नी गुरुं भर्तुः शुभाशुभम् ॥
मन्त्रशिल्पमपत्यं च सर्वमेतन्न यत्नतः ॥ 15 ॥

4.33.s:
tvayā saha mama rate nibandho nāsti suvrate ..
kṣudraṃ mahadvā yatkarma sarvadaivanibandhakam ..16..
4.33.d:
त्वया सह मम रते निबन्धो नास्ति सुव्रते ॥
क्षुद्रं महद्वा यत्कर्म सर्वदैवनिबन्धकम् ॥16॥

4.33.s:
ityuktavantaṃ brahmāṇaṃ smarantaṃ matpadāmbujam..
vicakarṣa punarveśyā kāmena hatacetanā ..17..
4.33.d:
इत्युक्तवन्तं ब्रह्माणं स्मरन्तं मत्पदाम्बुजम्॥
विचकर्ष पुनर्वेश्या कामेन हतचेतना ॥17॥

4.33.s:
etasminnantare śīghraṃ sthānaṃ tatsumanoharam..
ājagmurmunayaḥ sarve jvalanto brahmatejasā ..18..
4.33.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शीघ्रं स्थानं तत्सुमनोहरम्॥
आजग्मुर्मुनयः सर्वे ज्वलन्तो ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥18॥

4.33.s:
atriḥ pulastyaḥ pulaho vasiṣṭhaḥ kraturaṃgirāḥ..
bhṛgurmarīciḥ kapilo voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho ruciḥ .. 19 ..
4.33.d:
अत्रिः पुलस्त्यः पुलहो वसिष्ठः क्रतुरंगिराः॥
भृगुर्मरीचिः कपिलो वोढुः पञ्चशिखो रुचिः ॥ 19 ॥

4.33.s:
āsuriśca pracetāśca svayaṃ śukro bṛhaspatiḥ ..
utathyaḥ karakaḥ kaṇvaḥ kaśyapo gautamastathā .. 4.33.20 ..
4.33.d:
आसुरिश्च प्रचेताश्च स्वयं शुक्रो बृहस्पतिः ॥
उतथ्यः करकः कण्वः कश्यपो गौतमस्तथा ॥ 4.33.20 ॥

4.33.s:
sanakaśca sanandaśca kardamaśca sanātanaḥ ..
sanatkumāro bhagavānyogināṃ paramo guruḥ .. 21 ..
4.33.d:
सनकश्च सनन्दश्च कर्दमश्च सनातनः ॥
सनत्कुमारो भगवान्योगिनां परमो गुरुः ॥ 21 ॥

4.33.s:
śātātapaḥ pippalaśca śaṃkuḥ śukraḥ parāśaraḥ ..
mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca mṛkaṇḍuścyavanastathā .. 22 ..
4.33.d:
शातातपः पिप्पलश्च शंकुः शुक्रः पराशरः ॥
मार्कण्डेयो लोमशश्च मृकण्डुश्च्यवनस्तथा ॥ 22 ॥

4.33.s:
durvāsāśca jaratkārurāstīkaśca vibhāṇḍakaḥ ..
ṛṣyaśṛṅgo bharadvājo vāmadevaśca kauśikaḥ .. 23 ..
4.33.d:
दुर्वासाश्च जरत्कारुरास्तीकश्च विभाण्डकः ॥
ऋष्यशृङ्गो भरद्वाजो वामदेवश्च कौशिकः ॥ 23 ॥

4.33.s:
dṛṣṭvaitāṃśca taponiṣṭhānāgatāṃśca munīśvarān ..
tatyāja mohinī śīghraṃ vrīḍayā kamalodbhavam .. 24 ..
4.33.d:
दृष्ट्वैतांश्च तपोनिष्ठानागतांश्च मुनीश्वरान् ॥
तत्याज मोहिनी शीघ्रं व्रीडया कमलोद्भवम् ॥ 24 ॥

4.33.s:
tatrovāsa jagaddhātā taddhāmapārśvataśca sā ..
praṇemurmunayastaṃ ca bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ .. 25 ..
4.33.d:
तत्रोवास जगद्धाता तद्धामपार्श्वतश्च सा ॥
प्रणेमुर्मुनयस्तं च भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धराः ॥ 25 ॥

4.33.s:
āśiṣaṃ yuyuje brahmā vāsayāmāsa tānvibhuḥ ..
teṣu madhye prajajvāla yathā tārāsu candramāḥ .. 26 ..
4.33.d:
आशिषं युयुजे ब्रह्मा वासयामास तान्विभुः ॥
तेषु मध्ये प्रजज्वाल यथा तारासु चन्द्रमाः ॥ 26 ॥
4.33.m: The almighty Brahmā bestowed blessings and had them be seated;

4.33.s:
papracchurmunayo devaṃ kathameṣā tavāntike..
svarveśyānāṃ ca pravarā mohinītyevameva ca .. 27 ..
4.33.d:
पप्रच्छुर्मुनयो देवं कथमेषा तवान्तिके॥
स्वर्वेश्यानां च प्रवरा मोहिनीत्येवमेव च ॥ 27 ॥

4.33.s:
śrutvā munīnāṃ vacanamuvāca tānprajāpatiḥ ..
strījātīnāṃ ca vacanaṃ lajjācchādanameva ca .. 28 ..
4.33.d:
श्रुत्वा मुनीनां वचनमुवाच तान्प्रजापतिः ॥
स्त्रीजातीनां च वचनं लज्जाच्छादनमेव च ॥ 28 ॥
4.33.m: words concealing the shame of womankind: // 28

4.33.s:
.. brahmovāca ..
apūrvaṃ nṛtyagītaṃ ca ciraṃ kṛtvā śubhāvahā ..
uvāseyaṃ pariśrāntā yathā kanyā pituḥ puraḥ ..
ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā jahāsa muni saṃsadi .. 29 ..
4.33.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
अपूर्वं नृत्यगीतं च चिरं कृत्वा शुभावहा ॥
उवासेयं परिश्रान्ता यथा कन्या पितुः पुरः ॥
इत्युक्त्वा जगतां धाता जहास मुनि संसदि ॥ 29 ॥
4.33.m:
"Having performed an unprecedented dance and song for a long time, this auspicious woman
has sat down exhausted, like a daughter before her father."
Having spoken thus, the Creator of the worlds laughed in the assembly of sages. // 29

4.33.s:
jahasurmunayaḥ sarve sarvajñāstatra rādhike ..
sarvaṃ rahasyaṃ vijñāya jagatsraṣṭuśca mānasam .. 4.33.30 ..
4.33.d:
जहसुर्मुनयः सर्वे सर्वज्ञास्तत्र राधिके ॥
सर्वं रहस्यं विज्ञाय जगत्स्रष्टुश्च मानसम् ॥ 4.33.30 ॥
4.33.m:
All the omniscient sages laughed there, O Rādhikā,
knowing the whole secret and the mind of the creator of the world. // 30

4.33.s:
sadyaścukopa kulaṭā hāsyavyājena saṃsadi ..
sarvāṅgakampamānā sā kulaṭā kuṭilānanā .. 31 ..
4.33.d:
सद्यश्चुकोप कुलटा हास्यव्याजेन संसदि ॥
सर्वाङ्गकम्पमाना सा कुलटा कुटिलानना ॥ 31 ॥
4.33.m:
Immediately the wanton woman flew into a rage at the pretext of laughter in the assembly;
her whole body trembling, that unchaste woman with a contorted face, // 31

4.33.s:
raktapaṅkajanetrā ca kopaprasphuritādharā ..
utthāya ca sabhāmadhye teṣāṃ ca purataḥ sthitā ..
saṃbodhyovāca brahmāṇaṃ mṛtyukanyā yathā ruṣā .. 32 ..
4.33.d:
रक्तपङ्कजनेत्रा च कोपप्रस्फुरिताधरा ॥
उत्थाय च सभामध्ये तेषां च पुरतः स्थिता ॥
संबोध्योवाच ब्रह्माणं मृत्युकन्या यथा रुषा ॥ 32 ॥
4.33.m:
her eyes like red lotuses and her lips quivering with anger,
stood up in the midst of the assembly before them,
and addressing Brahmā, she spoke in fury like the daughter of Death: // 32

4.33.s:
mohinyuvāca ..
aye brahmañjagannātha vedakartā tvameva ca .. 33 ..
4.33.d:
मोहिन्युवाच ॥
अये ब्रह्मञ्जगन्नाथ वेदकर्ता त्वमेव च ॥ 33 ॥
4.33.m: "O Brahmā, lord of the world! You alone are the author of the Vedas. // 33

4.33.s:
kiṃ vā vedapraṇihitaṃ karma kiṃ tadviparyayam ..
vicāraṃ manasā svena kuru vedavidāṃ guro .. 34 ..
4.33.d:
किं वा वेदप्रणिहितं कर्म किं तद्विपर्ययम् ॥
विचारं मनसा स्वेन कुरु वेदविदां गुरो ॥ 34 ॥
4.33.m:
What action is ordained by the Vedas, and what is its opposite?
Consider this in your own mind, O guru of those who know the Vedas! // 34

4.33.s:
svakanyāyāṃ yatspṛhā sa kathaṃ hasasi nartakīm ..
nirmitā'hamīśvareṇa svarveśyā sarvagāminī .. 35..
4.33.d:
स्वकन्यायां यत्स्पृहा स कथं हससि नर्तकीम् ॥
निर्मिताऽहमीश्वरेण स्वर्वेश्या सर्वगामिनी ॥ 35॥
4.33.m:
You who had desire for your own daughter—how can you laugh at a dancing girl?
I was created by the Lord as a heavenly courtesan accessible to all. // 35

4.33.s:
satāṃ karma viruddhaṃ yattadatyantaviḍambanam ..
dāsītulyāṃ vinītāṃ ca daivena śaraṇāgatām .. 36 ..
4.33.d:
सतां कर्म विरुद्धं यत्तदत्यन्तविडम्बनम् ॥
दासीतुल्यां विनीतां च दैवेन शरणागताम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.33.m:
When righteous men do contrary deeds, that is an utter mockery.
Because you laugh in pride at me, who am humble like a servant-maid

4.33.s:
yato hasasi garveṇa tato'pūjyo bhavāciram ..
acirāddarpabhaṅgaṃ te kariṣyati hariḥ svayam .. 37 ..
4.33.d:
यतो हससि गर्वेण ततोऽपूज्यो भवाचिरम् ॥
अचिराद्दर्पभङ्गं ते करिष्यति हरिः स्वयम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.33.m:
and who came to you for refuge by fate, therefore you shall soon become unworthy of worship!
Before long, Hari himself will shatter your pride! // 37

4.33.s:
nibodha vacanaṃ brahmanveśyāyāśca tu sāṃpratam ..
tavaiva vacanaṃ stotraṃ gṛhṇāti yo naraḥ sadā .. 38 ..
4.33.d:
निबोध वचनं ब्रह्मन्वेश्यायाश्च तु सांप्रतम् ॥
तवैव वचनं स्तोत्रं गृह्णाति यो नरः सदा ॥ 38 ॥
4.33.m:
Now understand the word of a courtesan, O Brahmā!
Whatever man constantly receives your word or your hymn of praise, // 38

4.33.s:
bhavitā tasya vighnaśca sa yāsyatyupahāsyatām ..
bhavitā vārṣikī pūjā devatānāṃ yugeyuge .. 39 ..
4.33.d:
भविता तस्य विघ्नश्च स यास्यत्युपहास्यताम् ॥
भविता वार्षिकी पूजा देवतानां युगेयुगे ॥ 39 ॥
4.33.m:
for him there shall be obstacle, and he shall become an object of ridicule!
There will be annual worship of the deities in age after age, // 39

4.33.s:
tava māghyāṃ ca saṃkrāntyāṃ na bhaviṣyati sā punaḥ ..
kalpāntare'tra kalpe vā dehe dehāṃtare'tra vā .. 4.33.40 ..
4.33.d:
तव माघ्यां च संक्रान्त्यां न भविष्यति सा पुनः ॥
कल्पान्तरेऽत्र कल्पे वा देहे देहांतरेऽत्र वा ॥ 4.33.40 ॥
4.33.m:
but yours, on the saṃkrānti of Māgha, shall never happen again!
In another aeon or in this aeon, in this body or in another body, // 40

4.33.s:
punaḥ pūjā na bhavitā yā gatā sā gataiva ca ..
ityuktvā mohinī śīghraṃ jagāma madanālayam .. 41 ..
4.33.d:
पुनः पूजा न भविता या गता सा गतैव च ॥
इत्युक्त्वा मोहिनी शीघ्रं जगाम मदनालयम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.33.m:
there will be no worship for you again; that which is gone is gone indeed!"
Having spoken thus, Mohinī quickly went to the abode of the god of love. // 41

4.33.s:
tena sārddhaṃ ratiṃ kṛtvā babhūva vijvarā punaḥ ..
paścātsā cetanāṃ prāpya vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ punaḥ .. 42 ..
4.33.d:
तेन सार्द्धं रतिं कृत्वा बभूव विज्वरा पुनः ॥
पश्चात्सा चेतनां प्राप्य विललाप भृशं पुनः ॥ 42 ॥
4.33.m:
Having enjoyed pleasure with him, she became free of her fever again;
afterwards, regaining her senses, she wept bitterly once more. // 42

4.33.s:
ayaṃ kathaṃ mayā śapto jagadvidhiratipriyaḥ ..
svarveśyāyāṃ gatāyāṃ ca munayo duḥkhitā bhṛśam .. 43 ..
4.33.d:
अयं कथं मया शप्तो जगद्विधिरतिप्रियः ॥
स्वर्वेश्यायां गतायां च मुनयो दुःखिता भृशम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.33.m:
"Why was this creator of the universe, so very dear [to me], cursed by me?"
And when the heavenly courtesan had departed, the sages were greatly grieved; / 43

4.33.s:
svayaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ cakampe natakandharaḥ ..
upāyaṃ munayastasmai daduḥ kalyāṇakāriṇaḥ .. 44 ..
4.33.d:
स्वयं विधाता जगतां चकम्पे नतकन्धरः ॥
उपायं मुनयस्तस्मै ददुः कल्याणकारिणः ॥ 44 ॥
4.33.m:
The Creator of the worlds himself trembled with a bowed neck.
The sages, working his welfare, gave him a means [of remedy]: / 44

4.33.s:
śaraṇaṃ vraja vaikuṇṭhamityuktvā te gṛhānyayuḥ ..
brahmā jagāma śaraṇaṃ mama mūrtyantaraṃ param .. 45 ..
4.33.d:
शरणं व्रज वैकुण्ठमित्युक्त्वा ते गृहान्ययुः ॥
ब्रह्मा जगाम शरणं मम मूर्त्यन्तरं परम् ॥ 45 ॥
4.33.m:
"Go for refuge to Vaikuṇṭha!" Having said this, they went to their homes.
Brahmā went for refuge to my supreme other form, / 45

4.33.s:
śāntaṃ taṃ kamalākāntaṃ śyāmaṃ nārāyaṇābhidham..
gatvā viṣaṣṇavadanaḥ praṇamya ca caturbhujam .. 46 ..
4.33.d:
शान्तं तं कमलाकान्तं श्यामं नारायणाभिधम्॥
गत्वा विषष्णवदनः प्रणम्य च चतुर्भुजम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.33.m:
The tranquil, dark-complexioned lover of Kamalā, named Nārāyaṇa.
Having gone with a dejected face and bowed down to the four-armed [Lord], / 46

4.33.s:
tatrovāsa jagatkartā nātidūre samīpataḥ ..
rahasyaṃ kathayāmāsa śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ .. 47 ..
4.33.d:
तत्रोवास जगत्कर्ता नातिदूरे समीपतः ॥
रहस्यं कथयामास शुष्ककण्ठोष्ठतालुकः ॥ 47 ॥
4.33.m:
The creator of the universe sat there, nearby, not very far away.
With throat, lips, and palate dried up, he related the secret matter / 47

4.33.s:
dīnabandhuṃ dayāsindhuṃ vipattāraṇakāraṇam ..
śrutvā rahasyaṃ tatsarvaṃ prahasyovāca taṃ vibhuḥ ..
satyaṃ sāraṃ hitaṃ vākyaṃ jagatāṃ ca sukhāvaham .. 48 ..
4.33.d:
दीनबन्धुं दयासिन्धुं विपत्तारणकारणम् ॥
श्रुत्वा रहस्यं तत्सर्वं प्रहस्योवाच तं विभुः ॥
सत्यं सारं हितं वाक्यं जगतां च सुखावहम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.33.m:
To the friend of the poor, the ocean of compassion, the cause of deliverance from misfortune.
Having heard that entire secret, the all-pervading Lord laughed and spoke to him
Words that were true, essential, beneficial, and bringing happiness to the worlds. / 48

4.33.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
svayaṃ tvaṃ vedavidasi viduṣāṃ ca gurorguruḥ .. 49 ..
4.33.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
स्वयं त्वं वेदविदसि विदुषां च गुरोर्गुरुः ॥ 49 ॥
4.33.m: "You yourself are a knower of the Vedas, and among the wise the teacher of teachers. / 49

4.33.s:
tvayā kṛtaṃ ca yatkarma iha kena na tatkṛtam ..
strījātiḥ prakṛteraṃśā jagatāṃ bījarūpiṇī .. 4.33.50 ..
4.33.d:
त्वया कृतं च यत्कर्म इह केन न तत्कृतम् ॥
स्त्रीजातिः प्रकृतेरंशा जगतां बीजरूपिणी ॥ 4.33.50 ॥
4.33.m:
And what deed has been done by you—by whom in this world has it not been done?
The female race is a portion of Prakṛti, the seed-form of the worlds. / 50

4.33.s:
strīṇāṃ viḍambanenaiva prakṛteśca viḍambanam ..
na tadbhāratavarṣaṃ ca puṇyakṣetramanuttamam .. 51 ..
4.33.d:
स्त्रीणां विडम्बनेनैव प्रकृतेश्च विडम्बनम् ॥
न तद्भारतवर्षं च पुण्यक्षेत्रमनुत्तमम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.33.m:
By humiliating women alone, Prakṛti itself is humiliated.
Nor is that [place] the land of Bhārata, that incomparable field of merit. / 51

4.33.s:
krīḍākṣetre brahmaloke kastavendriyanigrahaḥ ..
yadi tadbhārate daivātkāminī samupasthitā .. 52 ..
4.33.d:
क्रीडाक्षेत्रे ब्रह्मलोके कस्तवेन्द्रियनिग्रहः ॥
यदि तद्भारते दैवात्कामिनी समुपस्थिता ॥ 52 ॥
4.33.m:
In Brahmaloka, a realm of sport, what restraint of your senses [is needed]?
Even if in that Bhārata a passionate woman appears by fate, / 52

4.33.s:
svayaṃ rahasi kāmārtā na sā tyājyā jitendriyaiḥ ..
tyaktvā paratra narakaṃ vrajedativiḍambitaḥ .. 53 ..
4.33.d:
स्वयं रहसि कामार्ता न सा त्याज्या जितेन्द्रियैः ॥
त्यक्त्वा परत्र नरकं व्रजेदतिविडम्बितः ॥ 53 ॥
4.33.m:
Afflicted by desire, alone in secret, she should not be rejected by those who have conquered their senses;
By rejecting her, one would go to hell in the next world, utterly disgraced; / 53

4.33.s:
bhavedeva hi duḥkhārtā śāpaṃ dadyācca taṃ dhruvam ..
vihāya svakalatraṃ ca yo gṛhṇāti parastriyam .. 54 ..
4.33.d:
भवेदेव हि दुःखार्ता शापं दद्याच्च तं ध्रुवम् ॥
विहाय स्वकलत्रं च यो गृह्णाति परस्त्रियम् ॥ 54 ॥
4.33.m:
Afflicted with grief, she would certainly pronounce a curse upon him.
He who abandons his own wife and takes another's woman, / 54

4.33.s:
lobhātkāmasukhādvā'pi so'dhamo nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
pātayitvā sa ca pateddaśa pūrvāndaśāparān .. 55 ..
4.33.d:
लोभात्कामसुखाद्वाऽपि सोऽधमो नात्र संशयः ॥
पातयित्वा स च पतेद्दश पूर्वान्दशापरान् ॥ 55 ॥
4.33.m:
Whether from greed or the pleasure of lust, he is the lowest of men, no doubt about it.
Causing ten ancestors and ten descendants to fall, he too falls. / 55

4.33.s:
tyaktvā svasvāminaṃ yā ca paraṃ gacchati kāmataḥ ..
na pumānna ca veśyā ca kulastrī tatra duṣyati .. .. 56 ..
4.33.d:
त्यक्त्वा स्वस्वामिनं या च परं गच्छति कामतः ॥
न पुमान्न च वेश्या च कुलस्त्री तत्र दुष्यति ॥ ॥ 56 ॥
4.33.m:
And she who, abandoning her own husband, goes to another out of lust—
Neither the man nor a courtesan, [only] a woman of good family is corrupted thereby. / 56

4.33.s:
upāyena ca yā sādhyaṃ karoti parapūruṣam ..
tiṣṭhatyevāndhakūpe sā yāvaccandradivākarau .. 57 ..
4.33.d:
उपायेन च या साध्यं करोति परपूरुषम् ॥
तिष्ठत्येवान्धकूपे सा यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ ॥ 57 ॥
4.33.m:
And she who by some means brings another's husband under her sway,
Dwells in a blind well for as long as the moon and the sun [endure]. / 57

4.33.s:
svarveśyā ca divaṃ yāti satataṃ kuladharmataḥ ..
dhruvaṃ bhavetso'parādhī tasyā apyavamānataḥ .. 58 ..
4.33.d:
स्वर्वेश्या च दिवं याति सततं कुलधर्मतः ॥
ध्रुवं भवेत्सोऽपराधी तस्या अप्यवमानतः ॥ 58 ॥
4.33.m:
A heavenly courtesan constantly goes to heaven by the duty of her class;
Surely that man would become a wrongdoer by slighting her. / 58

4.33.s:
tamupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi śapto yatra viśuddhyati ..
kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha jagannātha pāpinaśca bhavārṇave .. 59 ..
4.33.d:
तमुपायं करिष्यामि शप्तो यत्र विशुद्ध्यति ॥
क्षणं तिष्ठ जगन्नाथ पापिनश्च भवार्णवे ॥ 59 ॥
4.33.m:
I shall provide that means by which the cursed one is purified.
Wait a moment, O master of the universe, for sinners in the ocean of mundane existence." / 59

4.33.s:
etasminnaṃtare kaścidājagāma hareḥ puraḥ ..
dvārapālaḥ śīghragāmītyuvāca natakandharaḥ .. 4.33.60 ..
4.33.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे कश्चिदाजगाम हरेः पुरः ॥
द्वारपालः शीघ्रगामीत्युवाच नतकन्धरः ॥ 4.33.60 ॥
4.33.m:
In the meantime, someone came before Hari;
A swift-moving doorkeeper bowed his head and said: / 60

4.33.s:
dvārapāla uvāca ..
anyabrahmāṇḍādhipatirbrahmā daśamukhaḥ svayam ..
dvāre tiṣṭhanmahābhaktastvāṃ draṣṭuṃ svayamāgataḥ.. 61 ..
4.33.d:
द्वारपाल उवाच ॥
अन्यब्रह्माण्डाधिपतिर्ब्रह्मा दशमुखः स्वयम् ॥
द्वारे तिष्ठन्महाभक्तस्त्वां द्रष्टुं स्वयमागतः॥ 61 ॥
4.33.m:
"The lord of another cosmic egg, a ten-faced Brahmā himself,
Standing at the door, a great devotee, has come in person to see you." / 61

4.33.s:
dvārapālavacaḥ śrutvā sa caivānumatiṃ dadau ..
dvārapālājñayā brahmā tuṣṭāvāgatya bhaktitaḥ .. 62..
4.33.d:
द्वारपालवचः श्रुत्वा स चैवानुमतिं ददौ ॥
द्वारपालाज्ञया ब्रह्मा तुष्टावागत्य भक्तितः ॥ 62॥
4.33.m:
Having heard the words of the doorkeeper, he gave permission.
By the doorkeeper's permission, Brahmā entered and praised [him] with devotion / 62

4.33.s:
stotrairativicitraiśca caturvaktrā'śrutairaho ..
stutvovāsājñayā viṣṇoḥ kṛtvā paścāccaturmukham .. 63 ..
4.33.d:
स्तोत्रैरतिविचित्रैश्च चतुर्वक्त्राऽश्रुतैरहो ॥
स्तुत्वोवासाज्ञया विष्णोः कृत्वा पश्चाच्चतुर्मुखम् ॥ 63 ॥
4.33.m:
With exceedingly extraordinary hymns of praise, unheard by the Four-faced one, O wonder!
Having praised him, by order of Viṣṇu he sat down, placing the Four-faced one behind him. / 63

4.33.s:
nārāyaṇo dvārapālānityuvāca caturbhujān ..
āgantukaṃ janamapi praveśayata sādaram .. 64 ..
4.33.d:
नारायणो द्वारपालानित्युवाच चतुर्भुजान् ॥
आगन्तुकं जनमपि प्रवेशयत सादरम् ॥ 64 ॥
4.33.m:
Nārāyaṇa spoke to the four-armed doorkeepers:
"Usher in with respect any person who arrives." / 64

4.33.s:
etasminnantare tatra vṛndāvanavinodini ..
ājagāmātipraṇato brahmā śatamukhaḥ svayam .. .. 65 ..
4.33.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र वृन्दावनविनोदिनि ॥
आजगामातिप्रणतो ब्रह्मा शतमुखः स्वयम् ॥ ॥ 65 ॥
4.33.m:
In the meantime there, O delight of Vṛndāvana,
A hundred-faced Brahmā himself arrived, bowing down low. / 65

4.33.s:
divyaiḥ stotraiśca tuṣṭāva nigūḍhamatisundaraiḥ ..
stutvovāsa varaiḥ stotraiḥ sarveṣāmaśrutairaho .. 66 ..
4.33.d:
दिव्यैः स्तोत्रैश्च तुष्टाव निगूढमतिसुन्दरैः ॥
स्तुत्वोवास वरैः स्तोत्रैः सर्वेषामश्रुतैरहो ॥ 66 ॥
4.33.m: And he praised him with divine, profound, most beautiful hymns of praise;

4.33.s:
tadanantarayoragre bhaktasya śatamukhaḥ svayam ..
jagadvidhau sabhāyāṃ ca tatra tiṣṭhati tatkṣaṇe .. 67 ..
4.33.d:
तदनन्तरयोरग्रे भक्तस्य शतमुखः स्वयम् ॥
जगद्विधौ सभायां च तत्र तिष्ठति तत्क्षणे ॥ 67 ॥
4.33.m:
In front of the devotee who was next to them, the hundred-faced one himself—
While the creator of the world was staying there in the assembly at that moment, / 67

4.33.s:
ājagāmānyabrahmāṇḍādhipo brahmā hareḥ puraḥ ..
sahasravadanaḥ śrīmānbhaktyā namrātmakandharaḥ .. 68 ..
4.33.d:
आजगामान्यब्रह्माण्डाधिपो ब्रह्मा हरेः पुरः ॥
सहस्रवदनः श्रीमान्भक्त्या नम्रात्मकन्धरः ॥ 68 ॥
4.33.m:
The lord of another cosmic egg, a Brahmā, came before Hari,
A thousand-faced, glorious [being], his neck bowed in devotion. / 68

4.33.s:
stutvovāsa varaiḥ stotraiḥ sarveṣāmaśrutairaho ..
taṃ ca papraccha sarveṣāṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca brahmaṇām .. .. 69 ..
4.33.d:
स्तुत्वोवास वरैः स्तोत्रैः सर्वेषामश्रुतैरहो ॥
तं च पप्रच्छ सर्वेषां ब्रह्माण्डानां च ब्रह्मणाम् ॥ ॥ 69 ॥
4.33.m: And he asked him about the affairs of all the cosmic eggs and the Brahmās, / 69

4.33.s:
vārtā viṣayiṇāṃ caiva surāṇāṃ ca krameṇa ca..
caturmukhasya tāndṛṣṭvā darpabhaṅgo babhūva ha .. 4.33.70 ..
4.33.d:
वार्ता विषयिणां चैव सुराणां च क्रमेण च॥
चतुर्मुखस्य तान्दृष्ट्वा दर्पभङ्गो बभूव ह ॥ 4.33.70 ॥
4.33.m:
And of the rulers of realms, and of the gods in order.
Seeing them, the Four-faced one indeed suffered a destruction of his pride, / 70

4.33.s:
ātmānaṃ viṣṇusadṛśaṃ manyamānasya darpataḥ ..
anyānna darśayāmāsa brahmāṇḍasthānvidhīnhariḥ .. 71 ..
4.33.d:
आत्मानं विष्णुसदृशं मन्यमानस्य दर्पतः ॥
अन्यान्न दर्शयामास ब्रह्माण्डस्थान्विधीन्हरिः ॥ 71 ॥
4.33.m:
Since out of arrogance he had considered himself equal to Viṣṇu.
Hari did not show him the other Creators dwelling in [all] the cosmic eggs. / 71

4.33.s:
dṛṣṭvā ca kṛpayā tatra mṛtatulyaṃ caturmukham..
yāvanti gātralomāni santi nārāyaṇasya me..72..
4.33.d:
दृष्ट्वा च कृपया तत्र मृततुल्यं चतुर्मुखम्॥
यावन्ति गात्रलोमानि सन्ति नारायणस्य मे॥72॥
4.33.m:
And seeing there the four-faced [Brahmā] like one dead, out of compassion:
"As many hairs as there are on my body, Nārāyaṇa's,

4.33.s:
tatpramāṇāśca brahmāṇḍā brahmāṇaḥ santi santatam..
nārāyaṇaṃ praṇamyāśu jagmuste svālayaṃ prati..73..
4.33.d:
तत्प्रमाणाश्च ब्रह्माण्डा ब्रह्माणः सन्ति सन्ततम्॥
नारायणं प्रणम्याशु जग्मुस्ते स्वालयं प्रति॥73॥
4.33.m:
in that measure are there continually cosmic eggs and Brahmās."
Bowing to Nārāyaṇa, they quickly went to their own abodes.

4.33.s:
sa mene vidhirātmānamatyalpaviṣayādhipam ..
papraccha praṇataṃ viṣṇurlajjānamracaturmukham .. 74 ..
4.33.d:
स मेने विधिरात्मानमत्यल्पविषयाधिपम् ॥
पप्रच्छ प्रणतं विष्णुर्लज्जानम्रचतुर्मुखम् ॥ 74 ॥
4.33.m:
That Brahmā considered himself the lord of an exceedingly petty domain.
Viṣṇu asked the four-faced [Brahmā], who was bowing low, bowed with shame:

4.33.s:
vada tatkimidaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ svapnavadbhavatā'dhunā ..
nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā vidhirityuktavāṃstadā ..75..
4.33.d:
वद तत्किमिदं दृष्टं स्वप्नवद्भवताऽधुना ॥
नारायणवचः श्रुत्वा विधिरित्युक्तवांस्तदा ॥75॥
4.33.m:
"Tell me, what was this that was seen by you just now, like a dream?"
Hearing Nārāyaṇa's words, Brahmā then spoke thus:

4.33.s:
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca tava māyāsamudbhavam ..
ityevamuktvā sa vidhistasthau saṃsadi lajjayā ..
sarvāntaryāmī bhagavāṃstasyopāyaṃ vinirmame .. 76 ..
4.33.d:
भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च तव मायासमुद्भवम् ॥
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स विधिस्तस्थौ संसदि लज्जया ॥
सर्वान्तर्यामी भगवांस्तस्योपायं विनिर्ममे ॥ 76 ॥

4.34.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
etasminnantare tatra śaṃkaraḥ samupasthitaḥ ..
sasmito vṛṣabhendrastho vibhūtibhūṣaṇaḥ svayam .. 1 ..
4.34.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र शंकरः समुपस्थितः ॥
सस्मितो वृषभेन्द्रस्थो विभूतिभूषणः स्वयम् ॥ 1 ॥

4.34.s:
vyāghracarmāmbaradharo nāgayajñopavītakaḥ ..
svarṇākārajaṭādhāramardhacandraṃ ca sandadhat .. 2 ..
4.34.d:
व्याघ्रचर्माम्बरधरो नागयज्ञोपवीतकः ॥
स्वर्णाकारजटाधारमर्धचन्द्रं च सन्दधत् ॥ 2 ॥

4.34.s:
triśūlapaṭṭiśakaro bibhratkhaṭvāṅgamuttamam ..
sadratnasāraracitasvarayantrakaro mudā .. 3 ..
4.34.d:
त्रिशूलपट्टिशकरो बिभ्रत्खट्वाङ्गमुत्तमम् ॥
सद्रत्नसाररचितस्वरयन्त्रकरो मुदा ॥ 3 ॥

4.34.s:
vāhanādavaruhyāśu bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ..
praṇamya kamalākāntaṃ vāme covāsa bhaktitaḥ..4..
4.34.d:
वाहनादवरुह्याशु भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरः ॥
प्रणम्य कमलाकान्तं वामे चोवास भक्तितः॥4॥

4.34.s:
ājagmurmunayaḥ sarve surāḥ śakrādayastathā..
ādityā vasavo rudrā manavaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ .. 5 ..
4.34.d:
आजग्मुर्मुनयः सर्वे सुराः शक्रादयस्तथा॥
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा मनवः सिद्धचारणाः ॥ 5 ॥

4.34.s:
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgāstuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam ..
praṇamya taṃ śivaṃ sarve surāśca namrakandharāḥ.. 6 ..
4.34.d:
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वाङ्गास्तुष्टुवुः पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥
प्रणम्य तं शिवं सर्वे सुराश्च नम्रकन्धराः॥ 6 ॥

4.34.s:
etasminnantare tatra saṃgītaṃ śaṃkaro jagau ..
kṛtvā'tīva sutālaṃ ca svarayantrasamanvitaḥ ..7 ..
4.34.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र संगीतं शंकरो जगौ ॥
कृत्वाऽतीव सुतालं च स्वरयन्त्रसमन्वितः ॥7 ॥

4.34.s:
āvayośca guṇākhyānaṃ rāsasaṃbandhi sundaram ..
samayocitarāgeṇa manomohanakāriṇā .. 8..
4.34.d:
