आवयोश्च गुणाख्यानं राससंबन्धि सुन्दरम् ॥
समयोचितरागेण मनोमोहनकारिणा ॥ 8॥

4.34.s:
yatra kaṇṭhaikamānena caikatānena cāruṇā..
padabhedavirāmeṇa guruṇā laghunā kramāt.. .. 9 ..
4.34.d:
यत्र कण्ठैकमानेन चैकतानेन चारुणा॥
पदभेदविरामेण गुरुणा लघुना क्रमात्॥ ॥ 9 ॥

4.34.s:
gamakenātidīrgheṇa madena madhureṇa ca ..
bhave'tidurlabhaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ prītyā svena vinirmitam .. 4.34.10 ..
4.34.d:
गमकेनातिदीर्घेण मदेन मधुरेण च ॥
भवेऽतिदुर्लभं सृष्टं प्रीत्या स्वेन विनिर्मितम् ॥ 4.34.10 ॥

4.34.s:
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetraḥ punaḥpunaḥ ..
tadeva śrutimātreṇa mūrcchāṃ prāpurvicetanāḥ .. 11 ..
4.34.d:
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वाङ्गः साश्रुनेत्रः पुनःपुनः ॥
तदेव श्रुतिमात्रेण मूर्च्छां प्रापुर्विचेतनाः ॥ 11 ॥

4.34.s:
babhūvu rudrarūpāśca munayaḥ purataḥ priye ..
rudrarūpāḥ surāḥ sarve vidhātṛharipārṣadāḥ .. 12 ..
4.34.d:
बभूवु रुद्ररूपाश्च मुनयः पुरतः प्रिये ॥
रुद्ररूपाः सुराः सर्वे विधातृहरिपार्षदाः ॥ 12 ॥

4.34.s:
nārāyaṇaśca lakṣmīśca gāyakaśca śivaḥ svayam ..
jalapūrṇaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ dṛṣṭvā trasto'hamīśvari .. 13 ..
4.34.d:
नारायणश्च लक्ष्मीश्च गायकश्च शिवः स्वयम् ॥
जलपूर्णं च वैकुण्ठं दृष्ट्वा त्रस्तोऽहमीश्वरि ॥ 13 ॥

4.34.s:
gatvā mūrtīrvinirmāya sarvāśca tādṛśīriti ..
tatsvarūpāstadastrāśca tatsvavāhanabhūṣaṇāḥ .. 14 ..
4.34.d:
गत्वा मूर्तीर्विनिर्माय सर्वाश्च तादृशीरिति ॥
तत्स्वरूपास्तदस्त्राश्च तत्स्ववाहनभूषणाः ॥ 14 ॥

4.34.s:
tatsvabhāvāstanmanaskāstattadviṣayamānasāḥ ..
sthānaṃ nirmāya parito vaikuṇṭhasya caturdiśi .. 15 ..
4.34.d:
तत्स्वभावास्तन्मनस्कास्तत्तद्विषयमानसाः ॥
स्थानं निर्माय परितो वैकुण्ठस्य चतुर्दिशि ॥ 15 ॥

4.34.s:
tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca ājagāma svamālayam ..
śarīrajā surāṇāṃ sā babhūva suranimnagā .. 16 ..
4.34.d:
तदधिष्ठातृदेवी च आजगाम स्वमालयम् ॥
शरीरजा सुराणां सा बभूव सुरनिम्नगा ॥ 16 ॥

4.34.s:
muktidā ca mumukṣūṇāṃ bhaktānāṃ haribhaktidā ..
koṭijanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ vividhaṃ pāpināmaho .. 17 ..
4.34.d:
मुक्तिदा च मुमुक्षूणां भक्तानां हरिभक्तिदा ॥
कोटिजन्मार्जितं पापं विविधं पापिनामहो ॥ 17 ॥

4.34.s:
yasyāśca sparśavāyośca saṃparkeṇa vinaśyati ..
kiṃ vā na jāne prāṇeśi sparśadarśanayoḥ phalam .. 18 ..
4.34.d:
यस्याश्च स्पर्शवायोश्च संपर्केण विनश्यति ॥
किं वा न जाने प्राणेशि स्पर्शदर्शनयोः फलम् ॥ 18 ॥

4.34.s:
kimuta snānajanyaṃ ca kathayāmi nirūpaṇam ..
sarvatīrthātparaṃ pṛthvyāṃ puṣkaraṃ parikīrtitam .. 19 ..
4.34.d:
किमुत स्नानजन्यं च कथयामि निरूपणम् ॥
सर्वतीर्थात्परं पृथ्व्यां पुष्करं परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 19 ॥

4.34.s:
vedoktaṃ ca tadevāsyāḥ kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm ..
bhagīrathena cānītā tena bhāgīrathī smṛtā .. 4.34.20 ..
4.34.d:
वेदोक्तं च तदेवास्याः कलां नार्हंति षोडशीम् ॥
भगीरथेन चानीता तेन भागीरथी स्मृता ॥ 4.34.20 ॥

4.34.s:
gāmāgatā srotasoṃ'śādgaṅgā tena prakīrtitā ..
jānudvārā purā dattā jahnunā''pīya kopataḥ .. 21 ..
4.34.d:
गामागता स्रोतसोंऽशाद्गङ्गा तेन प्रकीर्तिता ॥
जानुद्वारा पुरा दत्ता जह्नुना'ऽपीय कोपतः ॥ 21 ॥

4.34.s:
tasya kanyāsvarūpā sā jāhnavī tena kīrtitā ..
bhīṣmaḥ svayaṃ vasurjātastasyāṃśāttena bhīṣmasūḥ .. 22 ..
4.34.d:
तस्य कन्यास्वरूपा सा जाह्नवी तेन कीर्तिता ॥
भीष्मः स्वयं वसुर्जातस्तस्यांशात्तेन भीष्मसूः ॥ 22 ॥

4.34.s:
dhārābhistisṛbhiḥ svargaṃ pṛthivīmatalaṃ tathā ..
mamājñayā ca gacchantī tena tripathagāminī .. 23 ..
4.34.d:
धाराभिस्तिसृभिः स्वर्गं पृथिवीमतलं तथा ॥
ममाज्ञया च गच्छन्ती तेन त्रिपथगामिनी ॥ 23 ॥

4.34.s:
pradhānadhārayā svarge sā ca mandākinī smṛtā ..
yojanāyutavistīrṇā prasthe ca yojanā smṛtā .. 24 ..
4.34.d:
प्रधानधारया स्वर्गे सा च मन्दाकिनी स्मृता ॥
योजनायुतविस्तीर्णा प्रस्थे च योजना स्मृता ॥ 24 ॥

4.34.s:
kṣīratulyajalā śaśvadatyuttuṅgataraṅgiṇī ..
vaikuṇṭhādbrahmalokaṃ ca tataḥ svargaṃ samāgatā .. 25 ..
4.34.d:
क्षीरतुल्यजला शश्वदत्युत्तुङ्गतरङ्गिणी ॥
वैकुण्ठाद्ब्रह्मलोकं च ततः स्वर्गं समागता ॥ 25 ॥

4.34.s:
svargāddhimādrimārgeṇa pṛthivīmāgatā mudā ..
sā dhārā'lakanaṃdākhyā lavaṇodena miśritā .. .. 26 ..
4.34.d:
स्वर्गाद्धिमाद्रिमार्गेण पृथिवीमागता मुदा ॥
सा धाराऽलकनंदाख्या लवणोदेन मिश्रिता ॥ ॥ 26 ॥

4.34.s:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśā bahuvegavatī satī ..
pāpināṃ pāpaśuṣkendhaṃ dagdhuṃ pāvakarūpiṇī .. 27 ..
4.34.d:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशा बहुवेगवती सती ॥
पापिनां पापशुष्केन्धं दग्धुं पावकरूपिणी ॥ 27 ॥

4.34.s:
aho sagaravaṃśebhyo nirvāṇamuktidāyinī ..
vaikuṇṭhagāmigī sā ca sopānarūpiṇī varā ..28 ..
4.34.d:
अहो सगरवंशेभ्यो निर्वाणमुक्तिदायिनी ॥
वैकुण्ठगामिगी सा च सोपानरूपिणी वरा ॥28 ॥

4.34.s:
ato'pi mṛtyusamaye satāṃ puṇyasvarūpiṇām ..
ādau pādau ca saṃnyasya mukhe toyaṃ pradīyate .. 29 ..
4.34.d:
अतोऽपि मृत्युसमये सतां पुण्यस्वरूपिणाम् ॥
आदौ पादौ च संन्यस्य मुखे तोयं प्रदीयते ॥ 29 ॥

4.34.s:
gaṅgāsopānamāruhya santo yānti nirāmayam ..
ābrahmalokaṃ saṃlaṃghya rathasthāśca nirāpadaḥ .. .. 4.34.30 ..
4.34.d:
गङ्गासोपानमारुह्य सन्तो यान्ति निरामयम् ॥
आब्रह्मलोकं संलंघ्य रथस्थाश्च निरापदः ॥ ॥ 4.34.30 ॥

4.34.s:
daivātpurā prāktanena magnaṃ cetkṛtapātakaiḥ ..
lomapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca modante harimandire .. 31 ..
4.34.d:
दैवात्पुरा प्राक्तनेन मग्नं चेत्कृतपातकैः ॥
लोमप्रमाणवर्षं च मोदन्ते हरिमन्दिरे ॥ 31 ॥

4.34.s:
tato bhogo bhavetteṣāṃ niścitaṃ pāpapuṇyayoḥ ..
atisvalpena kālena kālavyūhaṃ ca bibhratām .. 32 ..
4.34.d:
ततो भोगो भवेत्तेषां निश्चितं पापपुण्ययोः ॥
अतिस्वल्पेन कालेन कालव्यूहं च बिभ्रताम् ॥ 32 ॥

4.34.s:
tataḥ puṇyavatāṃ gehe labdhvā janma ca bhārate ..
saṃprāpya niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ bhavanti harirūpiṇaḥ .. 33 ..
4.34.d:
ततः पुण्यवतां गेहे लब्ध्वा जन्म च भारते ॥
संप्राप्य निश्चलां भक्तिं भवन्ति हरिरूपिणः ॥ 33 ॥

4.34.s:
mṛtadvijānāṃ dehāṃśca daivācchūdrā vahanti cet ..
padapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca teṣāṃ ca narake sthitiḥ .. 34..
4.34.d:
मृतद्विजानां देहांश्च दैवाच्छूद्रा वहन्ति चेत् ॥
पदप्रमाणवर्षं च तेषां च नरके स्थितिः ॥ 34॥

4.34.s:
tatasteṣāṃ ca sāhāyyaṃ karoti harirūpiṇī..
dadāti muktiṃ tebhyo'pi krameṇa ca kṛpāmayī..35..
4.34.d:
ततस्तेषां च साहाय्यं करोति हरिरूपिणी॥
ददाति मुक्तिं तेभ्योऽपि क्रमेण च कृपामयी॥35॥

4.34.s:
janma puṇyavatāṃ gehe kārayitvā ca bhārate..
sthalaṃ dadāti vaikuṇṭhe niścitaṃ janmabhistribhiḥ .. 36 ..
4.34.d:
जन्म पुण्यवतां गेहे कारयित्वा च भारते॥
स्थलं ददाति वैकुण्ठे निश्चितं जन्मभिस्त्रिभिः ॥ 36 ॥

4.34.s:
yātrāṃ kṛtvā tu yaḥ śuddhau snātuṃ yāti sureśvarīm ..
padapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe modate dhruvam .. 37 ..
4.34.d:
यात्रां कृत्वा तु यः शुद्धौ स्नातुं याति सुरेश्वरीम् ॥
पदप्रमाणवर्षं च वैकुण्ठे मोदते ध्रुवम् ॥ 37 ॥

4.34.s:
gaṅgāṃ prāpyānuṣaṅgeṇa snāti cetsamalo naraḥ ..
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ punaryadi na lipyate .. 38 ..
4.34.d:
गङ्गां प्राप्यानुषङ्गेण स्नाति चेत्समलो नरः ॥
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः पुनर्यदि न लिप्यते ॥ 38 ॥
4.34.m: he is freed from all sins, provided he does not become tainted again.

4.34.s:
kalau pañca sahasrābdaṃ sthitistasyāśca bhārate ..
tasyāṃ ca vidyamānāyāṃ kaḥ prabhāvaḥ kaleraho .. 39 ..
4.34.d:
कलौ पञ्च सहस्राब्दं स्थितिस्तस्याश्च भारते ॥
तस्यां च विद्यमानायां कः प्रभावः कलेरहो ॥ 39 ॥
4.34.m:
In Kali, her stay in Bhārata lasts for five thousand years;
while she is present, ah, what power does Kali have?

4.34.s:
kalau daśasahasrāṇi varṣāṇi pratimā mama..
tiṣṭhanti ca purāṇāni prabhāvastatra kaḥ kaleḥ .. 4.34.40 ..
4.34.d:
कलौ दशसहस्राणि वर्षाणि प्रतिमा मम॥
तिष्ठन्ति च पुराणानि प्रभावस्तत्र कः कलेः ॥ 4.34.40 ॥
4.34.m:
In Kali, for ten thousand years My images
and the Purāṇas remain; what power does Kali have then?

4.34.s:
atalaṃ yāti yā dhārā sā ca bhogavatī smṛtā ..
payaḥphenanibhā śaśvadativegavatī sadā .. 41 ..
4.34.d:
अतलं याति या धारा सा च भोगवती स्मृता ॥
पयःफेननिभा शश्वदतिवेगवती सदा ॥ 41 ॥
4.34.m:
The stream that goes to Atala is known as the Bhogavatī,
constantly resembling the froth of milk, always very swift,

4.34.s:
ākarāmūlyaratnānāṃ maṇīndrāṇāṃ ca saṃtatam ..
nāgakanyāśca yattīre krīḍanti sthirayauvanāḥ .. 42 ..
4.34.d:
आकरामूल्यरत्नानां मणीन्द्राणां च संततम् ॥
नागकन्याश्च यत्तीरे क्रीडन्ति स्थिरयौवनाः ॥ 42 ॥
4.34.m:
continually a mine of priceless gems and the best of jewels,
on whose bank the daughters of the nāgas frolic, endowed with eternal youth.

4.34.s:
svayaṃ devī ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ veṣṭayitvā ca saṃtatam ..
sahasrayojanā prasthe dairghye ca lakṣayojanā .. 43 ..
4.34.d:
स्वयं देवी च वैकुण्ठं वेष्टयित्वा च संततम् ॥
सहस्रयोजना प्रस्थे दैर्घ्ये च लक्षयोजना ॥ 43 ॥
4.34.m:
The goddess herself, constantly encircling Vaikuṇṭha,
is a thousand yojanas in breadth and a hundred thousand yojanas in length.

4.34.s:
asyā vināśaḥ pralaye nāstyeva duhiturmama ..
nānāratnākaraṃ divyaṃ tattīraṃ sumanoharam .. 44 ..
4.34.d:
अस्या विनाशः प्रलये नास्त्येव दुहितुर्मम ॥
नानारत्नाकरं दिव्यं तत्तीरं सुमनोहरम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.34.m:
There is truly no destruction of this daughter of Mine during the dissolution;
its celestial bank, a mine of various gems, is exceedingly charming.

4.34.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ jāhnavījanma puṇyadam ..
brahmaṇaśca pratīkāro mohinīśāpatā śṛṇu .. 45 ..
iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde jāhnavījanmaprastāvo nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. .. 34 ..
4.34.d:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं जाह्नवीजन्म पुण्यदम् ॥
ब्रह्मणश्च प्रतीकारो मोहिनीशापता शृणु ॥ 45 ॥
इति श्रीब्रह्मवैवर्ते महापुराणे श्रीकृष्णजन्मखण्डे नारायणनारदसंवादे जाह्नवीजन्मप्रस्तावो नाम चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः॥ ॥ 34 ॥
4.34.m:
Thus the entire, merit-giving birth of the Jāhnavī has been related.
Now hear the remedy for Brahmā from the curse of Mohinī.
Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, entitled "The Account of the Birth of the Jāhnavī", in the dialogue between Nārāyaṇa and Nārada, in the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa of the glorious Brahmavaivarta Mahāpurāṇa. // 34

4.35.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
nārāyaṇaśca brahmāṇamuvāca kṛpayā punaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā gaṅgāṃ ca sarve tāṃ mama māyāṃ ca menire .. 1 .. ..
4.35.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
नारायणश्च ब्रह्माणमुवाच कृपया पुनः ॥
दृष्ट्वा गङ्गां च सर्वे तां मम मायां च मेनिरे ॥ 1 ॥ ॥

4.35.s:
.. śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
uttiṣṭha gaccha bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati caturmukha ..
atra snātvā'bhiśaptastvaṃ pūto bhava mamājñayā..2..
4.35.d:
॥ श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
उत्तिष्ठ गच्छ भद्रं ते भविष्यति चतुर्मुख ॥
अत्र स्नात्वाऽभिशप्तस्त्वं पूतो भव ममाज्ञया॥2॥

4.35.s:
tvaṃ cetsatyaṃ svayaṃ pūtaḥ sparśaṃ vāñchanti tāni te ..
vaiṣṇaveśasya tīrthāni sarvāṇi satataṃ mune..3..
4.35.d:
त्वं चेत्सत्यं स्वयं पूतः स्पर्शं वाञ्छन्ति तानि ते ॥
वैष्णवेशस्य तीर्थानि सर्वाणि सततं मुने॥3॥

4.35.s:
tathāpi śāpamuktastvamatra prakṛtihelanāt ..
ahaṃkāraśca sarveṣāṃ pāpabījamamaṅgalam .. 4 ..
4.35.d:
तथापि शापमुक्तस्त्वमत्र प्रकृतिहेलनात् ॥
अहंकारश्च सर्वेषां पापबीजममङ्गलम् ॥ 4 ॥

4.35.s:
śīghraṃ tvaṃ gaccha golokaṃ mamālayaṃ parātparam ..
prakṛtyaṃśāṃ maṅgaladāṃ tatra prāpsyasi bhāratīm .. 5 ..
4.35.d:
शीघ्रं त्वं गच्छ गोलोकं ममालयं परात्परम् ॥
प्रकृत्यंशां मङ्गलदां तत्र प्राप्स्यसि भारतीम् ॥ 5 ॥

4.35.s:
prakṛtiṃ bhaja kalyāṇa sṛṣṭibījasvarūpiṇīm ..
aho kalpāntaparyantaṃ tapastaptaṃ tvayā'dhunā..6..
4.35.d:
प्रकृतिं भज कल्याण सृष्टिबीजस्वरूपिणीम् ॥
अहो कल्पान्तपर्यन्तं तपस्तप्तं त्वयाऽधुना॥6॥

4.35.s:
tava mantraṃ na gṛhṇanti ke'pi veśyā'bhiśāpataḥ ..
yadanyadevapūjāyāṃ tava pūjā bhaviṣyati .. 7 ..
4.35.d:
तव मन्त्रं न गृह्णन्ति केऽपि वेश्याऽभिशापतः ॥
यदन्यदेवपूजायां तव पूजा भविष्यति ॥ 7 ॥

4.35.s:
tvameva jagatāṃ dhātā svātmārāmaśca yoṣitaḥ ..
sarvarūpī ca pūjaḥ ca sarvadeheṣu sarvataḥ .. 8 ..
4.35.d:
त्वमेव जगतां धाता स्वात्मारामश्च योषितः ॥
सर्वरूपी च पूजः च सर्वदेहेषु सर्वतः ॥ 8 ॥

4.35.s:
tadā mamājñayā brahmā snātvā ca jāhnavījale ..
śīghraṃ jagāma golokaṃ māṃ praṇamya jagadguruḥ .. 9 ..
4.35.d:
तदा ममाज्ञया ब्रह्मा स्नात्वा च जाह्नवीजले ॥
शीघ्रं जगाम गोलोकं मां प्रणम्य जगद्गुरुः ॥ 9 ॥

4.35.s:
te devā munayaḥ sarve prajagmuḥ svālayaṃ mudā ..
sunirmalaṃ mama yaśo gāyantaśca punaḥpunaḥ .. 4.35.10 ..
4.35.d:
ते देवा मुनयः सर्वे प्रजग्मुः स्वालयं मुदा ॥
सुनिर्मलं मम यशो गायन्तश्च पुनःपुनः ॥ 4.35.10 ॥

4.35.s:
vidhirāgatya golokaṃ saṃprāpya bhāratīṃ satīm ..
sarvavidyādhidevīṃ tāṃ madvaktrābjavinirmitām ..11 ..
4.35.d:
विधिरागत्य गोलोकं संप्राप्य भारतीं सतीम् ॥
सर्वविद्याधिदेवीं तां मद्वक्त्राब्जविनिर्मिताम् ॥11 ॥

4.35.s:
vāgīśvarīṃ ca saṃprāpya brahmā pramuditaḥ svayam ..
kāmāstrāṇāṃ ca vyāpāramanumene svayaṃ vibhuḥ..12..
4.35.d:
वागीश्वरीं च संप्राप्य ब्रह्मा प्रमुदितः स्वयम् ॥
कामास्त्राणां च व्यापारमनुमेने स्वयं विभुः॥12॥

4.35.s:
tata āgatya māṃ natvā prāpya trailokyamohinīm ..
krīḍāṃ cakāra bhagavānsthānesthāne'tinirjane..13..
4.35.d:
तत आगत्य मां नत्वा प्राप्य त्रैलोक्यमोहिनीम् ॥
क्रीडां चकार भगवान्स्थानेस्थानेऽतिनिर्जने॥13॥

4.35.s:
ratiṃ cirataraṃ kṛtvā virarāma svayaṃ vidhiḥ ..
vāgīśvarīmuvācedaṃ tvaṃ vai brahmā ca karmaṇā .. 14 ..
4.35.d:
रतिं चिरतरं कृत्वा विरराम स्वयं विधिः ॥
वागीश्वरीमुवाचेदं त्वं वै ब्रह्मा च कर्मणा ॥ 14 ॥

4.35.s:
kācitsvakarmaṇā sādhvī pūjyā ca sthirayauvanā ..
tavaiva karmayogaṃ ca yuvānaṃ paśya sundari .. 15 ..
4.35.d:
काचित्स्वकर्मणा साध्वी पूज्या च स्थिरयौवना ॥
तवैव कर्मयोगं च युवानं पश्य सुन्दरि ॥ 15 ॥

4.35.s:
vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo guṇavānbhavet ..
jarāturo'haṃ vṛddhaśca tapasvī vaiṣṇavo dvijaḥ .. 16 ..
4.35.d:
विदग्धाया विदग्धेन संगमो गुणवान्भवेत् ॥
जरातुरोऽहं वृद्धश्च तपस्वी वैष्णवो द्विजः ॥ 16 ॥

4.35.s:
asvatantraḥ parādhīnaḥ kā ratiḥ puṃścalīṣu me ..
ājagāma brahmalokaṃ punareva nijālayam .. 17 ..
4.35.d:
अस्वतन्त्रः पराधीनः का रतिः पुंश्चलीषु मे ॥
आजगाम ब्रह्मलोकं पुनरेव निजालयम् ॥ 17 ॥

4.35.s:
dadṛśubrarhmalokasthāstāṃ devīṃ kautukānvitāḥ ..
atīva sundarīṃ ramyāṃ śubhravarṇāṃ ca sasmitām .. 18 ..
4.35.d:
ददृशुब्रर्ह्मलोकस्थास्तां देवीं कौतुकान्विताः ॥
अतीव सुन्दरीं रम्यां शुभ्रवर्णां च सस्मिताम् ॥ 18 ॥

4.35.s:
śaracchītāṃśuvadanāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām ..
pakvabimbaprabhāmuṣṭadīptauṣṭhādharapallavām ..19..
4.35.d:
शरच्छीतांशुवदनां शरत्पङ्कजलोचनाम् ॥
पक्वबिम्बप्रभामुष्टदीप्तौष्ठाधरपल्लवाम् ॥19॥

4.35.s:
muktāpaṅktivinindyaikadantapaṅktimanoharām..
ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpuraśobhitām .. 4.35.20 ..
4.35.d:
मुक्तापङ्क्तिविनिन्द्यैकदन्तपङ्क्तिमनोहराम्॥
रत्नकेयूरवलयरत्ननूपुरशोभिताम् ॥ 4.35.20 ॥

4.35.s:
ratnakuṇḍalayugmena karṇamūlavirājitām ..
ratnendrasārahāreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalām .. 21 ..
4.35.d:
रत्नकुण्डलयुग्मेन कर्णमूलविराजिताम् ॥
रत्नेन्द्रसारहारेण वक्षःस्थलसमुज्ज्वलाम् ॥ 21 ॥

4.35.s:
vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ sūkṣmaṃ bibhratīṃ navayauvanām ..
atīva kamanīyāṃ ca pīnaśroṇipayodharām .. 22 ..
4.35.d:
वह्निशुद्धांशुकं सूक्ष्मं बिभ्रतीं नवयौवनाम् ॥
अतीव कमनीयां च पीनश्रोणिपयोधराम् ॥ 22 ॥

4.35.s:
vīṇāpustakahastāṃ ca vyākhyāmudrākarāṃ varām ..
te ca nirmañchanaṃ kṛtvā cakruḥ paramamaṅgalam .. 23 ..
4.35.d:
वीणापुस्तकहस्तां च व्याख्यामुद्राकरां वराम् ॥
ते च निर्मञ्छनं कृत्वा चक्रुः परममङ्गलम् ॥ 23 ॥

4.35.s:
purīṃ praveśayāmāsurbrahmāṇaṃ bhāratīṃ mudā ..
brahmā tayā saha krīḍāṃ cakāra sa divāniśam .. 24 ..
4.35.d:
पुरीं प्रवेशयामासुर्ब्रह्माणं भारतीं मुदा ॥
ब्रह्मा तया सह क्रीडां चकार स दिवानिशम् ॥ 24 ॥

4.35.s:
atīva sukhasaṃbhoge nimagnaḥ satataṃ mudā ..
gūḍhe sarvapurāṇeṣu kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 29 ..
4.35.d:
अतीव सुखसंभोगे निमग्नः सततं मुदा ॥
गूढे सर्वपुराणेषु किं पुनः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥ 29 ॥

4.35.s:
..śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
prāṇeśavacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya parameśvarī ..
bhūyo'pi paripapraccha kautukānmānasaṃ purā .. 26 ..
4.35.d:
॥श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
प्राणेशवचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य परमेश्वरी ॥
भूयोऽपि परिपप्रच्छ कौतुकान्मानसं पुरा ॥ 26 ॥

4.35.s:
śrīrādhikovāca ..
brahmā kathaṃ na jagrāha veśyāṃ svayamupasthitām ..
na karmakṣetre rahasi phaladātā ca karmaṇām .. 27 ..
4.35.d:
श्रीराधिकोवाच ॥
ब्रह्मा कथं न जग्राह वेश्यां स्वयमुपस्थिताम् ॥
न कर्मक्षेत्रे रहसि फलदाता च कर्मणाम् ॥ 27 ॥

4.35.s:
upasthitāyāstyāge ca mahāndoṣo hi yoṣitaḥ ..
jñātvā devo vidhātā sa kathaṃ tatyāja mohinīm .. 28 ..
4.35.d:
उपस्थितायास्त्यागे च महान्दोषो हि योषितः ॥
ज्ञात्वा देवो विधाता स कथं तत्याज मोहिनीम् ॥ 28 ॥

4.35.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ ..
pādmakalpasya vṛttāntamuvāca parameśvarīm .. 29 ..
4.35.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
राधिकावचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मधुसूदनः ॥
पाद्मकल्पस्य वृत्तान्तमुवाच परमेश्वरीम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.35.m: and related the story of the Padma Kalpa to the supreme goddess. // 29

4.35.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca..
śṛṇu kānte pravakṣyāmi purāvṛttāntamīpsitam ..
akathyaṃ gopanīyaṃ ca mahatāmabhininditam .. 4.35.30 ..
4.35.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच॥
शृणु कान्ते प्रवक्ष्यामि पुरावृत्तान्तमीप्सितम् ॥
अकथ्यं गोपनीयं च महतामभिनिन्दितम् ॥ 4.35.30 ॥
4.35.m:
“Listen, my beloved, I shall relate the desired ancient story,
unspeakable, secret, and condemned by the great. // 4.35.30

4.35.s:
ekadā ca prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ vidhātā prerito mayā ..
sasarja manasā putrāñjvalato brahmatejasā.. 31 ..
4.35.d:
एकदा च प्रजाः स्रष्टुं विधाता प्रेरितो मया ॥
ससर्ज मनसा पुत्राञ्ज्वलतो ब्रह्मतेजसा॥ 31 ॥
4.35.m:
Once, impelled by me to create offspring, the creator
produced from his mind sons blazing with the radiance of Brahman: // 31

4.35.s:
sanakaṃ ca sanandaṃ ca sanātanamanuttamam ..
sanatkumāraṃ voḍhuṃ ca kaviṃ pañcaśikhaṃ vibhum ..32 ..
4.35.d:
सनकं च सनन्दं च सनातनमनुत्तमम् ॥
सनत्कुमारं वोढुं च कविं पञ्चशिखं विभुम् ॥32 ॥
4.35.m:
Sanaka, Sananda, the matchless Sanātana,
Sanatkumāra, Voḍhu, the poet Pañcaśikha, the mighty

4.35.s:
asitaṃ kapilaṃ siddhaṃ siddhānmama kulodbhavān..
tānnagnānpañcavarṣīyānpitā sraṣṭuṃ jagāda ha.. 33 ..
4.35.d:
असितं कपिलं सिद्धं सिद्धान्मम कुलोद्भवान्॥
तान्नग्नान्पञ्चवर्षीयान्पिता स्रष्टुं जगाद ह॥ 33 ॥
4.35.m:
Asita, and Kapila the Siddha—the Siddhas born of my lineage.
Their father told those naked five-year-olds to create. // 33

4.35.s:
prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ prerakaṃ ca janakaṃ te'vamanya ca ..
prajagmustapase tūrṇaṃ mamārcanaparāyaṇāḥ .. 34 ..
4.35.d:
प्रजाः स्रष्टुं प्रेरकं च जनकं तेऽवमन्य च ॥
प्रजग्मुस्तपसे तूर्णं ममार्चनपरायणाः ॥ 34 ॥
4.35.m:
Disobeying their father who urged them to create progeny,
they went quickly to perform austerities, devoted to my worship. // 34

4.35.s:
tadā ruṣṭo jagaddhātā punaḥ putrānvinirmame ..
rudrānekādaśa varānrudato bhīmavigrahān .. 35 ..
4.35.d:
तदा रुष्टो जगद्धाता पुनः पुत्रान्विनिर्ममे ॥
रुद्रानेकादश वरान्रुदतो भीमविग्रहान् ॥ 35 ॥
4.35.m:
Then, enraged, the creator of the world produced other sons:
the eleven excellent Rudras, crying, of fearsome forms. // 35

4.35.s:
tasminprayujya tarasā punaḥ putrānvinirmame ..
yogī yogena māṃ dhyātvā svātmārāmaḥ svavigrahe .. 36 ..
4.35.d:
तस्मिन्प्रयुज्य तरसा पुनः पुत्रान्विनिर्ममे ॥
योगी योगेन मां ध्यात्वा स्वात्मारामः स्वविग्रहे ॥ 36 ॥
4.35.m:
Assigning them with speed, he again created sons,
a yogin meditating upon me with yoga, delighting in his own self within his body:

4.35.s:
vasiṣṭhaṃ pulahaṃ caiva kratumaṅgirasaṃ tathā ..
bhṛgumatriṃ pulastyaṃ ca dakṣaṃ kardamameva ca .. 37 ..
4.35.d:
वसिष्ठं पुलहं चैव क्रतुमङ्गिरसं तथा ॥
भृगुमत्रिं पुलस्त्यं च दक्षं कर्दममेव च ॥ 37 ॥
4.35.m:
Vasiṣṭha, Pulaha, Kratu, and likewise Aṅgiras,
Bhṛgu, Atri, Pulastya, Dakṣa, and Kardama.

4.35.s:
marīciṃ ca vinirmāya prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ niyujya ca ..
prahṛṣṭamānasaḥ putraṃ kanyaikā ca sasarja ha .. 38 ..
4.35.d:
मरीचिं च विनिर्माय प्रजाः स्रष्टुं नियुज्य च ॥
प्रहृष्टमानसः पुत्रं कन्यैका च ससर्ज ह ॥ 38 ॥
4.35.m:
And having created Marīci and appointed them to create offspring,
with a joyful mind he brought forth a son and a daughter.

4.35.s:
kṛṣṇasya kāminaḥ putraḥ kāmadevo babhūva ha ..
kanyā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā .. 39 ..
4.35.d:
कृष्णस्य कामिनः पुत्रः कामदेवो बभूव ह ॥
कन्या षोडशवर्षीया रत्नभूषणभूषिता ॥ 39 ॥
4.35.m:
The son became Kāmadeva, [born] of the desirous Kṛṣṇa;
the daughter was sixteen years old, adorned with jewel ornaments.

4.35.s:
uvāca putraṃ sa vidhiḥ sudīptaṃ purataḥ sthitam ..
durnivāryaṃ matkalāṃśaṃ svātmārāmaṃ manoharam .. 4.35.40 ..
4.35.d:
उवाच पुत्रं स विधिः सुदीप्तं पुरतः स्थितम् ॥
दुर्निवार्यं मत्कलांशं स्वात्मारामं मनोहरम् ॥ 4.35.40 ॥
4.35.m:
Brahmā spoke to his radiant son standing before him,
irresistible, a part and portion of me, delighting in his own self, captivating the mind.

4.35.s:
brahmovāca ..
strīpuṃsoḥ krīḍanārthāya mudā tvaṃ ca vinirmitaḥ ..
hṛṣṭiyogena sarveṣāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ kariṣyasi .. 41 ..
4.35.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
स्त्रीपुंसोः क्रीडनार्थाय मुदा त्वं च विनिर्मितः ॥
हृष्टियोगेन सर्वेषामधिष्ठानं करिष्यसि ॥ 41 ॥
4.35.m:
“You were created with joy for the sport of man and woman;
through the union of joy you shall take your seat in all beings.

4.35.s:
saṃmohanaṃ samudvegaṃ bījastaṃbhitakāraṇam ..
unmattabījaṃ jvaladaṃ śaśvaccetanahārakam .. 42 ..
4.35.d:
संमोहनं समुद्वेगं बीजस्तंभितकारणम् ॥
उन्मत्तबीजं ज्वलदं शश्वच्चेतनहारकम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.35.m: Fascination, agitation, the cause that paralyzes the seed,

4.35.s:
pragṛhyaitānmayā dattānsarvānsaṃmohanaṃ kuru ..
durnivāryo mama varādbhava vatsa bhaveṣu ca .. 43 ..
4.35.d:
प्रगृह्यैतान्मया दत्तान्सर्वान्संमोहनं कुरु ॥
दुर्निवार्यो मम वराद्भव वत्स भवेषु च ॥ 43 ॥
4.35.m:
taking these, given by me, bewitch all beings!
Become irresistible by my boon, my child, throughout all worlds!”

4.35.s:
bāṇāndattvaivamuktvā ca prahṛṣṭaśca jagadvidhiḥ ..
dṛṣṭvovāca duhitaraṃ varaṃ dātuṃ samudyataḥ .. 44..
4.35.d:
बाणान्दत्त्वैवमुक्त्वा च प्रहृष्टश्च जगद्विधिः ॥
दृष्ट्वोवाच दुहितरं वरं दातुं समुद्यतः ॥ 44॥
4.35.m:
Having given the arrows and spoken thus, the creator of the world was delighted;
seeing his daughter, he prepared to give her a boon.

4.35.s:
etasminnantare kāmo manasā''locya mantraṇām ..
kartuṃ śastraparīkṣāṃ ca bāṇāṃścikṣepa brahmaṇi .. 45 ..
4.35.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कामो मनसा'ऽलोच्य मन्त्रणाम् ॥
कर्तुं शस्त्रपरीक्षां च बाणांश्चिक्षेप ब्रह्मणि ॥ 45 ॥
4.35.m:
Meanwhile, Kāma, considering a plan in his mind
to test his weapons, discharged his arrows at Brahmā.

4.35.s:
maṃtrapūtaiśca bāṇaiśca durvāryaiḥ smaraṇena ca ..
atividdho mahāyogī mūrcchito hatacetanaḥ.. 46 ..
4.35.d:
मंत्रपूतैश्च बाणैश्च दुर्वार्यैः स्मरणेन च ॥
अतिविद्धो महायोगी मूर्च्छितो हतचेतनः॥ 46 ॥
4.35.m:
Pierced deeply by the arrows consecrated with mantras, irresistible even upon remembering,
the great yogin swooned, his consciousness lost.

4.35.s:
kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya dadarśāgre ca kanyakām ..
tāṃ saṃbhoktuṃ manaścakre sā dudrāva bhiyā satī .. 47 ..
4.35.d:
क्षणेन चेतनां प्राप्य ददर्शाग्रे च कन्यकाम् ॥
तां संभोक्तुं मनश्चक्रे सा दुद्राव भिया सती ॥ 47 ॥
4.35.m:
Regaining consciousness in a moment, he saw the young maiden before him;
he set his mind on enjoying her, and the virtuous woman fled in fear.

4.35.s:
dṛṣṭvā paścācca pitaraṃ dhāvantaṃ hatacetanam ..
jagāma śaraṇaṃ śīghraṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ ca tapasvinām .. 48 ..
4.35.d:
दृष्ट्वा पश्चाच्च पितरं धावन्तं हतचेतनम् ॥
जगाम शरणं शीघ्रं भ्रातॄणां च तपस्विनाम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.35.m:
Seeing her father running behind her, deprived of his senses,
she quickly went for refuge to her ascetic brothers.

4.35.s:
te tāṃ samīpe saṃsthāpya tamūcuḥ pitaraṃ krudhā ..
hitaṃ tathyaṃ ca vedoktaṃ nītisāraṃ paraṃ vacaḥ .. 49 ..
4.35.d:
ते तां समीपे संस्थाप्य तमूचुः पितरं क्रुधा ॥
हितं तथ्यं च वेदोक्तं नीतिसारं परं वचः ॥ 49 ॥
4.35.m:
Placing her beside them, they angrily addressed their father
with supreme words beneficial, truthful, stated in the Vedas, and the essence of right conduct.

4.35.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ..
aho kimetajjanaka karma te'tivigarhitam ..
nīcānāṃ caritaṃ yattatkaroṣi tvaṃ jagadvidhe .. 4.35.50 ..
4.35.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः ॥
अहो किमेतज्जनक कर्म तेऽतिविगर्हितम् ॥
नीचानां चरितं यत्तत्करोषि त्वं जगद्विधे ॥ 4.35.50 ॥
4.35.m:
“Ah! What is this, father? Your deed is utterly reprehensible!
You, the creator of the world, are performing conduct belonging to the base!

4.35.s:
paśyanti satataṃ santaḥ prasūmiva parastriyam ..
ye te sarvatra pūjyāśca paratreha jitendriyāḥ ..51 ..
4.35.d:
पश्यन्ति सततं सन्तः प्रसूमिव परस्त्रियम् ॥
ये ते सर्वत्र पूज्याश्च परत्रेह जितेन्द्रियाः ॥51 ॥
4.35.m:
The virtuous always look upon another's wife as upon a mother;
those who control their senses are revered everywhere, in the other world and in this one.

4.35.s:
tvaṃ svayaṃ vedakartā ca kanyāṃ saṃbhoktumicchasi ..
kanyā ca mātṛvargeṣu praviṣṭā ca śrutau śrutā .. 52 ..
4.35.d:
त्वं स्वयं वेदकर्ता च कन्यां संभोक्तुमिच्छसि ॥
कन्या च मातृवर्गेषु प्रविष्टा च श्रुतौ श्रुता ॥ 52 ॥
4.35.m:
You yourself are the author of the Vedas, yet you desire to enjoy your daughter!
And a daughter is entered among the class of mothers, as heard in the Śruti:

4.35.s:
guroḥ patnī rājapatnī viprapatnī ca yā satī ..
patnī ca bhrātṛsutayormitrapatnī ca tatprasūḥ .. 53 ..
4.35.d:
गुरोः पत्नी राजपत्नी विप्रपत्नी च या सती ॥
पत्नी च भ्रातृसुतयोर्मित्रपत्नी च तत्प्रसूः ॥ 53 ॥
4.35.m:
The wife of a guru, the wife of a king, the virtuous wife of a brahmin,
the wife of a brother and of a son, the wife of a friend and his mother,

4.35.s:
prasūḥ pitrostathā bhrātuḥ patnī śvaśrūḥ svakanyakāḥ ..
jananī tatsapatnī ca bhaginī surabhī tathā .. 54 ..
4.35.d:
प्रसूः पित्रोस्तथा भ्रातुः पत्नी श्वश्रूः स्वकन्यकाः ॥
जननी तत्सपत्नी च भगिनी सुरभी तथा ॥ 54 ॥
4.35.m:
the mother of both parents, a brother's wife, a mother-in-law, one's own daughters,
one's mother, her co-wife, a sister, and Surabhī,

4.35.s:
svābhīṣṭasurapatnī ca dhātrikā'nnapradāyikā ..
garbhadhātrī svanāmnā ca bhayāttrātuśca kāminī .. 55 ..
4.35.d:
स्वाभीष्टसुरपत्नी च धात्रिकाऽन्नप्रदायिका ॥
गर्भधात्री स्वनाम्ना च भयात्त्रातुश्च कामिनी ॥ 55 ॥
4.35.m:
the wife of one's chosen deity, a nurse, the giver of food,
the bearer of the womb by name, and the beloved woman of one who rescues from fear—

4.35.s:
etā vedapraṇītāśca sarveṣāṃ mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ..
etāsvapi ca sarvāsu nyūnatā nāsti kāsu ca ..56..
4.35.d:
एता वेदप्रणीताश्च सर्वेषां मातरः स्मृताः॥
एतास्वपि च सर्वासु न्यूनता नास्ति कासु च ॥56॥
4.35.m:
these, laid down by the Vedas, are remembered as the mothers of all;
among all of these, none is in any way inferior.

4.35.s:
kanyādātā'nnadātā ca jñānadātā'bhayapradaḥ ..
janmado mantrado jyeṣṭhabhrātā ca pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ..57 ..
4.35.d:
कन्यादाताऽन्नदाता च ज्ञानदाताऽभयप्रदः ॥
जन्मदो मन्त्रदो ज्येष्ठभ्राता च पितरः स्मृताः ॥57 ॥
4.35.m:
The giver of a daughter, the giver of food, the giver of knowledge, the grantor of fearlessness,
the giver of birth, the giver of the mantra, and the eldest brother are remembered as fathers.

4.35.s:
etā vahanti ye mūḍhā ya etāñjanakānapi ..
pacyante narake te ca yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ .. 58 ..
4.35.d:
एता वहन्ति ये मूढा य एताञ्जनकानपि ॥
पच्यन्ते नरके ते च यावद्वै ब्रह्मणो वयः ॥ 58 ॥
4.35.m:
Those fools who take these [women as wives], or those who [harm] these fathers,
are cooked in hell for as long as the lifespan of Brahmā.

4.35.s:
tānandhakūpe saṃsthāpya dūrato yamakiṅkarāḥ..
kurvanti tāḍanaṃ śaśvatpurīṣaṃ pāyayanti ca .. 59 ..
4.35.d:
तानन्धकूपे संस्थाप्य दूरतो यमकिङ्कराः॥
कुर्वन्ति ताडनं शश्वत्पुरीषं पाययन्ति च ॥ 59 ॥
4.35.m:
Placing them in the Andhakūpa hell, the servants of Yama from afar
beat them constantly and make them drink feces.

4.35.s:
tvameva viśvakartā ca śāstā vai śamanasya ca ..
vayaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ tena gṛhṇāsi kanyakām .. 4.35.60 ..
4.35.d:
त्वमेव विश्वकर्ता च शास्ता वै शमनस्य च ॥
वयं विधाता जगतां तेन गृह्णासि कन्यकाम् ॥ 4.35.60 ॥
4.35.m:
You alone are the creator of the universe and the chastiser even of Death;
is it because ‘we are the creator of the worlds’ that you seize your daughter?

4.35.s:
asmākaṃ purato dūraṃ gaccha kāmārtamānasa..
na kurmo bhasmasātkartuṃ śaktāśca janakaṃ vayam ..61..
4.35.d:
अस्माकं पुरतो दूरं गच्छ कामार्तमानस॥
न कुर्मो भस्मसात्कर्तुं शक्ताश्च जनकं वयम् ॥61॥
4.35.m:
Go far away from our presence, you whose mind is afflicted with lust!
Though capable, we will not reduce our father to ashes.

4.35.s:
gurordoṣasahasrāṇi kṣantumarhanti paṇḍitāḥ ..
sarvaghnaṃ taṃ vinighnanti nītijñāḥ svaguruṃ vinā ..62..
4.35.d:
गुरोर्दोषसहस्राणि क्षन्तुमर्हन्ति पण्डिताः ॥
सर्वघ्नं तं विनिघ्नन्ति नीतिज्ञाः स्वगुरुं विना ॥62॥
4.35.m:
The wise ought to forgive thousands of faults of a guru;
those versed in conduct slay anyone who kills all, except their own guru.

4.35.s:
gṛhṇanti yadi sarvasvaṃ śapantaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ gurum ..
sādhavastaṃ na nindanti praṇamanti svabhaktitaḥ ..63..
4.35.d:
गृह्णन्ति यदि सर्वस्वं शपन्तं निष्ठुरं गुरुम् ॥
साधवस्तं न निन्दन्ति प्रणमन्ति स्वभक्तितः ॥63॥
4.35.m:
Even if he seizes everything, though the guru is harsh and cursing,
the virtuous do not revile him; they bow down with their own devotion.

4.35.s:
ye dviṣanti ca nindati gurumiṣṭaṃ surātparam ..
pacyante te'ndhakūpe ca yāvaccandradivākarau..64..
4.35.d:
ये द्विषन्ति च निन्दति गुरुमिष्टं सुरात्परम् ॥
पच्यन्ते तेऽन्धकूपे च यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ॥64॥
4.35.m:
Those who hate and revile the chosen guru, who is higher than the gods,
are cooked in Andhakūpa as long as the sun and moon endure.”

4.35.s:
purīṣaṃ bhuñjate nityaṃ kṣubhitā yamatāḍanaiḥ ..
sarpapramāṇakīṭaiśca daṃśitāśca divāniśam .. 65..
4.35.d:
पुरीषं भुञ्जते नित्यं क्षुभिता यमताडनैः ॥
सर्पप्रमाणकीटैश्च दंशिताश्च दिवानिशम् ॥ 65॥
4.35.m:
Agitated by the beatings of Yama, they constantly consume feces,
and are bitten day and night by worms the size of serpents. // 65

4.35.s:
ityevamuktvā munayaḥ praṇemustatpadāmbujam ..
sarvaṃ bhavati daivena praśāntamanasā dhruvam .. 66 ..
4.35.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा मुनयः प्रणेमुस्तत्पदाम्बुजम् ॥
सर्वं भवति दैवेन प्रशान्तमनसा ध्रुवम् ॥ 66 ॥
4.35.m:
Having spoken thus, the sages bowed to his lotus feet.
Indeed, everything happens by fate, with a calmed mind. // 66

4.35.s:
unmukhā munayaḥ sarve babhūvuśca svakarmaṇi..
brahmā śarīraṃ saṃtyaktuṃ vrīḍayā ca samudyataḥ ..67..
4.35.d:
उन्मुखा मुनयः सर्वे बभूवुश्च स्वकर्मणि॥
ब्रह्मा शरीरं संत्यक्तुं व्रीडया च समुद्यतः ॥67॥
4.35.m:
All the sages turned their faces toward their own duties,
and Brahmā, out of shame, prepared to abandon his body. // 67

4.35.s:
yogena bhittvā ṣaṭcakraṃ sarvānprāṇānniruddhya ca..
brahmarandhraṃ samānīya tatyāja svena vartmanā ..68..
4.35.d:
योगेन भित्त्वा षट्चक्रं सर्वान्प्राणान्निरुद्ध्य च॥
ब्रह्मरन्ध्रं समानीय तत्याज स्वेन वर्त्मना ॥68॥
4.35.m:
Piercing the six cakras through yoga and restraining all his vital breaths,
bringing them to the brahmarandhra, he gave up [his body] by his own path. // 68

4.35.s:
manasā śrīhariṃ smṛtvā namaskāraṃ cakāra ha ..
na me manaḥ paradravye bhavitā stokamīśvara ..69..
4.35.d:
मनसा श्रीहरिं स्मृत्वा नमस्कारं चकार ह ॥
न मे मनः परद्रव्ये भविता स्तोकमीश्वर ॥69॥
4.35.m:
Remembering Śrī Hari in his mind, he made obeisance:
“O Lord, let not my mind ever incline, even a little, toward another’s property! // 69

4.35.s:
prāṇatyāgātparaṃ duḥkhamayaśaśca yaśasvinām ..
babhūva hṛdi kṛtvaikaṃ brahmā līnaśca brahmaṇi.. .. 4.35.70 ..
4.35.d:
प्राणत्यागात्परं दुःखमयशश्च यशस्विनाम् ॥
बभूव हृदि कृत्वैकं ब्रह्मा लीनश्च ब्रह्मणि॥ ॥ 4.35.70 ॥
4.35.m:
For the famous, disgrace is a greater suffering than loss of life.”
Focusing upon the One in his heart, Brahmā became merged into Brahman. // 70

4.35.s:
kanyā tātaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā vilapya ca bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ..
yogena dehaṃ tatyāja sā pralīnā ca brahmaṇi..71..
4.35.d:
कन्या तातं मृतं दृष्ट्वा विलप्य च भृशं मुहुः॥
योगेन देहं तत्याज सा प्रलीना च ब्रह्मणि॥71॥
4.35.m:
Seeing her father dead, the maiden wailed bitterly again and again,
and gave up her body through yoga, merging into Brahman. // 71

4.35.s:
mṛtaṃ tātaṃ ca bhaginīṃ dṛṣṭvā ca munipuṃgavāḥ ..
sasmaruḥ śrīhariṃ kopātsvātmārāmaṃ vilapya ca ..72..
4.35.d:
मृतं तातं च भगिनीं दृष्ट्वा च मुनिपुंगवाः ॥
सस्मरुः श्रीहरिं कोपात्स्वात्मारामं विलप्य च ॥72॥
4.35.m:
Seeing their father and sister dead, the best of sages
wailed, and in anguish remembered Śrī Hari, who delights in Himself. // 72

4.35.s:
nārāyaṇo madaṃśaśca kṛpayā''gatya satvaram ..
brahmāṇaṃ jīvayāmāsa brahmajñānātsutāṃ ca tām ..73..
4.35.d:
नारायणो मदंशश्च कृपया'ऽगत्य सत्वरम् ॥
ब्रह्माणं जीवयामास ब्रह्मज्ञानात्सुतां च ताम् ॥73॥
4.35.m:
Then Nārāyaṇa, my portion, came swiftly out of compassion
and revived Brahmā and that daughter through the knowledge of Brahman. // 73

4.35.s:
brahmā puro hariṃ dṛṣṭvā varaṃ vavre sma vāñchitam ..
bhaktiṃ tvaccaraṇe śaśvanniścalāmanapāyinīm ..74..
4.35.d:
ब्रह्मा पुरो हरिं दृष्ट्वा वरं वव्रे स्म वाञ्छितम् ॥
भक्तिं त्वच्चरणे शश्वन्निश्चलामनपायिनीम् ॥74॥
4.35.m:
Seeing Hari before him, Brahmā chose his desired boon:
“Unswerving, constant, and unfailing devotion at your feet.” // 74

4.35.s:
brahmāṇaṃ virasaṃ dṛṣṭvā tamuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ..
prabodhavacanaṃ satyaṃ nītisāraṃ manoharam .. 75 ..
4.35.d:
ब्रह्माणं विरसं दृष्ट्वा तमुवाच कृपानिधिः ॥
प्रबोधवचनं सत्यं नीतिसारं मनोहरम् ॥ 75 ॥
4.35.m:
Seeing Brahmā dejected, the ocean of mercy addressed him
with words of awakening, true, captivating, and the essence of ethics. // 75

4.35.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu brahmanpravakṣye'haṃ mukhamuttolya sāṃpratam ..
tyaja lajjāṃ jagannātha hṛdayajvararūpiṇīm .. 76 ..
4.35.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
शृणु ब्रह्मन्प्रवक्ष्येऽहं मुखमुत्तोल्य सांप्रतम् ॥
त्यज लज्जां जगन्नाथ हृदयज्वररूपिणीम् ॥ 76 ॥
4.35.m:
“Listen, O Brahmā! Lift up your face now and I will speak.
Cast off shame, O lord of the world, which takes the form of a fever in the heart! // 76

4.35.s:
satkīrtirapakīrtirvā supratiṣṭhāpyupadravaḥ ..
kṣudrāṇāṃ caiva mahatāṃ bhavatyeva svakarmaṇā ..77..
4.35.d:
सत्कीर्तिरपकीर्तिर्वा सुप्रतिष्ठाप्युपद्रवः ॥
क्षुद्राणां चैव महतां भवत्येव स्वकर्मणा ॥77॥
4.35.m:
Good fame or ill fame, high renown or calamity—
these surely come to the low and the great alike through their own deeds. // 77

4.35.s:
sarveṣāmapi sarvebhyaḥ svakarma balavattaram ..
tasmātsantaḥ prakurvanti nityaṃ satkarma saṃtatam .. 78 ..
4.35.d:
सर्वेषामपि सर्वेभ्यः स्वकर्म बलवत्तरम् ॥
तस्मात्सन्तः प्रकुर्वन्ति नित्यं सत्कर्म संततम् ॥ 78 ॥
4.35.m:
One’s own karma is stronger for everyone than all else;
therefore, the virtuous constantly perform good deeds at all times. // 78

4.35.s:
kecitkurvanti nirmūlaṃ sarveṣāmapi karmaṇām ..
kṛtaṃ karma paraṃ bhuktvā haripādābjacetasaḥ ..79 ..
4.35.d:
केचित्कुर्वन्ति निर्मूलं सर्वेषामपि कर्मणाम् ॥
कृतं कर्म परं भुक्त्वा हरिपादाब्जचेतसः ॥79 ॥
4.35.m:
Some uproot all karmas completely,
having merely experienced whatever deed was done, their minds fixed on Hari's lotus feet. // 79

4.35.s:
kukarmaṇaścāpakīrtistato lajjā bhaveddhruvam ..
sukarmaṇaḥ supratiṣṭhā sarvatra nirmalaṃ yaśaḥ .. 4.35.80 ..
4.35.d:
कुकर्मणश्चापकीर्तिस्ततो लज्जा भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥
सुकर्मणः सुप्रतिष्ठा सर्वत्र निर्मलं यशः ॥ 4.35.80 ॥
4.35.m:
From bad deeds comes ill fame, and from that, shame certainly arises;
from good deeds comes high renown and stainless fame everywhere. // 80

4.35.s:
kālena rajasā deho balaṃ rūpaṃ śubhāśubham ..
kīrtiryā triguṇā caiva mohaścāpayaśo vidhe .. 81 ..
4.35.d:
कालेन रजसा देहो बलं रूपं शुभाशुभम् ॥
कीर्तिर्या त्रिगुणा चैव मोहश्चापयशो विधे ॥ 81 ॥
4.35.m:
Through time and through rajas, the body, strength, beauty, good and evil,
fame—which consists of the three gunas—infatuation, and disgrace [all arise], O creator. // 81

4.35.s:
ṛṇavraṇāpavādāśca jantūnāṃ yānti kālataḥ ..
mahatāṃ tau ca pūrvoktau netaraśca kadācana .. 82 ..
4.35.d:
ऋणव्रणापवादाश्च जन्तूनां यान्ति कालतः ॥
महतां तौ च पूर्वोक्तौ नेतरश्च कदाचन ॥ 82 ॥
4.35.m:
Debts, wounds, and censure of living beings disappear in time;
for the great, those two previously mentioned [debts and wounds disappear], but never the other [censure]. // 82

4.35.s:
sadā'pakīrtirvasati parastrīṣu ca vastuṣu..
tasmātte naiva gṛhṇanti santaḥ svakleśakāraṇe .. 83 ..
4.35.d:
सदाऽपकीर्तिर्वसति परस्त्रीषु च वस्तुषु॥
तस्मात्ते नैव गृह्णन्ति सन्तः स्वक्लेशकारणे ॥ 83 ॥
4.35.m:
Disgrace always dwells in [longing for] the wives and property of others;
therefore, the virtuous do not take hold of those causes of their own affliction. // 83

4.35.s:
smara māmantare brāhme madīyaṃ viṣayaṃ kuru..
ataste na mano lolaṃ bhavitā paravastuṣu .. 84 ..
4.35.d:
स्मर मामन्तरे ब्राह्मे मदीयं विषयं कुरु॥
अतस्ते न मनो लोलं भविता परवस्तुषु ॥ 84 ॥
4.35.m:
Remember me in the inner Brahmic state; make me your object of meditation;
then your mind will not wander toward the belongings of others. // 84

4.35.s:
yoṣidrūpā ca me māyā sarveṣāṃ mohakāriṇī ..
līlayā kurute mohaṃ svātmārāmasya saṃtatam .. 85 ..
4.35.d:
योषिद्रूपा च मे माया सर्वेषां मोहकारिणी ॥
लीलया कुरुते मोहं स्वात्मारामस्य संततम् ॥ 85 ॥
4.35.m:
My māyā in the form of a woman causes delusion in all;
in mere play, she constantly deludes even one who delights in the self. // 85

4.35.s:
nānāmudrāśraye deśe rāgiṇo saṃtataṃ ratiḥ..
stanābhidhe māṃsapiṇḍe'dhare lālālaye'śucau ..86..
4.35.d:
नानामुद्राश्रये देशे रागिणो संततं रतिः॥
स्तनाभिधे मांसपिण्डेऽधरे लालालयेऽशुचौ ॥86॥
4.35.m:
The passionate man continuously finds delight in a place that bears various markings—
in that lump of flesh called a breast, and on the impure lip that is a receptacle for saliva. // 86

4.35.s:
śroṇivaktrastanaṃ tāsāṃ kāmadevālayaṃ sadā ..
tasmātte na hi paśyanti santo hi dharmabhīravaḥ ..87..
4.35.d:
श्रोणिवक्त्रस्तनं तासां कामदेवालयं सदा ॥
तस्मात्ते न हि पश्यन्ति सन्तो हि धर्मभीरवः ॥87॥
4.35.m:
Their hips, face, and breasts are ever the abode of Kāmadeva;
therefore, the virtuous, who fear [violating] dharma, do not look upon them. // 87

4.35.s:
ko dharmaḥ kiṃ yaśasteṣāṃ kā pratiṣṭhā ca kiṃ tapaḥ..
kiṃ buddhirvidyā dānaṃ ca parastrīṣu ca yanmanaḥ .. 88 ..
4.35.d:
को धर्मः किं यशस्तेषां का प्रतिष्ठा च किं तपः॥
किं बुद्धिर्विद्या दानं च परस्त्रीषु च यन्मनः ॥ 88 ॥
4.35.m:
What is the dharma, what is the fame, what is the renown, and what is the asceticism,
what is the intellect, learning, or charity of those whose mind dwells on another's wife? // 88

4.35.s:
ihāpyapayaśo duḥkhaṃ narakeṣu paratra ca ..
vāsaḥ prahārasteṣāṃ ca tāḍanaiḥ kṛmibhakṣaṇaiḥ .. 89 ..
4.35.d:
इहाप्यपयशो दुःखं नरकेषु परत्र च ॥
वासः प्रहारस्तेषां च ताडनैः कृमिभक्षणैः ॥ 89 ॥
4.35.m:
Here [in this world] there is disgrace and sorrow, and in the next world, a dwelling in the hells
with blows, beatings, and being eaten by worms. // 89

4.35.s:
duḥkhabījaṃ sukhaṃ matvā mūḍhāśca daivadoṣataḥ ..
parastrīsevanaṃ prītyā kurvanti saṃtataṃ mudā .. 4.35.90 ..
4.35.d:
दुःखबीजं सुखं मत्वा मूढाश्च दैवदोषतः ॥
परस्त्रीसेवनं प्रीत्या कुर्वन्ति संततं मुदा ॥ 4.35.90 ॥
4.35.m:
Thinking the seed of sorrow to be happiness, fools, due to the fault of destiny,
constantly resort with pleasure to another's wife in joy. // 90

4.35.s:
uttamā matpadāmbhojaṃ satkarma madhyamāḥ sadā ..
smaranti śaśvadadhamāḥ parastrīsevanaṃ mudā .. 91 ..
4.35.d:
उत्तमा मत्पदाम्भोजं सत्कर्म मध्यमाः सदा ॥
स्मरन्ति शश्वदधमाः परस्त्रीसेवनं मुदा ॥ 91 ॥
4.35.m:
The best always remember my lotus feet; the middling remember good deeds;
the lowest constantly remember enjoyment with another's wife with delight. // 91

4.35.s:
vipattiḥ saṃtataṃ tasya paravastuṣu yanmanaḥ ..
viśeṣataḥ parastrīṣu suvarṇeṣu ca bhūmiṣu .. 92 ..
4.35.d:
विपत्तिः संततं तस्य परवस्तुषु यन्मनः ॥
विशेषतः परस्त्रीषु सुवर्णेषु च भूमिषु ॥ 92 ॥
4.35.m:
Misfortune is constant for him whose mind is fixed on another’s property,
especially on another’s wife, gold, and lands. // 92

4.35.s:
daivātparastriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā viramedyo hariṃ smaran ..
dṛṣṭvā parasuvarṇaṃ ca hastaprakṣālanācchuciḥ .. 93 ..
4.35.d:
दैवात्परस्त्रियं दृष्ट्वा विरमेद्यो हरिं स्मरन् ॥
दृष्ट्वा परसुवर्णं च हस्तप्रक्षालनाच्छुचिः ॥ 93 ॥
4.35.m:
He who, having seen another’s wife by chance, desists while remembering Hari,
and, having seen another's gold, becomes pure by washing his hands [is safe]. // 93

4.35.s:
satataṃ naiva saṃsaktāḥ santaḥ svastrīṣu kāmataḥ ..
yakṣmavyādhijñānahānilokanindābhayena ca ..94..
4.35.d:
सततं नैव संसक्ताः सन्तः स्वस्त्रीषु कामतः ॥
यक्ष्मव्याधिज्ञानहानिलोकनिन्दाभयेन च ॥94॥
4.35.m:
The virtuous are never constantly attached out of lust even to their own wives;
and out of fear of consumption, disease, loss of knowledge, and worldly censure.

4.35.s:
tapasvinastapasyāyāṃ śāstracintāsu paṇḍitāḥ..
yogino yogacintāsu vedārtheṣu ca vaidikāḥ ..95..
4.35.d:
तपस्विनस्तपस्यायां शास्त्रचिन्तासु पण्डिताः॥
योगिनो योगचिन्तासु वेदार्थेषु च वैदिकाः ॥95॥
4.35.m:
Ascetics [are engaged] in asceticism, learned scholars in contemplation of the scriptures,
yogins in contemplation of yoga, and followers of the Vedas in Vedic truths;

4.35.s:
sādhyaśca patisevāsu gṛhasthā gṛhakarmasu ..
viṣayeṣu viṣayiṇo madbhaktā mama sevane .. 96 ..
4.35.d:
साध्यश्च पतिसेवासु गृहस्था गृहकर्मसु ॥
विषयेषु विषयिणो मद्भक्ता मम सेवने ॥ 96 ॥
4.35.m:
virtuous women in service to their husbands, householders in domestic duties,
worldly men in worldly pursuits, and my devotees in my service.

4.35.s:
ete niyuktā eteṣu sabhāsu ca praśaṃsitāḥ...
vedoktācaraṇenaiva tadviruddhena ninditāḥ ..97..
4.35.d:
एते नियुक्ता एतेषु सभासु च प्रशंसिताः॥।
वेदोक्ताचरणेनैव तद्विरुद्धेन निन्दिताः ॥97॥
4.35.m:
Engaged in these [duties], these are praised in assemblies
solely through conduct enjoined by the Vedas; through conduct contrary to that, they are censured.

4.35.s:
sarve nityaṃ praśaṃsanti śaśvatsanmārgagāminam ..
hālikā api nindanti kuvartmagāminaṃ vidhe ..98..
4.35.d:
सर्वे नित्यं प्रशंसन्ति शश्वत्सन्मार्गगामिनम् ॥
हालिका अपि निन्दन्ति कुवर्त्मगामिनं विधे ॥98॥
4.35.m:
All people ever praise one who constantly walks the path of the good;
even ploughmen censure one who walks the bad path, O Brahmā.

4.35.s:
bhavitā na parastrīṣu paravastuṣu te manaḥ ..
adyaprabhṛti jīvantaṃ niviṣṭaṃ madvareṇa ca .. 99 ..
4.35.d:
भविता न परस्त्रीषु परवस्तुषु ते मनः ॥
अद्यप्रभृति जीवन्तं निविष्टं मद्वरेण च ॥ 99 ॥
4.35.m:
From today onward, as long as you live, by my boon
your mind shall not be directed toward another's wife or another's property.

4.35.s:
madīyaviṣaye bāhye mayā dattaṃ kuru priyam ..
antarā matpadāmbhojacintāṃ vighnavināśinīm .. 4.35.100 ..
4.35.d:
मदीयविषये बाह्ये मया दत्तं कुरु प्रियम् ॥
अन्तरा मत्पदाम्भोजचिन्तां विघ्नविनाशिनीम् ॥ 4.35.100 ॥
4.35.m:
In the external domain pertaining to me, pursue what is dear, granted by me,
and inwardly [maintain] meditation on my lotus feet, which destroys obstacles.

4.35.s:
kanyā bhavatu me brahmankāmadevasya kāminī ..
ratirnāma parityājyā ratyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ..101..
4.35.d:
कन्या भवतु मे ब्रह्मन्कामदेवस्य कामिनी ॥
रतिर्नाम परित्याज्या रत्यधिष्ठातृदेवता ॥101॥
4.35.m:
Let this maiden become the lover of Kāmadeva, O Brahman;
named Rati, the presiding deity of erotic pleasure, she is to be relinquished [by you]."

4.35.s:
ityevamuktvā brahmāṇamāśvāsya kamalāpatiḥ ..
jagāma nityaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vṛndāvanavinodanaḥ .. 102 ..
4.35.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा ब्रह्माणमाश्वास्य कमलापतिः ॥
जगाम नित्यं वैकुण्ठं वृन्दावनविनोदनः ॥ 102 ॥
4.35.m:
Having spoken thus and comforted Brahmā, the Lord of Kamalā,
he who delights in Vṛndāvana, went to eternal Vaikuṇṭha.
